name: grey robes
description: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: large sign

name: rigid leather tunic
description: This is a boiled leather cuirass. Only slightly flexible, it has soft leather at the joints and on the arms, and provides good protection.

name: studded leather tunic
description: This is a vest of thick leather studded with iron rivets. It is a little heavy, but will provide good protection in combat.

name: chainmail hauberk
description: This is a tunic of small interlinked iron rings, overtop of a thin leather jacket. It is heavy, and makes some noise when in use, but provides very good defense against attack.

name: scalemail tunic
description: This is a suit of boiled leather with coin-sized iron discs sewn onto it. It is a little heavier than chainmail, but also protects better.

name: brigandine tunic
description: This is a suit of boiled leather reinforced with iron bands. It is quite heavy, and makes noise when in use due to the clanking of the iron bands, but provides excellent defense in combat.

name: half-plate corselet
description: This is a corselet of thin steel, worn over a leather jacket. It is very heavy and cumbersome, but provides excellent protection against attacks.

name: light plate corselet
description: This is corselet of light steel plate, worn over heavy leather. It is very heavy and noisy, but the incredible edge it gives in combat may be worthwhile, if you are strong enough to bear its weight!

name: full plate corselet
description: This is a heavy platemail corselet, with a chainmail vest underneath. It is so heavy you can barely pick it up, and it clangs noisily when moved, but it is nearly unsurpassed in the protection it provides in combat.

name: cloth pants
description: This is a pair of simple cloth leggings, with a leather belt to cinch them up. They are light and unrestrictive, but do not provide much in the way of defense.

name: leather pants
description: This is a pair of soft leather pants. They are comfortable and flexible but are not too heavy, and provide decent defense.

name: rigid leather pants
description: This is a pair of soft leather pants with rigid leather plates sewn onto them for protection. They are only slightly bulky, and provide fairly good protection.

name: chainmail leggings
description: These leggings are made of a simple pair of cloth pants, with linked chain-mail overtop. They provide good protection in combat, but make some noise due to the noise they make.

name: scalemail leggings
description: This is a pair of leather pants with iron discs sewn onto them as protection. They are a little heavy, but give better protection than chainmail does.

name: brigandine leggings
description: This is a pair of leather pants with iron bands sewn around them. They provide great protection, but are heavy, and make considerable noise due to the clanking of the overlapping bands.

name: light plate leggings
description: This a pair of steel plate leggings, with heavy leather underneath and at the joints. They are quite heavy, and make tremendous noise, but are invaluable for their defensive potential.

name: full plate leggings
description: This is pair of heavy plate greaves, with chainmail underneath and at the joints. They are extremely heavy and noisy, but provide excellent protection.

name: small sign
description: FILE DESCRIPTION SILVRMRE.TXT

name: skullcap
description: This is an extremely thin skullcap of steel, designed to be worn over the crown of the head. It provides a little defense.

name: soft leather cap
description: This is a leather helm with ear and nose-guards. It is light and flexible, and provides decent protection.

name: hard leather helm
description: This is a rigid leather helm studded with iron rivets. It is much heavier than a regular leather helm, but the iron studs deflect blows.

name: chain coif
description: This is a snugly-fitting chainmail hood, covering head and neck. It is strong and durable, and fairly light.

name: pot-helm
description: This is an iron helm with noseguard and leather neck-guard. It is the helm of choice for most guardsmen and warriors, as it is not too heavy, but protects well.

name: horned helmet
description: This is a solid iron helm, neck-length and horned. Its massive horns curl upwards, like a bull's. It is heavy, but is strong and protects well.

name: visored greathelm
description: This is a massive steel helm, offering full protection from attacks. Vision is limited to sight through the narrow eyeslits.

name: cotton gloves
description: This is a pair of light cotton gloves, offering little protection save from the cold.

name: suede gloves
description: This is a pair of simple suede gloves. They are soft and warm, but are not very protective.

name: leather gloves
description: This is a pair of soft leather gloves. They are longer than most gloves, coming up to the mid-forearm, and give decent protection versus attack.

name: hard leather gauntlets
description: This is a pair of rigid leather gauntlets. They are long, coming nearly up to the elbow, and give good defense. They are the gauntlet of choice for most adventurers.

name: chain gauntlets
description: This is a pair if elbow-length chain gauntlets, with cloth underneath for comfort. They have a leather palm for better weapon grip.

name: scale gauntlets
description: This is a pair of soft leather gloves with coin-sized iron discs sewn onto them. They are heavy, as far as gloves go, and have leather palms for better weapon grip.

name: plate gauntlets
description: This is a pair of steel plate gauntlets. They are heavy and durable, and provide great protection. They have an open leather palm for increased grip.

name: cloth shoes
description: This is a pair of light canvas shoes, with coiled rope soles. They are not suited for action of any kind.

name: padded black boots
description: This is a pair of padded black boots. They come up to mid- shin and are quilted as to reduce noise. This is the footwear of choice for stealth-minded adventurers.

name: ironwood shield
description: Crafted from an ironwood tree, this shield is thick and offers good deflection of attack. Hardened by magic, it is lighter then metal, and a warmth pulses from its surface, much like a heartbeat.

name: hardened leather boots
description: This is a pair of rigid leather boots. They come up to the middle of the shin, and are tough and well-made. They give good protection in combat.

name: chainmail boots
description: This is a pair of rigid leather boots, covered in steel chain links. The links have been muffled, but still make it more difficult for a person to sneak, despite this they offer good protection in combat.

name: plate boots
description: This is a pair of steel plate sollerets, lined with leather on the inside for comfort. Despite this precaution, however, they are not comfortable at all, although they provide great defense against attack.

name: travelers cloak
description: This is a light leather cloak, suitable for the road. It gives a little defense, and is good for protection against the elements.

name: silk cape
description: This is a long silken cape, embroidered with intertwining designs about the hem. A small silver clasp holds it closed.

name: greatcloak
description: This is a massive animal skin cloak. It is thick and is good protection, and provides great defense against the weather, but is heavy and would get in the way of any stealthy maneuvers.

name: buckler shield
description: This is a tiny shield, mostly used in tandem with a fencing weapon. It is light and can be moved quickly to deflect attack, but does not provide very good protection.

name: target shield
description: This is a small wooden shield, used by warriors to practice maneuvers. It is fairly light and protective.

name: round shield
description: This is a medium-sized round shield. It is a popular shield, as it is moderately heavy, and provides good defense.

name: spiked shield
description: This is a medium-sized shield with a large iron spike in the centre. It is very heavy, but gives good protection, as well as a little offense.

name: curved heater
description: This is a traditional knight's shield. It is not too heavy, but is designed to deflect blows well. Its face is blank so that a heraldric symbol or family crest may be placed on it.

name: kite shield
description: This is a long, thin shield, useful against arrows. It is heavy and somewhat cumbersome, but if you stand sideways it is possible to shield most of the body from attack.

name: longsword
description: This is a three-foot length of sharpened cold steel, bladed along one edge. Its blade is thin, and designed for thrusting. Overall, this is a good weapon.

name: broadsword
description: This is similar to the longsword, but is double-edged and is heavier. It hits hard, but is harder to wield than the longsword.

name: shortsword
description: This is a two-foot-long blade, useful for close-quarters fighting. It is the standard arm of alley-fighters, and the dwarven tunnel-fighters, who do not have the space available to swing a long sword.

name: dagger
description: This is a small, sharp knife, used primarily for stabbing. It is easy to handle and to conceal, but it does minor damage. It is completely useless against most heavy armours.

name: knife
description: This is a wicked-looking curved knife. It is heavier than a dagger, but is also harder to wield.

name: stiletto
description: This is an extremely thin, edgeless thrusting blade. It is very small and easy to conceal. Its extremely poor combat value makes it useless against all but the most lightly armoured opponents.

name: battle axe
description: This is a large double-bladed axe, used in one hand. It is a favourite of strong warriors, as it can inflict impressive wounds, and is not so massive as to be unwieldly.

name: scimitar
description: This is a curved sword, about three feet in length, and bladed upon one edge. It is thin, and fairly light, but can deliver considerable slashing wounds.

name: short-spear
description: This is a short thrusting spear, used in one hand and usually with a shield. It can do decent impaling damage, and is a favourite of woods dwellers who have to worry about hitting trees with a swing.

name: sickle
description: This is a sharp, curved crescent of iron. The Druids use this to cut mistletoe and such plants for their woodland worship. In a pinch, it can do decent damage, but it is unwieldly.

name: hatchet
description: This is a short-hafted light axe, not designed for throwing. It is bladed only on one side, and attacks with this weapon are fairly fast and damaging.

name: falchion
description: This is an end-heavy sword, with a slight forward curve. It is large and heavy, and does considerable damage in combat. It is a little unwieldly and slow.

name: greatsword
description: This is a long, heavy, four-foot-long sword. It is quite sharp and deadly, and is bladed on both sides. This two- handed sword can inflict massive damage in battle, but can only be used effectively by the very strong. It can punch through the best platemail with ease.

name: flamberge
description: This is a medium-sized, wavy-bladed greatsword. It is lighter and faster than a conventional greatsword, and inflicts less damage. It is still extremely effective in combat, however.

name: bastard sword
description: This is a light two-handed sword. It is about three-and-a- half feet long, midway in size between a broadsword and a greatsword. It is fairly fast and damaging, and is overall a good weapon.

name: greataxe
description: This is a heavy, long-hafted, double-bladed axe. It is very sharp, and its massive head can inflict horrible wounds on an opponent. It is very slow and unwieldly, but armour is almost useless against it as it punches right through.

name: halberd
description: This is six-foot pole with an axe head mounted at the top. It is extremely slow, and is quite clumsly to wield, but the damage its huge, arcing swings can inflict is quiet high.

name: pike
description: This is a six-foot-long spear. It is too long to be used very well, but provides good defense, and does considerable damage.

name: long-spear
description: This is a four foot long spear, used with both hands. It is fairly quick and is a good defensive weapon, but it does not do great damage.

name: glaive
description: This is a heavy blade mounted on the end of a six-foot pole. It is only bladed on one side, and is used with a harsh chopping motion. It is slow and clumsy, but does very good damage.

name: mace
description: This is a steel ball mounted on a two-foot wooden rod. It is a well-rounded weapon, providing adequate defense and attack. This is the weapon of choice for Priests and the like.

name: morning-star
description: This is a spiked steel ball, attached by chain to a two-foot wooden rod. It does good damage, as when it is swung the ball reaches great speeds, but is not too fast or wieldy.

name: heavy-mace
description: This is a heavy steel ball mounted on a wooden handle. It is fairly large and heavy, and does good damage. It is mainly used by the stronger of the Priesthood.

name: club
description: This is a knob-ended piece of wood. It is generally a poor weapon, doing decent damage but being comparatively slow. Its main advantage is that it is readily available.

name: warhammer
description: This is a martial version of the tool by the same name. It has a heavy, flattened head on one side, and a blunt spike on the other. The damage it can do is considerable, but due to its weight it is fairly slow.

name: spiked club
description: This is a rod with jagged nails stuck through it. It is not very quick or effective against armour, but can do good damage against unarmored foes as the nails rip through them. It is mainly used my impoverished thugs who cannot afford any better weapons.

name: whip
description: This is a four-foot-long braided leather whip. Overall, it is not a very good weapon, as it is used mainly to entangle and to cause pain.

name: war mattock
description: This is a large, heavy, square-headed mace with a flat end. It does good damage and is a fairly good weapon.

name: quarterstaff
description: This is a six-foot wooden staff, bound about the middle with strips of cloth. It is a simple weapon, and does not deal very much damage, but provides good defense as it is quite quick to use.

name: iron-capped staff
description: This is a staff with iron caps on the ends. It does more damage than a conventional staff, but is also slower due to the added weight.

name: flail
description: This is a large, two-handed morning star. It is heavy and extremely damaging, as well as being slow and poor on the defensive side. It is a good weapon for brawny warriors who prefer blunt weapons.

name: battle-hammer
description: This is a large, two-handed sledgehammer. It is very heavy and quite slow, but the damage it does in battle is considerable.

name: iron staff
description: This is a wooden staff with an iron core. It is quite heavy for its size, and is not as easily maneuvered as a regular staff, but it also does more damage.

name: sandals
description: This is a simple pair of leather thong sandals.

name: wall
description: This smooth wall is made of carefully-fitted bricks. As you examine it, one of the bricks seems to stick out of the wall as if it were a gross boil.

name: crack
description: There is a small crack in the wall here. Investigating it further, you find a small button!

name: tapestry
description: This is an elaborately-woven tapestry, made of red and gold thread. It depicts a battle between a griffon and a dragon, their bodies entwined one around the other. Moving it aside, you see a small crack in the wall.

name: hole
description: This jagged hole is about four feet in diameter, and looks as if it was made by some extremely powerful beast. Peering in, you can see the shadowy recesses of a cavernous tunnel!

name: fountain
description: This beautiful alabaster fountain gleams in the light. It is carved to ressemble the arched neck and head of a dragon, and it spews water into a large circular dish in the form of a clamshell.

name: statue
description: This is a white marble statue of a ten-foot-tall knight in full plate armour. He stands resting both hands on the pommel of his sword, and his shield rests up against the wall. Although his face cannot be seen through his visored helmet, he conveys a feeling of sorrow. The statue looks as if it could rotate upon its base.

name: sword
description: The knight's massive bastard-sword is intricately engraved with ancient runic symbols. It is nearly six feet long, and even though this must be a stone duplicate of the real weapon, it appears to be razor-sharp.

name: griffon shield
description: This golden kite shield looks as if it has separated from some wall or fixture. It is rough around the edges but has an inner beauty and shine to it. An intricate carving of a rearing griffon is shown on the shield, showing it to be a symbol of Silvermere. Inscripted on the front of the shield

name: griffon
description: The carved griffon is detailed exquisitely. Each claw and feather is defined so exactly that it must have taken years to complete. The griffon's beak appears as sharp as a sword blade, and its eye shines like a star... but upon closer inspection, you see that the eye is actually a button!

name: jeweled longsword
description: This exquisitely-crafted blade is honed to a razor-sharp edge, and its blade is embellished with highlighted runes and engravings. Its hilt is encrusted with glittering gems of all sizes, and its pommel is fashioned in the form of a dragon's claw gripping a blue sapphire.

name: glowing warhammer
description: This large, one-handed warhammer shines with a soft blue glow. It appears to be made of a dark metal, and although looks heavy is in fact quite easy to swing. Its flat, broad head is ornately carved with sigils of power.

name: high-necked robes
description: These long, voluminous robes have a stiff, high-necked collar which gives a very dramatic appearance to the wearer. The deep green of the robes is offset by brilliant golden runes which adorn the cuffs and hem, and a golden sash around the waist keeps it closed.

name: iron ring
description: This is a plain iron ring, polished so that it gleams brilliantly.

name: copper ring
description: This ring is made of three copper threads, meticulously polished and lacquered, and braided together to form a band.

name: silver ring
description: This is a thick silver ring, heavily carved with angular lines and designs.

name: amethyst ring
description: This beautiful, silver ring is set with a trio of small, uncut, lavender-hued amethysts.

name: golden amulet
description: This amulet is made of heavy yellow gold, worked masterfully into the form of a stylized sun.

name: silver holy amulet
description: This simple but beautifully-crafted amulet is worked in the shape of a holy symbol, and is made out of blue-white silver. It is hung upon a chain of silver links.

name: golden braided belt
description: This belt is fashioned out of thick golden bands, to form a wide braid. It is encrusted with small rubies and diamonds, and the buckle is a large platinum star.

name: platinum tiara
description: This light crown is extremely simple but classically made. It is a single band of platinum, delicately etched and set with a single eye-sized sapphire at the brow.

name: silver bracers
description: These engraved silver bracers are etched with ancient runes and symbols, and are beautifully crafted.

name: golden armbands
description: This matched pair of golden armbands are made of heavy yellow gold with the texture of honey, and are unadorned.

name: maul
description: This huge, two-handed mace is nearly six feet in length. It is so massive that you have difficulty even lifting it, and the damage it does in combat must be incredible, although it is incredibly slow. Only the strongest can wield this weapon with any effect.

name: black star key
description: This black iron key's head is shaped like a circled five-pointed star. You get a faint feeling of distaste when touching it.

name: scroll of cure paralysis
description: This holy writ details the exact prayers and intonations necessary to gain the power to learn this spell.

name: torch
description: This long wooden stick is bound by stips of oil-soaked cloth. When lit, it provides fairly good illumination.

name: lantern
description: This is a small iron lantern, its glass bulb protected by shutters. When filled with oil and lit, it provides very good illumination.

name: bone key
description: This small, fragile-looking key appears to be made of bone. It is quite cold to the touch.

name: silvery mace
description: This brilliant silvery mace shines with an inner light. Its broad head is studded, and its hilt is wrapped in white leather. A thong hangs from the base of its handle.

name: black chainmail hauberk
description: This suit of chainmail is enameled with a flat black lacquer finish. It sports cruel-looking spikes on the shoulder guards and has on it a badge made in the image of a red horned skull.

name: black shield
description: This heavy black iron shield is emblazoned with a red horned skull. It is quite heavy, but is large enough to provide good protection from attacks.

name: tomb door
description: This large stone door is carved with holy images and symbols. A large plaque in the centre is engraved with an elaborate script, but the age of the writing is such that it is indecipherable to you.

name: stone door
description: This huge stone portal is completely plain except for a black keyhole set in the exact centre of its grey face. Spidery runes are carved all about this hole, in a script which you have never seen before.

name: sarcophagus
description: This white stone coffin is seemingly carved out of one huge piece of rock, and is made in the likeliness of the long- dead noble for whom it was commissioned. You can see no seam or binding which would enable it to open.

name: lever
description: This simple iron lever is set in the centre of a steel plate. Its round knob is dull and smoothed by much use.

name: manhole
description: This is a three-foot-wide hole in the centre of the street, concealed by a perforated stone cover which allows the stream of water and refuse to drain into the sewers.

name: iron sink
description: This large iron sink is crudely fashioned to resemble a toad, its gaping mouth open wide. Four webbed feet hold it high off of the ground. Upon further examination, you think that the inside is extensively rusted... until you notice the pool of red liquid on the floor beneath the sink and realize that the 'rust' is actually dried blood.

name: fireplace
description: This squat, gaping fireplace is completely blackened with soot. A large iron hook hangs inside for a pot which isn't there, and the bricks which it is made of are beginning to crumble and fall out.

name: brick
description: Searching the bricks in the fireplace, you eventually find one whose deceptive newness is masked by dirt. It is actually made of steel, and moves easily under your touch.

name: black door
description: Steel bands reinforce this black wooden door. A small shuttered slit is cut at eye level, allowing whomever is inside to look out, but not allowing you to look in. An elaborate depression in the shape of a five-pointed star is set just above the handle of the door.

name: spiked collar
description: This heavy iron collar is studded with cruel-looking spikes. It is large enough that it must have been worn by an animal of great size, and could comfortably fit around the neck of a human. It has some strange runes inscribed about its edge.

name: rope and grapple
description: This is a coil of braided hemp rope, strongly woven and well-made. It could hold the weight of even the heaviest adventurer. It is attached to a heavy four-pronged iron grapple, and is useful for climbing up out of pits or over obstacles.

name: red skull
description: This huge horned skull is carved right into the face of the wall. It is so finely made that is appears to be alive, leering hideously at you. Its large eye sockets are like bottomless pits, with no light reflecting from within the polished holes whatsoever. Its strong jaw is clenched shut, and its apparently razor-sharp teeth fit perfectly together.

name: sacrificial robes
description: These jet black robes are made of a heavy, tightly-woven cloth. The cuffs, collar and hem are adorned with blood-red sigils and glyphs. They radiate a definite aura of evil.

name: emerald-tipped crozier
description: This long cherrywood staff has been polished to a mirror shine and gilded with elaborate designs along its length. At its end, an emerald curl glitters and shines in the the light. This holy weapon allows a priest to channel divine intervention from his or her god!

name: bloodstained shortsword
description: This needle-pointed blade is about two feet long, and is razor-sharp. It is made of some dark metal, and seems to be permanently stained with blood. A red rune glows brightly at the base of the blade.

name: moonblade
description: This finely-made sword glows with a silvery light. It is extremely sharp and seems to be made of some sort of translucent metal. Pale yellow runes engraved into its surface glow softly.

name: switch
description: This is a simple iron switch, set under the edge of the stone table.

name: stone table
description: This is a huge stone table, its edge right at your eye level. Deep cracks riddle its surface, and it is worn with age and heavy use. A stone chair of appropriate size stands nearby.

name: shortbow
description: This small curved bow is made out of a light, polished wood. It is tightly strung, and has a light pull. It is fairly effective at close range, but has not the power for extreme range or damage. It comes with a small quiver filled with arrows.

name: huge darkwood club
description: This massive club is about six feet in length, and is banded about the hilt with a thick strap of greasy leather. It would be nearly impossible for any normal being to wield this, much less even pick it up!

name: platinum ring
description: This small, shiny platinum band is unadorned but is very beautiful in a simple sort of way. It is perfectly round, and isn't scratched in the slightest, which is a testament to its maker.

name: golden belt
description: This wide belt seems to be made of golden chain links, and is fastened with a solid platinum buckle crafted in the shape of a coiled cobra.

name: ruby necklace
description: This glittering necklace is made of a fine silver chain, with small rubies set about it in mountings shaped like the leaves of flowers.

name: black leather tunic
description: This leather vest is made of a glossy black leather which seems to absorb the surrounding light. It does not weigh much at all, and is very flexible.

name: holy medallion
description: This beautiful platinum medallion is exquisitely crafted with the symbols of the gods. It seems to vibrate quietly when you touch its smooth surface.

name: platinum bracers
description: These thin silver bracers would be plain if not for the strange, swirling runes engraved along them. The metal seems warm and strangely pliant, as if some unnatural life lurked within.

name: gold ring
description: This glittering golden ring is quite large, and is studded with opalescent black jewels.

name: elven war-spear
description: This magnificent spear has a three-foot-long shaft of pale white wood as hard as steel. Its razor-sharp head is leaf- shaped, and could cut a hair lengthwise. It is used by grasping the centre of the shaft with one hand, and the butt with the other, giving excellent maneuverability and accuracy. This is a favourite of the elven hunters.

name: laen longsword
description: The longsword is made of an unknown crystal-like substance. You notice it gleam with power when it reflects the sun's light.

name: vorpal sword
description: This long, strangely-crafted sword is made out of some unknown type of metal, which glitters like silver, but is as dark as jet. Its blade is so sharp that even the slightest touch with the edge could sever a finger. This otherwordly weapon would prove deadly in battle.

name: sunsword
description: This heavy golden sword burns with a brilliant fiery light. Its hilt is wrapped in black leather, its pommel and guards elaborately engraved with stylized suns. The arcane power emanating from this weapon is enormous, and it would be impressive in battle.

name: prismatic claymore
description: This blade of four feet has been crafted from an alien metal of ever-changing colours. The sword looks quite sharp and hums with magical energy. Five gems have been fashioned into the hilt: amber, amethyst, onyx, ruby and emerald. Each one is marked with a small silver rune and they all seem to glow in unison.

name: minor healing potion
description: This small glass vial is filled with a shimmering red elixir. It is closed by a simple cork stopper.

name: scroll of divine mercy
description: This holy writ details the exact prayers and intonations necessary to gain the power to learn this spell.

name: songsheet of life
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Life.

name: ebony greataxe
description: This large crystalline greataxe absorbs all light like a hole in space. It is extremely cold to the touch, and is surrounded with a sinister aura.

name: blackened skin-bound book
description: This ancient tome smells rank and seems to be made of the blackened skin of a human! Inside contains many spidery- runed pages.

name: cracks
description: Searching the table, you find a crack wide enough to put your arm through. Looking inside, you see a sturdy iron switch embedded deep within!

name: bas-relief image
description: This beautifully-carved image is that of an angular, glowing figure garbed in flowing robes. Great feathered wings spread out majestically from its back, and its head is bowed as if in supplication. Its androgynous face radiates a feeling of serenity and peace.

name: brass plaque
description: This rectangular brass plaque has been engraved thus:   No form   No mouth with which to speak   Yet sings with a thousand voices   No legs upon which to stand   Yet runs faster than any man.

name: ebony triangle
description: This is a triangular piece of ebony so black that it almost appears to be a rip in space. It is inverted so that it points toward the ground. A golden sun adorns the bottom- most point, a silvery-white crescent moon is in the top left corner, and in the top right corner is a seven-pointed star of blue-tinged silver.

name: golden sun symbol
description: This simply-wrought sun symbol seems to be made of a fine yellow gold. It is not embedded in the ebony triangle, but appears to be affixed to it somehow. Upon closer inspection, you see that although you cannot remove it, it may be possible to move it somehow. It occupies the southern point of the triangle.

name: silvery moon symbol
description: This waxing crescent moon appears to be made of a white metal, possibly platinum. It is fixed to the triangle, but you think it may be able to be moved in some way.

name: seven-pointed star symbol
description: This star is crafted out of a bluish silver, and its seven points are evenly spaced about its perimeter. It is set in the top right corner of the ebony triangle, and although it is affixed there you get the impression that it is meant to be moved.

name: stone face
description: As you look closer, the stone face comes to life. Its eyes flicker open, and as it opens its lips, a chilling, hollow voice whispers the words:          Never seen, always felt          Without you are dead as stone.

name: minotaur statue
description: This crudely-wrought statue easily fills the entire wall from floor to ceiling. It depicts a hideous bull-headed creature with the muscular torso of a man, and hairy legs with cloven hooves. It wields a massive greataxe, and the expression on its face is one of sadistic joy. You notice some words scratched into the floor next to the statue.

name: statue's stone greataxe
description: This massive axe is huge even for a two-handed weapon. It has a single massive blade, and looks like the axes executioners use to remove their victims' heads from their necks. It appears that there is a joint at the base of the greataxe's handle, where it is gripped by the statue, allowing it to be moved somewhat.

name: statue's horned head
description: Long and terrible horns jut out from either side of the minotaur statue's head. Looking closer, you notice they are both jointed at their bases. Your curiosity aroused, you inspect the head thoroughly and find some other mysterious discoveries -- both the statue's eyes and nose ring appear to have been set in after the creation of the statue.

name: statue's eyes
description: The minotaur's eyes are much more skillfully crafted than the rest of the statue, and appear to have been set in after the main statue body was created. They reflect what looks like an attitude of utter fearlessness and ferocity, and you shudder when you think that the real beast must truly exist. At any rate, since they are separate, they might be moved.

name: words scratched into floor
description: There are but a few straggling characters scratched into the floor here, and due to their shaky hand you presume that they were written in haste. Apparently parts have been worn out with the passage of time. They read:
There appears to be more, but much is scratched out.

name: statue's nose ring
description: This is a simple stone hoop set through the nostrils of the statue's nose. It appears to be able to move freely, and the construction of the whole face indicates to you that this statue is not all that it seems.

name: bone staircase
description: This disturbing stair is seemingly comprised of hundreds of bleached bones. There are bones of all types of creatures here, including many odd, alien ones that must have come from beasts you have never heard of. You cannot tell what holds the staircase together, as its bewilderingly rickety shape defies most natural laws of construction.

name: iron door
description: This massive iron door must be at least twelve feet in height, and six feet across. It is heavily riveted and reinforced, and although you cannot possibly know how thick it is, you surmise it would be nearly impossible to batter down. A black hole about an inch in diameter is located on the right edge of the door.

name: wooden table
description: This is a fairly ordinary oaken table, about six feet by four feet in size. It has four stumps as legs, and stands three feet off of the ground.

name: stone shelves
description: These crude stone shelves have been carved out of the wall by the use of some sharp, heavy instrument. Placed on these shelves is a variety of disgusting objects, ranging from a pile of rancid scalps to a jar full of fingerbones. Dead bats and reptiles also occupy space here.

name: bone-handled headcutter
description: This is a massive, double-handed axe with a shaft made out of the petrified bone of some unknown creature. Its blade is huge and heavy, and its single edge appears to be razor- sharp.

name: ruby key
description: This is a large silver key, with an eye-sized ruby set in the handle. It is set upon a thick leather thong.

name: serpent staff
description: This long, twisted mahogany staff is carved in the form of a slender snake. Small glittering emeralds in its eyes glow with an inner fire, and it is warm to the touch.

name: golden broadsword
description: This long, leaf-bladed broadsword shines with a mirrorlike golden finish. Its crossguard is fashioned to look like a pair of spreading wings, and the pommel is a bird's claw clutching an amber stone. A strange, stylized five-pointed star is etched into the blade near its base.

name: golden breastplate
description: This elegant golden breastplate has been crafted to look like a muscled torso, the model of which must have been impressive indeed. It is polished well enough that you can clearly see your reflection in its surface, and is surprisingly light for its size.

name: rosewood staff
description: This long, straight staff is quite slender and looks as if you could snap it in two, but in actuality cannot even be bent in the slightest. It is plain and unadorned, with the exception of small runes encircling the top and bottom ends.

name: shimmering white robes
description: These extremely plain and unadorned robes seem to made out of plain cotton, but there is definitely something special about them that you just can't put your finger on. They are soft and comfortable, and their mere touch soothes you. Holy symbols are worked into the hem with a simple stitch.

name: cure poison potion
description: This small metal flask is stopped up with a cork. Opening it up, you see a thick violet liquid sloshing about. It smells like sour berries, but none like you have ever smelled before.

name: starsteel scimitar
description: This curved sword appears to have been crafted from an extremely rare metal called starsteel. The blade shines bluish-silver and the edge glitters brightly. A single glittering diamond has been set in its pommel, and spiral symbols inlaid in its hilt glow warmly.

name: red robes
description: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It is thin and provides little protection, but it quite light.

description: This is a plain leather belt, with a square iron buckle to hold it closed.

name: iron ration
description: This is a small package containing specially-preserved and cured meat, some dried fruits, and sack of varied nuts. It is the staple of far-ranging adventurers who either have no hunting skills or who don't have the inclination to hunt for their food.

name: waterskin
description: This is a small waterskin made of waterproofed leather. It holds a few litres of water.

name: incense
description: This is a small stick of incense. It is sometimes burned in religious ceremonies as it has a somewhat soothing effect when inhaled and helps concentration.

name: bone charm
description: This is a strange, yellowed bone amulet strung on a crude string. it has unsettling symbols carved on its surface, and it feels slightly warm in your palm.

name: brass lamp
description: This is an ancient, heavily-etched brass lamp. It has been polished to the point that you can see the reflection of your face clearly in its surface. It is filled with a sweet- smelling scented oil.

name: glass mirror
description: This is a circular glass mirror, set in a carved wooden frame. It is a fairly common sight, and one can be found in nearly every maiden's possession.

name: carved ivory mask
description: This is an odd ivory face-plate, with two silken strings to tie behind your ears to keep it in place. It has two thin eye slits to see through, and is ornately carved with delicate swirling designs.

name: silk robe
description: This is a beautiful silken robe, glossy midnight blue in colour. It is durable and extremely smooth to the touch. On its back a slender, sinuous dragon-like creature is curled about a magnificent silver orb. It is bound about the waist with a shimmering silver sash.

name: tankard of mead
description: This is a large, heavy wooden mug filled with a sweet honey mead. It is very tasty.

name: jug of dark ale
description: This is a fair-sized earthenware jug of dark brewed ale. It is quite strong, and has a slightly bitter taste.

name: bottle of wine
description: This is a small corked bottle of red wine. It is not of the highest quality, but nonetheless has a slight tartness and full flavour.

name: roast mutton
description: This is a greasy, but well-done joint of mutton. It smells wonderful!

name: beef stew
description: This is a small earthenware bowl filled with a thick, nutritious stew comprised of beef and onions.

name: fine broadsword
description: This is an extremely well-crafted blade of high steel. Its apparent age has not affected its condition, and it still holds a sharp edge.

description: Dark fire rises from this blade, even as damnation is spelled out in twisted runes along its length. Screams of agony can be heard as this sword weaves through the air, its keen edge unstoppable against most protection. Swords such as this can only come from the netherworld, and most carry a horrific price for wielding its power.

name: ancient scroll
description: This ancient scroll holds cryptic writing within it that seem glow with a dangerous power. They look to be priestly runes inscribed upon its aged skin.

name: tarnished chainmail hauberk
description: This is a tunic of iron chain armour. It appears to be well- used, as it is covered with a thin layer of rust and many nicks and scratches.

name: padded vest
description: This is a heavy vest made out of crudely-quilted cloth. It is one-size-fits-all, with a rope belt to cinch the waist. It provides decent protection, but is very heavy for its combat worth.

name: padded pants
description: This is a simple pair of heavy cloth pants. They are of questionable quality, and are tailored to fit nearly anyone. A rope is tied about the waist to keep them up.

name: padded helm
description: This is an open-face helmet made out of heavy quilted cloth. Its multiple layers of crude cloth make it fairly heavy for its meagre protection, but it is better than entering combat without one. A bare head makes an inviting target to opponents.

name: padded gloves
description: These heavy gloves are made of a canvas-like cloth, crudely stitched. They are a common sight on any working man's hands as they protect well from chafing, and provide some protection from damage.

name: padded boots
description: These knee-length boots are made of heavy quilted cloth, with coiled rope soles. They provide little protection, and are fairly heavy, but they are better than nothing.

name: claw glyph
description: This is a carving of a cruelly-hooked, clawed hand. It is inscribed in the centre of the marble wall, and is circled by two concentric rings. Directly underneath the claw glyph is a small, round button.

name: iron key
description: This is a heavy iron key. Its handle is crafted in the form of a coiled serpent.

name: golden battleaxe
description: This heavy, double-bladed hand axe appears to be made of a glittering gold. Its razor-sharp blade gleams in the light, illuminating the miniscule runes covering its surface.

name: flame glyph
description: This is a carving of a stylized flame, surrounded by two concentric rings. Directly underneath it is a small round button.

name: obsidian key
description: This is a large shiny key carved from obsidian stone. Its handle is wrapped with silver thread.

name: mithril cutlass
description: This three-foot-long blade is crafted out of the finest metal known -- mithril. Its blade is so keen it could cut a hair, and its balance is perfect. Its slightly-curved blade can slice through steel and flesh with equal ease.

name: fist glyph
description: This is an image of a mailed, clenched fist carved into the wall. It is surrounded by a pair of concentric circles. One of the circles appears to be outlined, as though it were a button carved into the glyph.

name: stone key
description: This is a large stone key, made out of a black-flecked granite.

name: sign
description: ** Choose your path wisely **

name: copper key
description: This is a large copper key. Its handle has an eye stamped into it.

name: shimmering greatsword
description: This exquisite silvery greatsword is polished to a mirrorlike sheen. Its hilt is wrapped in cords of gold, and is heavily worked with holy symbols.

name: platinum mace
description: This well-balanced mace has a round head made out of reinforced platinum, with a shaft of black iron. Its head is inscribed with holy symbols, and there is a powerful aura of power surrounding it.

name: black flail
description: This large, jet-black flail has glowing red runes burning along its length. Its three heads are spiked and would cause great damage in battle.

name: crystal shortsword
description: This razor-edged blade is made of chiseled green crystal. Its hilt is crafted out of black steel, and is bound with silver cord.

name: ebony ninjato
description: This straight singled-edged blade is made out of some strange black metal. Its hilt is forged into the shape of a black panther with glowing amber stones for eyes.

name: flametongue
description: This long, needle-pointed blade is made of shining high steel. Its hilt is carved obsidian, and is inlayed with small rubies. When drawn, the blade bursts into flame, burning those whom it hits.

name: darkwood staff
description: This is a living branch from a darkwood tree. It is warm to the touch, and you can feel the lifeblood flowing within. A silver sheath caps the bottom of the staff, and the centre is carved with intricate looping designs to provide good grip.

name: obsidian runestaff
description: This is a six-foot-long staff of a glossy jet black substance. Its surface is heavily carved with swirling runes which seem to pulse and glow redly with an inner light.

name: jeweled main-gauche
description: This long-bladed knife is meant to be wielded in the left hand as a defensive weapon. It has a wide guard and strong blade, which allow it to turn aside most weapons. It is quite ornate, and an eye-sized ruby is set in its pommel.

name: silver rapier
description: This light sword has a long, thin blade designed for thrusting, which shines with a soft white light. It handles beautifully, and it seems to move with a will of its own.

name: clawed gloves
description: These heavy gloves are made out of stiff cloth, and they each have three steel claws jutting off of their backs. They are used by mystics to increase their hand-to-hand damage.

name: witchwood spear
description: This spear is crafted from a magically-grown hardwood, which when cut from the living tree, can be crafted into high quality magical weapons. This long spear is inlaid with silvery runes, and its foot-long bladed head narrows to a razor-sharp point.

name: jeweled scimitar
description: This elaborately-worked scimitar is made of the finest high steel, and is worked with many exquisite gems. Its hand guard is delicately worked to portray a snake biting its own tail.

name: brass key
description: This shiny brass key has the image of a burning flame on its handle.

name: glowing broadsword
description: This beautifully-crafted broadsword is honed to a razor- sharp edge. Silvery runes etched along its blade glow softly.

name: runed chainmail hauberk
description: This steel-link chainmail vest is reinforced with thin metal plates. It is of exquisite craftsmanship, and the runes engraved in its surface seem to glitter in the light.

name: steel nunchaku
description: This small flail is made up of two steel rods joined together by a short iron chain.

name: ninjato
description: This finely-crafted steel blade is honed to a razor-sharp edge, and bears an ornately-designed wooden hilt.

name: kusari gama
description: This huge flail consists of a sickle on one end attached to a large weighted chain.

name: black tabi
description: These padded black boots resemble sandals worn overtop knee-length leggings. Their soles are woven in such a way so that the sounds of movement are muffled greatly.

name: hooded mask
description: This mask is made out of a flat black material, specially treated to not reflect the light. It conceals the wearer's head, leaving nothing but a slit to see through.

name: black ninja robes
description: These tight black robes are made out of a tough, non- reflective fabric. They are slightly elastic to allow freedom of movement, but are fitted so they do not flap or make any noise.

name: emerald-hilted rapier
description: This long, diamond-bladed rapier sparkles endlessly, causing you to fall into a slight daze. Its hilt, gleaming with emeralds, emits a faint green glowing aura. Examining the blade closer you realize that it is razor sharp and you notice the words
engraved upon its pommel.

name: tower shield
description: This huge iron shield is bolted together with rivets, and is held onto the forearm by thick leather straps. It provides a virtual wall of defense against attack, but gets in the way of your attacks as well as the opponents. The incredible weight of this shield prohibits its use by weaker adventurers.

name: soulsword
description: This ghostly weapon flickers with charged energy from the astral plane. Its nature is such that it magically bonds with the bearer, and cannot be removed except by spells. It is rumoured that Soulswords will remain with the wielder even after death, accompanying him into the afterlife.

name: silvery skullcap
description: This thin skullcap is made of a shining silver-like metal. It is heavily inscribed with angular runes, glowing a faint blue. An emanation of power surrounds it.

name: eagle helm
description: This fine steel helm is crafted to look like an eagle's head. The beak is short, curved, and sharp, and the feathers are engraved into the surface of the helm with remarkable workmanship. The eagle's black eyes are of glossy stone.

name: wolf helm
description: This exquisite helm is crafted from the finest steel, and is light as well as strong. It is crafted in the form of a snarling wolf's head with the jaws wide open, giving the appearance that the wearer is being swallowed alive.

name: runed cowl
description: This midnight-blue hood is inscribed with spiralling silver glyphs. A fine silver chain attached to it is used to fasten it to a cloak or shirt.

name: crested war helm
description: This elaborate helmet is crafted from the lightest high-steel, and is designed with only one thing in mind -- effectiveness in combat. Its visored face offers only a small eyeslit to see through, and small enchanted jewels set in the sides aid the user in combat.

name: jade amulet
description: This small, circular pendant is carved and polished from a deep green jade. It is inscribed with a single exotic rune.

name: amethyst pendant
description: This is a crudely-cut piece of amethyst in a plain iron setting.

name: ethereal amulet
description: This is a smoky piece of glass hung on a thin silvery chain. Some small, dark-coloured object is set in the centre of the glass, and radiates an eerie, shifting aura.

name: holy vestements
description: These elaborate white robes are decorated with gold lace and small precious gems. Holy symbols are woven into the hem and cuffs with golden thread.

name: gilded robes
description: These gorgeous robes are made out of glittering cloth of gold, and have golden buttons and trim. Small glowing runes are etched into the collar.

name: runed robes
description: These midnight-blue robes are inscribed with spiralling silver glyphs. Silver bands adorn the cuffs, collar and hem. An aura of arcane power radiates from within.

name: wyvernhide tunic
description: This thick leather tunic is made from boiled wyvern's hide. The dull brown scales are extremely tough, and provide excellent protection from attack. Wyvernhide is highly prized as wyverns are known for their ferocity in combat.

name: cat's-eye pendant
description: This small golden pendant is set with a chrysoberyl gem, commonly referred to as a cat's eye. It is worn on a thin gold chain, and, although quite beautiful, radiates an unsettling aura.

name: gianthair vest
description: This is a thick padded vest made of giant's hair. Giant hair is widely used in the making of ropes and is used in the construction of many armours, as it is tough and durable. A vest made of giant hair is both protective and light, and provides protection from the elements.

name: red enameled scalemail
description: This heavy scalemail shirt is crafted from the finest steel. The scales have been individually lacquered with a crimson substance, and are polished to a brilliant shine. It feels unnaturally cool to the touch.

name: chainmail halter
description: This is a chainmail halter-top, with cloth padding underneath. It is worn by women wishing to be fashionable as well as effective in combat.

name: steel brassiere
description: This is a light steel breastplate for women, padded with leather. It is slightly cumbersome, but provides great protection.

name: fine breastplate
description: This marvellously-crafted breastplate is made of the finest tempered steel, designed to be light and extremely strong. It is the armour of choice for many knights and heavy footmen.

name: adamantite chainmail hauberk
description: This heavy suit of chainmail armour gleams with the smooth darkness of the metal known as adamantite. Nearly indestructible and quite rare, only master smiths have the necessary skill to craft such works of art.

name: shadow cloak
description: This nightblack cloak is made from some strange, non- reflective cloth, and is smooth to the touch. It is not stirred by the wind or weather, but just hangs motionless.

name: crimson cloak
description: This long cloak is made of fine, brilliant red silk, and is embroidered with gold thread. A thick gold chain and clasp hold it closed at the neck. A glittering diamond in the clasp is engraved with a single angular rune.

name: elven cloak
description: This lightweight cloak is made of a smooth, close-knit cloth. It shifts and shimmers, and blends into the surroundings, helping the wearer avoid detection. A small silver clasp in the shape of a leaf holds it closed at the throat.

name: adamantite bracers
description: These heavy, dull grey bracers are crafted from the juggernaut of all metals -- adamantite. It is known for its massive weight and incredible durability. As with anything made from adamantite, these bracers are heavy and nearly impenetrable.

name: serpent armbands
description: This is a pair of armbands crafted to look like snakes entwining each arm. Their sinuous spirals are made from some dull green metal. Each tiny scale is picked out with marvellous skill, and the serpents' eyes are small rubies.

name: crimson bracers
description: These steel bracers have been lacquered a dull red. Curving runes engraved along their length glow a faint orange, like dim coals on a hearth. A small ruby is set in the centre of the face of each bracer.

name: silver bracelet
description: This is a simple silver link bracelet, commonly worn as adornment.

name: ivory bracers
description: These beautiful ivory bracers are carved with intricate animals, many of which you have never seen before. They are light and delicate, and seem well-used.

name: fingerbone bracelet
description: This is a simple leather thong strung with fingerbones from various races... some very familiar. The bones are carved with crude shamanistic runes.

name: silk gloves
description: This is a beautifully-crafted pair of silk gloves. They are light and protective, though somewhat costly.

name: gauntlets of power
description: These heavy plate gauntlets are made of strong black iron. Engraved in the centre of the back of each gauntlet is a glowing yellow rune.

name: white satin gloves
description: These simple white gloves are made of a soft white satin, stitched with golden thread. A holy symbol is embroidered into the back of each glove.

name: embroidered black gauntlets
description: These heavy gauntlets seem to be made of some dull black leather. They are stitched with heavy black thread, and unholy symbols are stitched on their backs.

name: sapphire ring
description: This small silver ring is set with a pale, glittering sapphire. The gem is as translucent as a piece of ice, and just as cold.

name: mithril ring
description: This small, intricate ring is made of pure mithril, and is carved in the shape of many intertwining bodies. Tiny diamonds are set for eyes, and the ring glitters brightly in the light. Its exquisite craftmanship means it was likely a dwarf lord's prized possession.

name: opal ring
description: This heavy platinum ring is set with a massive opal, carved by some magical means in the shape of a skull. Sinister runes are etched along the length of the shining band.

name: moonstone ring
description: This beautiful silvery ring is made of three intertwining bands. Set in the centre is a cluster of three moonstones which glow with a soft light.

name: malachite ring
description: This heavy malachite ring is carved in the shape of a snake biting its own tail. Small, fluidly-engraved runes are set in the inside of the ring.

name: belt of might
description: This is a plain leather belt, with a solid iron buckle fashioned into two clasping hands. Its ordinary appearance hides a potent power.

name: fine platinum chain
description: This is a long, extremely thin chain of brilliant platinum. Gold thread is intertwined in between the shining links. This type of chain is commonly worn wrapped about the waist by wealthy women.

name: silk trousers
description: This is a pair of brilliant silk pants, of excellent workmanship. They are light and loose, and tight around the ankles and waist.

name: leather skirt
description: This is a soft leather skirt, coming down to just above the knees. It is comfortable and flexible, and has a slit up the side for ease of movement.

name: silvery chain leggings
description: These brilliant leggings are crafted from some silvery metal chain mesh. A band of disks about the waist is etched with a series of strange letters in some foreign tongue.

name: black plate leggings
description: These crude iron plates are inscribed with harsh, sprawling runes, and are heavily nicked and scratched. However, they are surprisingly light for their apparent size.

name: dwarven work boots
description: These heavy leather boots are reinforced with steel bands, and have heavy metal caps on the toes. They are of sturdy dwarven manufacture, meant for durability and toughness -- ugly, but effective.

name: elven boots
description: These well-made boots are crafted from some soft, but extremely durable leather. They come up past the knee, and are normally folded over at the tops. Such boots are said to aid a person in the arts of stalking.

name: winged sandals
description: These silvery sandals are adorned with a small pair of feathery white wings on each heel.

name: snakeskin boots
description: This is a pair of glittering black snakeskin boots. The scales are sharp and opalescent, and gleam like oil in the light.

name: mirrored shield
description: This is a perfectly round shield of steel. Its face has been polished to a literally mirrorlike shine, and its reflection is dazzling.

name: heavy bone mace
description: This massive mace is seemingly carved from the legbone of some huge animal. Its head is knobbed and is covered in wicked-looking protrusions.

name: starsteel greatsword
description: This huge two-handed sword is crafted from some glittering, silvery metal. The light refracts off of it in rainbows, its perfect surface reflecting like a mirror. Its elegant hilt is bound in black leather. The pommel is adorned with a softly glowing diamond the size of a bull's eye, and sinuous patterns are etched into the double crossguards.

name: dwarven-craft hammer
description: This heavy, two-handed hammer is imbued with powerful striking magics. It is used by the elite dwarven smiths to craft the most precious of metals -- mithril. These hammers are the only things that have the power to craft mithril, and consequently make incredible weapons in battle; however, they are lacking greatly in accuracy.

name: trident
description: This is a heavy, two-handed weapon much like a spear. Its shaft is crafted from a durable hardwood, and its triple- pronged head of high steel. The tip-heavy construction of the trident makes it a somewhat clumsy weapon if one is not used to it, but it is effective nonetheless.

name: warpblade
description: The blade of this strange weapon seems to fade in and out of existence -- one minute a solid grey length, the next as insubstantial as smoke. Odd sigils are etched up and down the length of the blade, and golden threads are worked into the normal-seeming steel hilt.

name: hell-flail
description: This massive, three-headed flail is made of some heavy, soot-coloured metal. It reeks of brimstone and charred flesh. Evil-looking runes glow like the fires of hell on the brutally-spiked head.

name: thunderstaff
description: This slender, silvery staff crackles with power. Lightning flickers up and down its length, and magical runes are engraved in jagged patterns all over it.

name: frost sceptre
description: This heavy glass sceptre feels as cold as ice. Its broad, flat head is engraved with a single, brightly glowing rune. The handle is wrapped in white leather, and a thong hangs from the pommel.

name: serpent scourge
description: This vicious-looking weapon consists of a cluster of long lashes attached to an iron handle. Each four-foot leather lash is painted green and is fitted with a wicked iron tip crafted in the likeness of a snake's head. A small green emerald set in the pommel glows malevolently.

name: black scimitar
description: This wicked-looking blade is heavily serrated. It is heavy and unwieldy, but would do great damage to unarmoured opponents.

name: oaken staff
description: This heavy oaken staff appears to be carved with strange druidic runes and symbols. It is extremely hard and sturdy.

name: golden sickle
description: This foot-long sickle is wickedly curved, and gleams brightly in the light. Its golden surface is engraved with images of trailing ivy and mistletoe. The razor-sharp edge of its blade glitters unnaturally.

name: bladed staff
description: This exotic weapon consists of a four-foot shaft of hardwood with two long, curved iron blades mounted on the ends. It appears unwieldy but is in fact a deadly and effective weapon when used in the right hands.

name: heavy black rod
description: This three-foot-long rod flickers from light grey, to charcoal, to night black, then back to grey again in an endless cycle of shifting shades. It is completely unmarked and is as smooth as glass.

name: crystal spear
description: This is a four-foot-long spear made out of some glittering, faceted crystal. It is extremely sharp, and its surface from the head down has been smoothed and carved to provide better grip.

name: blue potion
description: This is a small glass vial, filled with a thick, dark blue liquid. An eye is burned into the cork.

name: turquoise potion
description: This is a crystal bottle, filled with a pale turquoise elixir. It is stoppered with a steel plug, which has a symbol of a drop imprinted on it.

name: green potion
description: This is a small steel-banded glass bottle, filled with a dull-coloured green liquid. The stopper is branded with a small symbol in the shape of a crescent moon.

name: yellow potion
description: This is a glass vial filled with a thin, bright yellow liquid. Stamped into the cork is a small symbol of a sun.

name: frothing pink potion
description: This fragile glass vial is filled with a pale pink elixir. The liquid is bubbling and churning up white foam. Three lines are stamped into the cork.

name: silvery potion
description: This small glass vial is filled with a glittering silver liquid. Engraved upon the steel stopper is a small cross.

name: orange potion
description: This is a large glass flask, the bottom half of which is wrapped in a leather covering. A thick orange liquid sloshes about within. Upon the stopper is carved a clenched fist.

name: white potion
description: This thick crystal bottle is filled with a thin white liquid with the consistency of milk. A strange rune is carved into the stopper.

name: black orb
description: This fist-sized orb is engraved with swirling lines and designs. Spaced evenly about the orb are six different runes, carved deeply into its surface.

name: belt of faith
description: Crafted from a mix of mithril and adamantite, this belt is a symbol of protection. A platinum circle adorned with a diamond, a ruby, and an onyx sits as the buckle. Inscripted upon it are the words
It is very finely made and gives off an aura of power.

name: darkwood ring
description: This polished black ring is made out of the wood of the sturdy darkwood tree, which is known for its iron-like strength. The ring is carved with elaborate sigils and runes, and it radiates a faint warmth.

name: green metal key
description: This large, heavy key is made of some rough green metal. Its many teeth jut out at strange angles. The key's head is crafted in the shape of a serpent's head.

name: large iron key
description: This massive iron key is quite crudely made. Its solid construction makes it fairly invulnerable to damage, however.

name: tree trunk
description: A large tree that has been ripped from the ground, only someone with extreme strength could imagine wielding it. Large handprints have shrunk one side of it, forming a handle of sorts. It could easily cause great damage to any unlucky enough to meet its bark.

name: cyclops eye
description: This huge eyeball is about two feet in diameter, and glows with a greenish hue. It is fairly heavy and cumbersome.

name: greater red dragon scale
description: This huge reddish scale is larger than a tower shield and as solid as iron. It is incredibly light for its size, though, which is fortunate since otherwise it would be impossible to lift.

name: spider silk
description: This is a coil of shimmering, silky thread, smooth and cool to the touch.

name: crystal sword
description: This is a light two-handed sword, made out of some glittering multifaceted crystal. Its edges are sharpened to the point where they could cut a hair.

name: crystal club
description: This large, heavy club is made out of a glittering, multifaceted crystal.

name: rolled parchment
description: To chieftain Ss'keth'an -- Affairs are proceeding as planned. You shall be well rewarded for your defense of the crystal pass. We have many slaves that would suit your needs admirably. Remember, it is VITAL that no one passes through the crystal tunnel. See that none do. You know what swift vengeance would be exacted otherwise.  -- Lord Cambron

name: large broken tree
description: This twisted black tree juts out over the edge of the chasm here. Upon closer inspection, you notice a path hidden by bushes surrounding the base of the tree. The path leads down onto a concealed ledge, where a pair of stairs lead down the face of the cliff!

name: greater hellhound hide
description: This is the thick, heavy hide of a greater hellhound. Its black fur is dry and straight, and reeks of brimstone.

name: magma amulet
description: This dully-glowing pendant is made of grey iron. Set in the centre of its face is a smooth red stone, and it hangs upon a braid of thick black hair.

name: large boulder
description: This massive stone is charred and heavily gouged by some huge clawed animal. However, at your touch it moves slightly, and you think that it may be possible to turn it!

name: Kher grass
description: This is a bundle of black, unclean-looking weeds. It smells sour, and is almost greasy.

name: cross key
description: This heavy gold key's handle is shaped like an X. The barrel and teeth are smooth and shiny.

name: runed key
description: This small red key is inscribed with glittering black runes. It is very heavy for its size, and seems to glow warmly when you hold it.

name: skull key
description: This large, light key is made of polished ivory. Its many teeth are sharp, and its handle is carved in the form of a grinning skull.

name: skull sword
description: This huge, one-handed sword is crafted out of some dark metal. Its blade is serrated and razor-sharp, and is engraved with skulls along its length. Its long bone handle is as strong as iron, and appears to be the legbone of some creature. A small skull is set in the pommel.

name: glowing red amulet
description: This heavy iron amulet is surrounded by a dull red glow. It is inset with rubies and is carved in the shape of a black sun. It hangs upon a fine chain of black metal, and seems warm to the touch.

name: gleaming steel device
description: This shiny metal contraption is smooth and seamless. Its myriad parts fit together bewilderingly, so that you do not know where one part begins and the next ends. You have never seen anything like it. Its tall, pillar-like shape is broken by three dark slots spaced evenly about its surface. A faint hum comes from within, and it is slightly warm to the touch.

name: dark temple key
description: This heavy obsidian key is smooth and warm to the touch. Its head is crafted in the shape of a horned skull, with glowing rubies for eyes. The skull seems to grin at you maliciously, and you get a feeling of disease while this is near you.

name: katana
description: This is a light one-handed sword. It is about three and a half feet long, midway in size between a broadsword and a greatsword. Its slightly curved blade is razor-sharp, and the sword is apparently made by a master craftsman. Its black hilt is carved in the shape of a rearing panther.

name: black plate corselet
description: This is a heavy platemail corselet, made of black iron. Underneath is a black chainmail shirt of the same material. It is extremely heavy, but is massive and will provide excellent protection from attack. Glowing red runes glitter over its entire surface, and appear to crawl and move when you're not looking directly at them.

name: golden chalice
description: This large, heavy goblet is encrusted with jewels, and is exquisitely carved with flocks of angels. A holy prayer is inscribed in flowing letters about its base.

name: hideous altar
description: This massive altar is crafted out of red stone, in the shape of a horned skull. Its features are picked out with exquisite skill, its open mouth filled with needle-sharp teeth. Its huge eye sockets gaze at you hollowly.

name: scroll of shadowform
description: This parchment is inscribed with runes of magic, but exactly what is written can only be learned by reading it.

name: scroll of ice storm
description: This parchment is inscribed with runes of magic, but exactly what is written can only be learned by reading it.

name: scroll of chaos storm
description: This bark parchment has swirling runes burned onto it, detailing the rituals and methods of learning this spell.

name: multicoloured sash
description: This is a six-foot-long, rainbow-coloured silken sash, worn about the waist. Its brilliant patterns are the result of a cunning dye process. Sewn into the edges are runes of a mithril thread so thin that it is almost invisible.

name: iron tube
description: This is a strange contraption indeed. It consists of a wooden handle, which is attached to an iron sphere, which in turn is affixed to the end of a two-foot-long iron tube. A metal stud is affixed to the top of the sphere, and small objects can be heard rattling about inside.

name: silver disk
description: This small flat silver plate is around 5 inches in diameter. It is quite tarnished and worn with age, but you can make out the following inscription: Speak the answer, and you may pass.

name: shattered skeleton
description: This poor adventurer appears to have missed a handhold and fallen to his death. Chunks of rock and dirt cover its body and as you look closer, you notice a large silver disk behind the rubble.

name: crystal ball
description: As you gaze into the crystal ball, a swirly mist dissolves and you witness what appears to be a a miraculous underground city. Upon closer inspection, you notice that all of its inhabitants are dwarves!

name: silver pedestal
description: This intricately-designed pedestal was most likely magically crafted out of pure silver. It breaks out into a three- pronged clasp at the top where it holds the crystal ball. On closer inspection, you discover that you might be able to to turn the crystal ball in some manner.

name: lava-rock
description: This sheet of what appears to be cooled lava is rough and textured with several small rocks inbedded within its surface. Looking closely, you discover a large opal stone that appears to be moveable.

name: glowing ruby
description: This is a perfect, head-sized star ruby, the likes of which you have never seen before. You cannot even begin to imagine its worth. It glows with a pulsing inner light, seeming to throb in time with your heartbeat. It alone is cool within this searing heat, and it seems to beckon to you, its shimmering glow a call for your touch.

name: sabre of inquisition
description: This fine blade appears to have been manufactured from some type of glass or crystal and then hardened using some chemical mixture. It looks to be very sharp and has a mithril hilt with a crimson flame etched on its pommel. Something catches your eye and you see in very tiny letters the words
written in flowing script.

name: small sign
description: Say you want to 'buy healing' to have your damage healed.

name: sabre
description: This finely-balanced weapon has an extremely sharp blade, measuring two and a half feet long, and slightly curved. It is fairly heavy for its length, but is balanced so well that this makes no difference speedwise.

name: starcharts
description: Several star charts lay tossed around this room. Among them you see several depicting mythological beasts, and a few with an unreadable script written underneath. You come to the conclusion that they are for summoning purposes.

name: thin grey tome
description: This simple grey tome seems to sparkle with an interesting light, causing your eyes to be drawn to it immediately. On the cover, the book is titled

name: silver spined tome
description: This plain grey tome is fixated with a silver spine, which is fashioned to resemble several wild roses. Glancing at the cover, you read the topic

name: flat black tome
description: This large black book appears to be almost fake, as it does not appear to have any pages. Upon closer inspection, you discover a switch.

name: rune-carved staff
description: This four-foot-long oaken staff is etched, rather crudely, with several tribal sigils and pictograms of some unknown culture. Several of the pictograms depict a figure holding a staff in battle against a large ape-like beast, under which is a strange, unknown script.

name: glass key
description: This two-pronged glass key emits a faint magical aura.

name: silvery plate corselet
description: This light corselet is fashioned from an extremely stong, glittering metal. It is elaborately engraved with swirling designs, highlighted in gold. The crest of the town of Silvermere is emblazoned on its chest, proudly displayed in gold and jewels.

name: silvery crested shield
description: This large, curved shield is crafted from a fine, silvery metal, and glitters brightly. Emblazoned on its smooth face is the proud symbol of the town of Silvermere.

name: fine silvery broadsword
description: This is an extremely well-crafted blade of a strong, brilliantly shining metal. It appears to be razor-sharp, and is surprisingly light for its size. Its wide blade is engraved with sinuous runes up half its length. The straight hilt and crossguards are inset with gold and small jewels.

name: decapitated head
description: The bloody head of some poor bastard stares outward with a dead gaze. It could be any simple commoner that met this horrid end. Blood is clotted and dried all over the neck where it was chopped from its body with some grisly weapon.

name: altar
description: This large, bloodstained altar has wide blood gutters leading down to a hollow at one end. In this hollow, a black, fist-sized gem is set. Presumably blood and the gem are used for some sadistic ritual -- it is clear that sacrifices made on this stone slab would bathe the black stone in blood.

name: huge darkwood tree
description: This massive, twisted darkwood tree is so huge it is wider than a house. Its thick branches droop down heavily, laden with deep green leaves. It is covered in a variety of odd-looking knots.

name: pipe
description: This filthy, slimy pipe reeks with a disgusting scent. Partially concealed just inside, however, is a two-way switch!

name: eye socket
description: This is a dark eye socket in the face of the carved skull. Hidden inside is a large stone button!

name: songsheet of draining
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Draining.

name: songsheet of silence
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Silence.

name: songsheet of lethargy
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Lethargy.

name: songsheet of dazzling
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Dazzling.

name: songsheet of quickness
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Quickness.

name: songsheet of pain
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Pain.

name: songsheet of stunning
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Stunning.

name: songsheet of shockwave
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Shockwave.

name: songsheet of heroism
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Heroism.

name: songsheet of sonic blast
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Sonic Blast.

name: songsheet of evasion
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Evasion.

name: obsidian claymore
description: A massive one-handed sword, it has been crafted from the stone of obsidian. Waves of fire erupt from the blood red symbols that run up the blade. The hilt is entwined with a strange black fabric that allows you to handle it. It hisses as it moves through the air, leaving a trail of flame.

name: scroll of solid fog
description: This parchment is inscribed with runes of magic, but exactly what is written can only be learned by reading it.

name: scroll of wind of haste
description: This parchment is inscribed with runes of magic, but exactly what is written can only be learned by reading it.

name: scroll of mana storm
description: This parchment is inscribed with runes of magic, but exactly what is written can only be learned by reading it.

name: scroll of corrosion
description: This parchment is inscribed with runes of magic, but exactly what is written can only be learned by reading it.

name: scroll of meteor swarm
description: This parchment is inscribed with runes of magic, but exactly what is written can only be learned by reading it.

name: scroll of mystic mist
description: This parchment is inscribed with runes of magic, but exactly what is written can only be learned by reading it.

name: scroll of spirit horde
description: This parchment is inscribed with runes of magic, but exactly what is written can only be learned by reading it.

name: scroll of dragonfire
