description: This parchment is inscribed with runes of magic, but exactly what is written can only be learned by reading it.

name: scroll of stoneskin
description: This bark parchment has swirling runes burned onto it, detailing the rituals and methods of learning this spell.

name: scroll of blaze
description: This bark parchment has swirling runes burned onto it, detailing the rituals and methods of learning this spell.

name: scroll of creeping doom
description: This bark parchment has swirling runes burned onto it, detailing the rituals and methods of learning this spell.

name: scroll of maelstrom
description: This bark parchment has swirling runes burned onto it, detailing the rituals and methods of learning this spell.

name: scroll of plasma bolt
description: This bark parchment has swirling runes burned onto it, detailing the rituals and methods of learning this spell.

name: scroll of plague
description: This bark parchment has swirling runes burned onto it, detailing the rituals and methods of learning this spell.

name: scroll of earthquake
description: This bark parchment has swirling runes burned onto it, detailing the rituals and methods of learning this spell.

name: scroll of earthfist
description: This bark parchment has swirling runes burned onto it, detailing the rituals and methods of learning this spell.

name: ninja battle armour
description: This cunningly-crafted suit of armour is made from bamboo and a strange, thin black leather. It is very light yet strong, and provides ample freedom of movement with a maximum of protection.

name: poisoned shuriken
description: This small steel disk has four razor-sharp blades protruding from its edge. A dull black substance has been smeared on the points.

name: smoke bomb
description: This small, paper-wrapped package smells slightly of powder and chemicals.

name: demon's skull mask
description: This mask is the skull of something hideous. Spikey protrusions rim the eye sockets, adding to the thing's demonic visage. The mouth is frozen into a hideously evil grin, and its hollow black eye sockets appear to have a reddish glow. You get a strong feeling of fear just looking at the thing and have second thoughts about putting it on.

name: grey leather-bound tome
description: This huge, heavy tome is covered with swirling silvery runes and symbols. Inside, yellowed parchment pages are inscribed with spidery black letters.

name: charred scroll
description: This paper has been burned heavily and looks as though it could turn to ash at any moment. Written carefully upon the paper are fiery runes of power that dance and sway in a druidic dance, revealing the translation of a spell.

name: serrated battle axe
description: This is a large double-bladed axe, used in one hand. Its huge, serrated blades are razor-sharp, and jagged runes have been cut into its haft.

name: rusty iron key
description: This large, heavy key is covered in a layer of thick brown rust. Engraved in its handle appears to be two words in the old script, reading

name: crowbar
description: This is a two-foot long length of iron, with a point on one end and a hammer-like claw at the other. It is mainly used for prying things open or for breaking chains, though it can be used as a weapon in a pinch.

name: rusted gate
description: This tall, rusting ironwork gate must once have been a fine work of art, as its intricate spirals and curves show. Now, however, it is bent and cannot even fulfill its use as a gate, for the rust has fused it to the fence. Thick creeping weeds once entwined through its bars, but have since been cut and thrown to the side.

name: rusty fence
description: This high ironwork fence is topped by rusty, though still sharp, spearpoints. Its once-intricate craftmanship is now marred by the thick brown rust coating its surface and its bent bars. Creeping weeds entwined between its bars completely block your view past the fence.

name: chained door
description: This large wooden door is locked by a heavy iron chain, bolted to iron loops affixed to the warehouse's walls. Though on the surface the chains look unbreakable, they are in fact old and somewhat rusted, and with some work and the right tools they could be broken.

name: western wall
description: This wall is extremely clean compared to the rest of the sewer -- in other words, it is not outright filthy. A thin layer of slime and mould covers its surface, as well as an abnormal number of small black holes.

name: small black holes
description: Looking into some of the small black holes, you discover a smooth metal stud lurking within one of them!

name: smooth metal stud
description: This is a small metallic button, and it appears to be well- used. It moves slightly at your touch.

name: wooden table
description: This is a rather ordinary-looking wooden table, made to last. Its thick face and legs are heavily nicked and cut with use.

name: chair
description: This is a plain wooden chair, its little ornamental carving smoothed away by much use. Its seat is likewise smoothed, and its legs and back are nicked from being pushed into things.

name: stove
description: This fat black wood-burning stove is covered in grease and soot, and appears to be heavily used. It stinks of burnt flesh and fat.

name: fireplace
description: This large stone fireplace is covered in soot, and holds a bubbling cauldron full of a rank-smelling stew. The fire is burning some of the evil-looking weeds taken from the garden outside, and they give off a greasy black smoke that makes you gag.

name: ancient door
description: This huge ancient door is elegantly decorated with delicate scrollwork and stylized vines. It appears to have weathered the years quite well, and is nearly as strong as it was when it was new. A square lock gapes from its right side, though the key to this door must be long lost.

name: hills
description: These hills are made of a light grey rock, almost the colour of powdered bone, and are run through with veins of a deep metallic red. Their faces are sheer, sharp, and unscalable, and rumour tells that the red veins are actually rivulets of blood from adventurers who have tried to scale their heights.

name: road
description: This is a poorly-maintained gravel road, covered with dirt and debris. Black weeds occasionally poke through its surface. It is hard to tell whether the road is frequented by a few people, or traveled infrequently by many, as the tracks are obscured by those of what you presume to be animals.

name: avalanche of jagged rubble
description: This massive pile of collapsed stone appears to be completely impassable, as the stones are both too large and too sharp to handle. However, several man-sized holes can be seen leading inside the rubble, and although it would be dangerous, a few of them may be passable.

name: displacer beast tentacle
description: This is the jet-black severed tentacle of a displacer beast. A mass of bony spikes protrude from the end, and it looks as though it would make an effective weapon.

name: manticore tail
description: This huge, heavy tail is tipped with a heavy bone ball covered in long spikes. The spines are iron-hard and sharp as razors, and make this tail a deadly weapon, although its extreme weight doesn't allow much in the way of speed.

name: longbow
description: This slender, curved bow is made out of a long branch of supple wood. It is tightly strung, and has a fair amount of stopping power. Its pull is a little heavy, but it makes for a good, accurate weapon. It comes with a quiver full of black-feathered arrows.

name: composite bow
description: This long, fabulously-crafted bow is made of horn and light wood, and is pulled taut by a gut string. The strength and range of this bow are nearly unmatched.

name: black serpent key
description: This glossy, sinuous key depicts the form of a serpent with red, glinting eyes. The teeth of the key are oddly curved as well, and any lock this key fits must be of a completely different construction than any ordinary lock you've seen.

name: piece of black chitin
description: This is a large, mostly undamaged piece of a violet-black chitin. It is flexible, able to be bent fairly easily, but is also extremely strong and hard to puncture.

name: path
description: This is a narrow gravel path, threading its way through the confusing labyrinth of hills known as the Dragon's Teeth. It is somewhat difficult to keep one's bearing, as all the hills look nearly the same, and the sheer rocky faces are too tall and jagged to climb for a good look at the surroundings.

name: two-headed morningstar
description: This heavy weapon consists of a leather-bound oak rod about two feet in length, attached to a pair of ball-tipped chains. The metal balls are covered in blunt protrusions to cause more damage. A golden tassle hanging off the pommel is its only ornamentation.

name: gnarled wand
description: This foot-long wand seems to be made out of a blackened oak, its length filled with twisting convolutions. Carved in the side of the wand in a crude, jagged script is the word

name: large canvas tent
description: This is a simple, but effective, heavy cloth tent. It is quite big, having room for about a dozen well-sized people, and seems to be populated by at least that many, if the sprawled bedrolls and miscellaneous debris are anything to go by.

name: massive canvas tent
description: This huge tent appears to be of relatively good make, and is supported in the middle by a heavy wooden pole. Apparently it only houses one being, as there is only one bed, the rest of the room being filled with odd knicknacks, large skulls hung on the walls, and an impressive collection of dull shoddy weapons.

name: bonfire
description: This huge, crackling bonfire shimmers and spits, its black smoke rising up into the sky. A thick hunk of meat, held by an iron spit, roasts over the flame, filling the air with its aroma.

name: walls
description: The walls of these tunnels are made of a light grey stone, run through with metallic veins the colour of blood. They are deeply gouged in places, though what could tear stone with such ease remains to be seen.

name: hole
description: The black hole in the ceiling here is too high to reach, and appears to lead upwards at a steep slant.

name: hole
description: This four-foot-wide hole appears to have been roughly carved out with some extremely-sharp digging instrument... or perhaps, claws.

name: small hole
description: This dark hole is about four feet across, and appears to lead down into the depths of the hill.

name: green bubbling pool
description: This wide, bubbling pool smells light and sweet, like the scent of flowers on a breeze. It is illuminated by a soothing green glow that comes from within. The shore of the pool does not seem treacherous, and it would be easy to drin straight from the pool, or to fill up a container with its liquid.

name: crystal flask
description: This crystal bottle is quite well crafted, and would hold a few mouthfuls of liquid.

name: glowing crystal flask
description: This small crystal bottle is filled with some sort of slowly bubbling green liquid.

name: flaming scimitar
description: This metal of alien origin projects an intense, magical flame. The curved blade sprouts from an obsidian hilt, which is strangely cool to touch. A single ruby set in the pommel

name: silvery longbow
description: This beautifully-made longbow appears to be made of glimmering Silverwood, a sure sign of Elven origin. It has elegant, sinuous runes carved into its length, and although it is tightly strung, it is remarkably easy to draw. A silver-laced quiver of white leather is full of black- feathered arrows, their points sharp as razors.

name: golden snake earrings
description: This pair of small golden earrings is crafted in the shape of sinuous serpents biting their own tails, thus forming hoops. Their eyes glitter with tiny emeralds, and the scales seem to have been carefully crafted one by one.

name: curved black dagger
description: This large, thin-bladed dagger is extraordinarily heavy for its size, and is nearly as long as a shortsword. Its blade is heavily carved with softly glowing red runes, and there is a decidedly evil aura surrounding it.

name: pile of digested bodies
description: This is probably the most disgusting sight you have ever seen. A dozen or so bodies have been partially eaten away by the milky-white fluid which covers them, and pale white eggs embedded in their flesh lay broken and oozing. It is impossible to distinguish what race each body is, as they have been mutilated beyond recognition.

name: partially digested body
description: This is the body of a creature of unknown race, its skin melted away, a milky fluid covering it. Its flesh is embedded with pale, oval-shaped eggs the colour of maggots, though they have all been broken and ooze liquid. It is impossible to determine who, or what, the body once was.

name: violet organic walls
description: These strange-looking walls are made of a hard, sticky, violet substance that smells faintly sweet. They are formed in organic patterns, with swirling rounded designs. Although they are interesting to look at, they are also extremely alien, and somewhat disturbing.

name: partially concealed hole
description: This large hole is somewhat hidden by a number of tentacle- like organs forming a crude door. The pulse and move as you watch them. The hole is easily wide enough to allow entry.

name: black mountains
description: The stone of these mountains is coal black and as sharp as flint. It is shot through with thin metallic red veins, which reflect the light with crimson sparkles. This mountain range is known to be practically unscalable, and is nearly devoid of plant life. Very few creatures can survive in such harshness, and those that do are deadly.

name: crevice trail
description: This is a narrow rocky trail passing along the bottom of a natural crevice in the mountain. Occasionally there is a small, but unfathomably deep crack to leap over, and often the trail is nearly blocked by fallen rocks and rubble. There is evidence of tracks of some sort, though the rocky terrain makes them unidentifiable.

name: thick brown vines
description: These heavy, almost-leathery vines vary in thickness from one inch to almost four. They appear quite strong, and could possibly bear the weight of someone climbing upon them.

name: filthy nests
description: These nests are extremely disgusting and dirty, being filled with rotting meat, debris, and various worthless odds and ends. Bits of bone and leather are scattered about, as well as broken pieces of weapons and armour.

name: severed head of Markus
description: This is the gruesome, bloody head of Commander Markus of the Western Garrison. His once-proud eyes are now glazed and lifeless, and his once-dark skin is now pale and clammy. His swollen tongue lolls grotesquely out of his mouth.

name: locked wooden box
description: This small, heavy, rectangular box appears to be made of polished darkwood. Its corners are capped with shining iron, and it has a heavy lock on it.

name: crossbow
description: This powerful weapon is comprised of a small, but extremely powerful, metal bow affixed to a two-foot-long wooden stock. The bow is extremely difficult to cock, making this a slow weapon, but its steel-tipped bolts can pierce through armour with ease. It comes with a quiver full of short, sharp bolts.

name: heavy crossbow
description: This is a more powerful version of the standard crossbow. Its bow is very tightly strung, and requires much strength to re-cock, making it very slow to fire. Nonetheless, it is extremely accurate, and armour is nearly useless against its heavy bolts. It comes with a quiver full of the small, weighty, steel-tipped bolts it requires.

name: sling
description: This is a simple leather thong, with a pouch affixed to its middle. To use, a stone is placed within the pouch, then the sling is whirled about at great speeds. When one end of the sling is released, the stone flies at the target. It comes with a pouch full of smooth, round stones.

name: staff-sling
description: This weapon looks like a shortish wooden staff, with a leather sling affixed to the end. It is able to throw stones faster and further than a normal sling, but it is slower to use and it requires two hands. It comes with a pouch full of stones.

name: grey rolled parchment
description: This thin piece of parchment is covered in spidery letters. After scanning the document, you discover it is instructions on the learning and casting of a spell named Frenzy!

name: tattered scroll
description: This long, ripped scroll is covered by row upon row of thin, evenly-spaced handwriting, describing the methods of learning and casting a spell named Mass Frenzy! This spell duplicates the effects of the Frenzy spell, but is cast upon oneself and one's allies.

name: holy writ
description: This thin manual describes the ways of properly praying to one's deity in order to be filled with righteous power! This Righteousness gives the target an increase in combat power, coupled with a small healing of one's wounds over time.

name: skin-covered book
description: In this unholy manual, you uncover the evil, secret techniques of the blood ritual! This Blood Ritual allows the recipient to be filled with a minute power of the Blood God, giving an increase in combat power along with a small amount of healing over time. This spell is powered by the pain and suffering of others, and is needless to say quite evil.

name: barkskin scroll
description: This thick, weathered bark scroll is inscribed with many passages written in a bold, flowing hand. Upon scanning its contents, you discover that it contains the secret methods of learning and casting the Regeneration spell! This powerful but short-lived spell rapidly heals the target's wounds.

name: double crossbow
description: This strange contraption appears to be a heavy crossbow with two bows, one on top of the stock, the other on the bottom! The bolts are held in an ingenious auto-reloading magazine, which must be reloaded every so often. Cocking both bows and reloading the magazine makes re-arming this weapon fairly slow, but the firing of it is quick as lightning.

name: rapier
description: This excellent weapon has a three-foot length of thin sharpened steel, designed for thrusting and lunging. It is marvellously balanced, and greatly improves defense as it is so quick to maneuver.

name: main-gauche
description: This off-handed dagger is designed for parrying, and is used in conjunction with another weapon such as a rapier. It is finely made from the best steel.

name: serpentine sword
description: This disturbing-looking weapon has a three-foot razor-sharp blade, wavy like the name suggests. Its black hilt is adorned with a single tiny emerald in the pommel.

name: serpentine dagger
description: This long, wavy-bladed dagger is nearly as big as a shortsword. Its edge is honed to be razor-sharp, and its black hilt is adorned with a single tiny emerald.

name: barbed whip
description: This long, heavy whip is made of thick leather strands intertwined with thin metal wires. Along the length of the whip are hooked metal barbs, and a large cluster of these is affixed to the tip of the whip.

name: black chitin helm
description: This exotic-looking helm is quite beautiful in an alien sort of way. It seems to be made of a deep violet-black insect carapace, and has been crafted to resemble the head of one of these insects, complete with antennae and glossy black eyes on the forehead of the helm. It is extraordinarily strong for its weight.

name: black chitin armour
description: This exotic-looking armour seems to be made out of glossy, violet-black plates of insect carapace. It has been crafted in such a way as to maximize protection given, and has been treated with some special formula and bonded with spider silk to increase strength. It is indeed incredibly hard and strong for its weight.

name: black chitin leggings
description: These exotic-looking leggings seem to have been made out of glossy, violet-black plates of insect chitin. They have been bonded together with spider silk and treated with a secret formula which makes them extremely hard and glossy.

name: black chitin shield
description: This exotic-looking shield seems to have been crafted from three large, interlocking plates of violet-black insect chitin. They have been bonded together with spider silk, and treated with a secret formula, rendering them extremely hard. The shield is very light for its size, and would provide excellent protection.

name: white gold ring
description: This elegantly-crafted band is made of three intertwined loops of the finest pale gold. Small diamonds set around its perimeter glitter brightly, and a prayer is engraved in small letters inside the band.

name: pewter door
description: These massive pewter doors are beautifully carved with all manner of wild beast, including a good many who obviously are not from this land. They must be enchanted as they open with ease, despite their obvious weight.

name: throne
description: This large, heavy throne is carved out of adamantite. Its two arms are made to look like serpents, with their tails stretching back and entwining intricately to form the back and seat. The serpent on the left is black, while the one on the right is white. Somehow you get an impression of great power emanating from it.

name: black and white serpent ring
description: This intricate ring is crafted out of coloured adamantite, and is made to look like two intertwined snakes, each biting the other's tail. Each tiny scale is picked out in perfect detail, and each small eye is a round, glittering grey crystal.

name: Magebane sword
description: This long, wickedly-sharp sword is crafted from the finest steel possible. It is named the Magebane for its edge, which is covered in many small serrated points. The combination of the sharpness and these tiny barbs cause painful, jagged wounds in the target, disrupting concentration (and thus spellcasting).

name: lockpicks
description: This small pouch is filled with all the necessary tools and picks to aid one in unlocking tricky doors.

name: thief's kit
description: This small box contains a full set of lockpicks, as well as other assorted tools that aid in not only picking locks, but also disarming traps.

name: pewter tankard
description: This is a heavy pewter tankard, dented from extreme use in bar brawls. Traces of vomit can be seen within.

name: dead cat
description: This is a stiff, stinking, dead cat. It once used to be a cute little fluffy creature, but now it's dead!

name: ruby-eyed skull ring
description: This shining black ring seems to be made out of an unknown dark, glittering metal, and is extremely cold to the touch. A tiny, perfect dark skull is affixed to it, its eyes burning with an unnatural red flame. The ring has a noticeable aura of evil surrounding it, as well as one of extreme suffering.

name: massive black doors
description: These huge, ominous doors are crafted from jet-black stone, and tower a good twenty feet above you. They are simple and unornamented, and their only significant feature is the smaller, locked entrance door providing a way through.

name: alleyway
description: This narrow, unlit alley is filled with trash and other unbecoming articles. It stinks heavily of rot and offal, and rats scurry away as you look.

name: street
description: This wide, flagstoned street is in a moderate state of disrepair. Trash is scattered haphazardly about the streets, and it is obvious that attention to cleanliness is not one of the priorities here. The tall, rickety buildings flanking the street have a decidedly seedy and unkempt look about them.

name: iron sign
description: A small iron plaque is riveted to the wall here, and it reads:

name: smoky black talisman
description: This small dark disk is hung upon a fine silver chain. Strange runes are inscribed upon its surface, which read:

name: severed head of Goru-Nezar
description: This large, heavy head once belonged to the ogre-mage lord, Goru-Nezar. Now its lifeless eyes stare out ominously, and its tongue lolls out grotesquely.

name: Dusk
description: A long spear fashioned from a glittering metal, it seems to have a black aura about it, but you sense no evil. Marked on the spear is a symbol of a full moon, fashioned in dark blue metal. Great power radiates from the weapon, and it seems to dim everything around you.

name: ebony kris
description: This wavy-bladed dagger is nearly the size of a shortsword, and is extremely sharp. Its blade is coated with a dripping black ichor, which steams and foams when it hits the ground.

name: twisted bone staff
description: This long, yellowed bone staff is twisted along its length and curls at the top like a goat's horn. Engraved upon its surface are runes of power.

name: small diamond
description: This tiny, glittering diamond has been well cut, and the light reflects from within beautifully.

name: log raft
description: This small floating platform is simply a number of small logs lashed together with rope. It is somewhat heavy and extremely cumbersome to carry.

name: wooden skiff
description: This somewhat shabbily-made boat is barely large enough for one person. Its pair of small oars are barely long enough to use and would give you splinters, but nonetheless it is waterworthy.

name: marsh light
description: This strangely-crafted lamp is made out of a slightly opaque glass. A pale, flickering green light dances within it, seeming to whisper odd and disturbing things. Around the lamp is a black iron frame, with a handle affixed to the top.

name: silver river
description: The Silver river is reknowned for its beauty, majesty, and mystery, as well as for its danger. Lurking beneath the glittering silvery surface, capricious and sometimes evil creatures wait for unsuspecting travelers. A perpetual cover of fine white mist muffles the sounds here and prevents seeing very far.

name: silvermere wall
description: The massive town wall of Silvermere once was used to keep out waves of invaders, and now serves a somewhat similar purpose -- warding off maligned creatures in the wild. There appears no place to land a boat along the base of the wall, as its sheer face descends right into the river.

name: dark forest
description: The forbidding forest north of Silvermere is an even more ominous cousin of the eastern Darkwood forest. Its trees are packed tightly together, as if suspiciously and consciously forming a wall to keep out intruders. A sense of ancient watchfulness pervades the air surrounding this oldest of woods, and there appears to be no place to land at its foot.

name: long bridge
description: This long, arching bridge spans the Silver river, connecting Silvermere to the fenced-in graveyard. It is of ancient make, and excellent quality -- although it appears overly slender for a bridge of its length, its strength is surprising. The river passes swiftly beneath it, and it is raised up high enough that it is not possible to climb up.

name: rocky waterfall
description: Here the Silver river cascades down a rocky face inside the cave, crashing down into a dark, frothing pool with a thundrous roar. Up the side of the waterfall, a crudely-hewn stair can be seen leading up into the darkness, presumably to the top of the waterfall.

name: dark brown walls of stone
description: These smoothed, naturally-carved walls are of a deep brown earthy stone, mixed with the occasional darker mineral vein. A pale green fungus or lichen covers many parts of the walls here, and gives off a faintly acrid odour.

name: pale green lichen
description: This tough, acrid-smelling lichen looks quite unappetizing. Bits of dirt and moisture can be seen trapped within it.

name: elevated rocky ledge
description: It is hard to tell whether or not this stone ledge is natural or has been crafted, as its shape appears normal but has an unnatural symmetry to it. A few small
lead up to it from the cavern floor, and end in front of the carved wall face.

name: carved wall face with design
description: This smooth stone wall has been carved with the image of a dancing demon, seemingly capering with glee. The carving is about two feet in height, and is well-detailed. Even the eyes, although they are stone, seem to glare at you evilly, such was the skill of the craftsman!

name: black cauldron
description: This massive black cauldron is large enough to hold an entire person, and from the looks of it, has indeed been used for such a purpose. Vile slime coats the inside of the cauldron, and it reeks of evilness.

name: skull wand
description: This thick-hafted wand is more like a rod, in that it is short, about two feet long, and thick as a pole. It is crafted from some dark, polished wood, and is tipped with a gleaming silver skull. Runes carved into the length of the wand glow with a dull, fiery red.

name: manastone
description: This is a cool blue stone of unknown origin, and it pulsates brightly and appears to have some great magical power held within its core. A chain of gold is attached to the stone for wearing around one's neck.

name: ancient statues
description: These huge, weatherbeaten statues must have been carved some thousands of years ago, judging from their unfamiliar style of workmanship and the degree of decay. They appear to be warrior-kings, each holding up a palm in greeting... or possibly warning. You think you can see a hint of sadness etched into the statues' ancient, scarred faces.

name: huge stone
description: This gigantic stone almost looks like a giant tortoise. It sits off to the north of the river, its rocky foundation forcing the river's path to the south.

name: huge fallen tree
description: This massive tree appears somewhat bent and twisted, and is scorched all down one side, presumably by lightning. It is stuck in some rocks in the centre of the river, and careful navigation is required to get around it.

name: silvery stream
description: This rapidly-flowing stream is an offshoot of the Silver River. It threads its way along the bottom of a wide crack in the Dragon's Teeth hills. The stony walls loom high above you, and occasionally a stone falls with a loud splash into the waters near you.

name: silvery pool
description: This large pool is fed from a small tributary of the Silver River. It must drain down into the earth somewhere, as the water does not rise despite the constant influx of water.

name: darkened ironwood forest
description: The trees of this forest are huge, towering skywards, their tops unseen far above. Their bark is of a strange dull metallic grey, the colour of iron. An aura of watchfulness pervades this area, and while it is not overtly hostile, you get the distinct impression you are not welcome here.

name: wavy-bladed dagger
description: This long dagger is practically a shortsword in length. Its wavy blade is a jet black, and its hilt is of polished black iron.

name: shillelagh
description: This gnarled wooden club is inlaid with brightly glittering gold. It emanates a strange magical aura.

name: huge tree
description: This massive ironwood tree could not be encircled by any less than thirty people with their arms outstretched. Its many branches would make it easy to climb up into, though to reach any heights would be tiring.

name: golden honeycomb
description: This large, delectable honeycomb drips with the glittering golden honey of the killer bees.

name: bushes
description: This strange hedge seems to have been cultivated by someone. Peering closer, an opening of some kind can be seen beneath it!

name: bright red plant
description: This strange, crimson plant has many long sinuous branches, and thick reddish roots which climb up the walls. Its five- pointed leaves are of a shining golden colour, and it evidently bears fruit as some are shriveled on the ground beside it.

name: small green fruit
description: These bite-sized fruits are a pale green in colour, and are banded with black stripes. They have a faintly sweet smell.

name: huge broken willow
description: This massive, ruined willow tree stands by the water. A wide crack in its side appears to lead within it!

name: woodland robes
description: These forest-green robes are adorned with black and grey stitching, depicting several different woodland creatures. The robes are of a fine, almost silky fabric, and feel warm to the touch. A palpable aura of power emanates from them.

name: pearl ring
description: This elaborately-carved platinum ring is set with a huge opalescent pearl. The band is made to resemble intertwined vines, with small leaves forming the clasps which hold the pearl.

name: bronzewood forest
description: The trees of this forest are quite large, towering far above you, but not quite as tall as the ironwood trees. Their skin is a dull, nonreflective bronze colour, and their leaves are of a glossy black. They are straighter and their bark is smoother than the other trees in this forest, and their branches are longer and carry more leaves.

name: unicorn horn
description: This three-foot-long horn is one of the most beautiful objects you have ever seen. Its spiraling length is a shining pearly white, and its tip is razor-sharp. Since the only way to obtain a unicorn horn is to kill one and take it, these horns are shunned with disgust by the good- hearted.

name: copperwood forest
description: The trees of this forest are not as tall as the ironwood trees, but they still tower far above you. Their bark is an almost-glossy copper colour, and their leaves are shiny and brown.

name: large tree
description: This massive copperwood tree could not be encircled by any less than twenty people with their arms outstretched. Its many branches would make it easy to climb up into, though to reach any heights would be tiring.

name: handful of brown nuts
description: These small nuts are round and hard, and smell quite appetizing. They have tiny black speckles around their width.

name: strange mushrooms
description: These odd-looking mushrooms seem to have been coated with a glittering dust of some sort.

name: witchwood breastplate
description: This odd breastplate is crafted out of a magical, living wood. It is engraved with sorcerous runes which shift and change as you watch. The breastplate is slightly warm to the touch, as the wood's life force is magically kept alive to strengthen the armour.

name: silverwood plate corselet
description: This is a corselet of enchanted silverwood, inlaid with precious gems and gold. It is strong as steel, but is nonetheless quite light. A gift surely fit for a king.

name: silverwood forest
description: The trees of this forest are tall, with golden leaves and smooth silvery bark. They are slender but very strong, with long, high limbs.

name: rope bridge
description: This slender rope bridge is made of plaited elven rope, and is much stronger than it looks.

name: elven waybread
description: This delicious-smelling cake is wrapped in the golden leaves of the silverwood tree. Light, tasty and filling, they make ideal rations for adventurers.

name: massive wooden club
description: This huge wooden club is over six feet in length. Wieldable by only the strongest fighters, this weapon is not an elegant weapon in combat, but it deals massive damage.

name: spiked gauntlets
description: These heavy steel gauntlets have spikes protruding from the knuckles and the back of the hand. Their palms are of thick leather so that they will provide better grip.

name: ancient stone wall
description: This ancient stone wall towers about a hundred feet over you. It is made of huge dark blue blocks, their surfaces barely marred by the passage of time.

name: demolished doors
description: These huge steel-banded wood doors have been blasted asunder by some fiery magic. The scorch marks appear quite fresh, and it is probable that they have been made only recently.

name: white fang
description: This is a four-inch-long fang, bone-white, and somewhat cold to the touch.

name: black fang
description: This is a four-inch-long fang, black as pitch and very sharp. It irritates your skin to touch it.

name: green fang
description: This is a four-inch-long fang, coloured deep green. Holding it in your hand makes you feel somewhat sick.

name: blue fang
description: This is a four-inch-long fang, azure blue and quite sharp. The hair on your hand stands straight out when you hold it.

name: red fang
description: This is a four-inch-long fang, red as blood, and somewhat warm to the touch.

name: dragonclaw staff
description: This four-foot-long staff is crafted from pure adamantite. Its slender shaft has been generously engraved with symbols of power. Upon one end a small dragon's claw has been affixed, an orb of polished sapphire in its grasp. Deep within the orb, blue flashes spark occasionally.

name: silverwood staff
description: This elegant staff is a living branch of the silverwood trees, long and slender and warm with life. Starting halfway up the shaft and continuing to its end, stars of all shape and size have been carved into the wood and have been coloured gold, with no apparent damage to the living wood. The silverwood staff radiates a palpable magical aura.

name: spiked plate corselet
description: This is a massive steel plate corselet, studded with wicked spikes all over its surface. Although it is extremely heavy, it is also exceedingly strong.

name: crumbling bible
description: This ancient religious tome has lost all of its pages, save one which is in perfect condition. Upon this last page is the holy incantation necessary to learn a spell to restore flesh that has been transformed to stone by unnatural means.

name: blades of balance
description: These twin swords are exquisitely balanced and honed to a razor-sharp edge. One is pure white, and engraved with flowing, sinuous runes, the other is jet black and etched with angular symbols. They cannot be wielded separately, and in conjunction make excellent weapons.

name: chrome key
description: This small, shining key is made of brilliantly-reflective metal. Etched into the end is a small, lidded eye.

name: demonhide bracers
description: These deep red bracers are crafted out of the black-spined skin of a demon. They are tough and form-fitting. On the inside wrist of each bracer, a glowing blue symbol of the Kai Lords is emblazoned.

name: mithril helm
description: This gorgeous full-helm has been crafted to look like the head of a dwarven king. Atop it a golden crown has been affixed, and the faceplate is crafted in the likeness of a stern dwarf-face. The helm glimmers slightly and is completely unscratched.

name: holy avenger
description: This long, straight blade is crafted from adamantite, and polished to a silvery sheen. Its cross-hilt is wrapped with golden cord. Engraved up and down the blade's length are holy inscriptions, and an aura of power protects the wielder from evil foes, making him more difficult to hit.

name: icehammer
description: This massive sledgehammer seems to be made out of solid, glittering blue ice. It radiates an aura of intense cold, but despite this it can be handled without harm.

name: shattered skeleton
description: This broken, chewed carcass has evidently been here a long time, judging by the dirt encrusting its bones. At second glance, one of the bones seems to be free of blood and dirt, and sticks out of the ground rather than out of the skeleton.

name: black silk robes
description: These fine robes are woven out of a glossy black silk. They are embroidered with black thread, and are surprisingly tough. At second glance intricate symbols can be seen stitched all over their surface.

name: black silk pants
description: These fine pants are woven out of a glossy black silk. They are embroidered with black thread, and are surprisingly tough. At second glance intricate symbols can be seen stitched all over their surface.

name: black silk slippers
description: These fine slippers are woven out of a glossy black silk. They are embroidered with black thread, and are surprisingly tough. At second glance intricate symbols can be seen stitched all over their surface.

name: black silk gloves
description: These fine gloves are woven out of a glossy black silk. They are embroidered with black thread, and are surprisingly tough. At second glance intricate symbols can be seen stitched all over their surface.

name: contraption
description: This is a heavy metal plate, about six inches thick and ten by ten feet square. It is affixed to the wall here by some unknown means. Covering its surface are many levers and switches, buttons and knobs of all descriptions and sizes. What the odd contraption could be for is anyone's guess.

name: dragon key
description: This odd key has a head shaped like the visage of a toothily grinning dragon. The barrel and teeth of the key are of a black metal, and set in the barrel are five tiny stones, one each of blue, red, green, black and white.

name: white dragon carving
description: This three-foot-diameter white marble carving features a roaring dragon's head, encircled by icicles. Five odd curved slots ring the carving, one of which is filled by a white fang.

name: black dragon carving
description: This three-foot-diameter obsidian carving features a roaring dragon's head, encircled by fuming droplets. Five odd curved slots ring the carving, two of which are filled by white and black fangs.

name: green dragon carving
description: This three-foot-diameter green jade carving features a roaring dragon's head, encircled by wispy fumes. Five odd slots ring the carving, three of which are filled with white, black and green fangs.

name: blue dragon carving
description: This three-foot-diameter lapis carving features a roaring dragon's head, encircled by crackling lightning. Five odd slots ring the carving, all but one of which are filled with white, black, green and blue fangs.

name: dragon carving
description: This three-foot-diameter granite carving features a roaring dragon's head, encircled by double lines. Five odd curved slots ring the carving.

name: blood lance
description: This seven-foot-long lance is coloured blood red, and is wickedly barbed. Unholy symbols etched up and down its length give off a smoky yellow light.

name: black tome
description: This huge, heavy tome is covered with swirling silvery runes and symbols. Inside, yellowed parchment pages are inscribed with two spells: Chaos Shield, which concentrates chaotic power around the target in a crackling field, and Mana Flux, which draws energy from the surrounding area to regenerate mana. Both spells sometimes have undesired effects.

name: forgotten scroll
description: Detailed upon this ancient, rotting leather parchment is a form of divine incantation. It provides the chants required to draw power from the forgotten gods, allowing you to sacrifice your health to benefit another.

name: iceforge anvil
description: This huge black-iron anvil seems to have been made for a giant, as it is six feet up to its flat hammering surface! A thick coating of ice surrounds the anvil, and waves of cold emanate from it. Upon close scrutiny, glowing blue runes can be seen etched into its surface. Ancient rumours have told of enchanted anvils being used to craft magical armaments.

name: frozen hydra
description: This huge, seven-headed beast is covered in a three-foot- thick prison of ice, its snarling visage forever frozen. It appears heavily armoured and armed, its teeth being long and swordlike, its necks long and agile. Gripped in one of its mouths is a large, glittering icy hammer, maul-sized for someone of human stature.

name: frozen giant
description: This thirty-foot-tall giant is encased in a living tomb of ice three feet thick. His massively-muscled arms are frozen reaching out as if grasping at something, and his face is fixed in an outraged frown.

name: ancient tome
description: This large, heavy tome lays open, a thin, red silk bookmark nestled between its pages. The ancient, yellow pages are covered in a thin, spidery text which reads:

name: small book
description: This ancient book's pages have all crumbled to dust, but its lacquered covers have not. There is writing on the inside cover, as well as a small illustration, and though they are faded and hard to make out, they read as follows:

name: painting
description: This large painting is set in a plain wooden frame. It is covered with a thick layer of dust, and is somewhat worse for wear. However, this couldn't possibly make the woman in the painting less attractive, as she is possibly the ugliest woman you have ever seen. A face only a son could love, and that must have been the case, as at the bottom is

name: stone mouth
description: As you gaze at the mouth, the lips begin to move, whispering a ghostly rhyme which goes like this:

name: plaque on gate
description: This ornate iron gate is tall and spike-topped, and would easily prevent entry by scaling. Its thick bars make any thought of bashing it down immediately flee your head. A beautiful platinum plaque set in the gate sports seven glittering stones -- ruby, emerald, diamond, amethyst, sapphire, onyx and topaz -- and looks somewhat like this:

name: palace key
description: This intricate golden key is engraved with the name of King Yeshuz.

name: elf-head
description: This bloody head once belonged to a forest-loving wood-elf. Now its blue tongue lolls grotesquely, its sightless eyes staring out blankly in death.

name: head of the woodelf lord
description: Even in death, the elf-lord seems to have an air of serenity about him. Too bad he's worm food now.

name: eye of the beholder
description: This large globular eye radiates anti-magic intensely. It is somewhat heavy, and gives you the creeps as it stares lifelessly at you.

name: nexus spear
description: This long, slender spear is crafted out of a glittering silvery metal. Blue sparkles of energy crackle forth periodically, leaving the smell of ozone in the air. It radiates an aura of intense power, and is lethal in the hands of a skilled fighter.

name: staff of the elements
description: This strange staff is made of four intertwined metallic rods, one blue, one green, one red and one silver. It crackles with arcane energy, as the powers from all four elements meet, fuse and conflict.

name: adamantite spear
description: This long, heavy spear is crafted from one of the hardest and heaviest metals known -- adamantite. Its dark surface almost seems to absorb light, and its head is razor-sharp and glimmers in the light.

name: gleaming contraption
description: This large, box-like object gleams like polished silver, greatly in contrast to the surrounding junk. There is a wide opening in the front, the High Guild of Magery's seal on one side, and a plaque covered with instructions on the other.

name: plaque
description: This rectangular plaque is inscribed with the following:

name: mining helm
description: This is a large metal hat with a hollow at the top for placing a candle or other light source. Currently a glowing stone has been placed there, naturally glowing with a phosphorescent tinge. It can offer decent protection for the head as well as decent light for underground tunnels.

name: nexus chakram
description: This exotic weapon is a razor-sharp circle of gleaming steel, which, when thrown, magically returns to its wielder. The blade is three inches wide, with the weapon being one foot in diameter. Strange runes inscribed upon its surface glow fiercely.

name: whirling vortex
description: Brilliant colours swirl about in midair here, as some sort of extra-planar rift breaks the air. Energy crackles all about this arcane portal... Who knows where it might lead?

name: shining metallic robes
description: These heavy garments are made from some seamless, glittering silvery fabric, which is smooth as silk. A strange energy courses though the robes, which crackle with sparkling motes whenever their shining folds are shifted.

name: obsidian obelisk
description: This tall, pointed obelisk is night-black and as smooth as glass. Intricate runes carved into its surface emanate a strange aura of power.

name: pipe
description: This thick, silvery pipe glistens with cool condensation. Seams in the metalwork are sealed tightly with rivets, and fresh water drips down periodically. Judging from the workmanship, it is likely the handiwork of gnomes.

name: rubble
description: Searching through the rubble, you find a stone tile set into the floor.

name: boulder
description: This large boulder is somewhat suspiciously round, and looks to have been carved out of the walls of the tunnel.

name: gate key
description: This simple key is fashioned of a strange black metal. Impossibly tiny teeth line both sides of it, suggesting an incredibly-complex locking mechanism. For some reason, you get a sick feeling in the pit of your stomach and want to dispose of the key quickly.

name: bloodstone orb
description: This small, heavy stone orb is swirled with green and red, and feels slightly warm to the touch. A single glowing rune in the side pulsates with hidden power.

name: glowing key
description: This small key is slightly translucent, and has no teeth or lock interface whatsoever. Circular runes are carved around the small head, and the key glows from within with a pale blue light.

name: adamantite key
description: This large key is crafted from the dusky grey metal known as adamantite. It is indestructible and quite heavy for its size. Stamped into the head of the key is a bold royal insignia.

name: dark blue orb
description: This is a small, royal-blue sphere, roughly one foot in diameter. It glows and pulses with an inner light, practically oozing with dark power.

name: opal brooch
description: This intricate brooch is heavily encrusted with small opals arranged into the official royal insignia of the monarchy. It is a sign of very high rank or achievement.

name: shelf and jars
description: This large shelf is covered in dirt and dust, and many tiny disgusting creatures crawl about it in squalor. Partially concealed behind the row of jars is a crude stone button recessed into the wall!

name: golden key
description: This small, heavy key is made of pure reddish gold. Its smooth surface is unadorned, but seems to radiate a strange force that makes your hair stand on end.

name: wooden desk
description: This old wooden desk looks like it has been severly abused, its surface being cut and worn. All its drawers are missing, but this is fortunate, as it allows you to see a hidden iron switch lurking deep within!

name: amber talisman
description: This small, circular disc is engraved with a curving sigil of peculiar design.

name: huge keg
description: This massive wooden barrel is nearly large enough to stand in without stooping. An ornate silver tap is set securely in the centre of the front of the keg, and glimmers in the light.

name: greasy leather bracelet
description: This heavy, thick bracelet is filthy and looks well-used. A single strange rune has been burned into one side of it. Upon closer inspection, you notice that the leather is in fact the skin of a human!

name: mutilated corpses
description: Many disemboweled bodies have been hung by meathooks here to allow easy access by whatever filthy beast consumes them. The stench here is incredible, making you gag and forcing you back.

name: giant apparatus
description: This massive steel and glass device appears to process a fluid which flows into it from a huge wooden vat. Noxious clouds of yellow fumes puff out occasionally, filling the air with a deadly reek.

name: moldy key
description: This large, heavy iron key is covered with a thin layer of mold and fungus. It appears to be quite old and abused.

name: rune-etched sceptre
description: This golden sceptre is about three and a half feet long, and is decorated from head to handle in glowing runes. Jeweled studs ring the head and seem to shine with a life all their own. Easily swung with one hand, the sceptre seems magically guided to where you want it to strike.

name: adamantite katana
description: This four-foot-long sword is one of the finest examples of craftmanship you have ever seen. Made from the powerful, but heavy metal, adamantite, it is a weapon to strike terror into a foe. Perfectly balanced and sharper than a razor, in a master's hands it is a whirling blade of death.

name: jeweled adamantite longsword
description: This is a cobalt blue longsword, forged of the finest adamantite. Its hilt is lined with deep crimson rubies that are carved with intricate runes and shimmer with magical luster. At the tip of the hilt is a large black skull that seems locked in a permanent grin.

name: cat-o-nine tails
description: This long-handled whip has nine three-foot leather
attached to a knob at its end. Metal spikes and razors are embedded in the lashes, and would cause immense pain to anyone struck.

name: adamantite claymore
description: This is a large one-handed sword, nearly the size of a bastard-sword and crafted out of adamantite. The hilt is wound with black leather and intertwined with fine mithril thread. Dark blue energy pulses up and down the length of the blade, making the hair on the back of your neck stand on end.

name: obsidian field plate
description: This is a corselet of finely-crafted obsidian, inlined with a thick layer of soft leather padding. Its shoulder guards each have three large spikes protruding from them, making side attacks difficult. Swirling runes cover the surface, seeming to dance mesmerizingly in grand, complex patterns.

name: carved statues
description: These two statues flank the gate, each crafted in the form of a tall dark-elf warrior garbed in chainmail and bearing a long blade. Strangely, they seem somewhat warm to the touch, almost as if life force pulsed within them.

name: small glass flask
description: This rounded flask is filled with an oily fluid, which bubbles and froths unnaturally.

name: diamond-studded ring
description: This is a small, fragile-looking silver band with evenly- spaced diamond studs placed around its circumference. Impossibly tiny runes inlaid with mithril glitter brightly when exposed to light.

name: silversilk trousers
description: This is a marvelously-sewn pair of silversilk pants, inlaid with precious runes of gold. They are light and supple, and are a treasure indeed.

name: large silvery cross
description: This is the fabled Cross of Vengeance, which, when used, imbues its wielder with a mighty power. Its heavy, foot-long body is etched with glowing red runes, and its surface is untarnished despite its seemingly incredible age.

name: ivory bracelet
description: This simple-looking, but nonetheless beautifully-crafted, bracelet is made from the purest ivory. Bands of yellow gold and platinum are staggered at evenly-spaced intervals all around its length, and there is an inscription written in an ancient tongue on the inside.

name: arcane tome
description: This is a small, hand-sized book. On its cover is an exotic design decorated by a strikingly ornate description. Glancing about its tattered pages, you find an ancient incantation which may be of use to mages.

name: darkwood shield
description: This small shield is carved from the bark of an ancient darkwood tree. It is very thick, so as to provide good protection, but it is still much lighter than any metal shield. A slight warmth seems to radiate from it, and its surface almost pulses with life.

name: pristine scroll
description: The runes of this magical scroll seem to burn into your brain as you look at them, yet for some reason you cannot make them out. Only by reading the scroll completely could anything be learned from it.

name: mithril-runed tunic
description: This light, exquisitely beautiful tunic is made of the finest leathers, engraved with spectacular mithril-inlaid runes. An aura of power radiates from its surface in waves.

name: door with puzzle lock
description: This ingenious puzzle lock is crafted in such a cunning manner that it would require a great intellect to solve it, if the solution was not already known. No keyhole can be seen to open the door, so solving the puzzle is necessary to continue.

name: nightblack portal
description: This oval rift in space pulsates with an evil, chaotic power. Negative energy leaks out and surrounds you, leaving you numb and trembling. Whatever lies beyond would be sure death for the weak, and difficult at best even for mighty heroes.

name: black orb
description: This head-sized orb floats in the air with apparent ease. Its smooth, featureless surface is shrouded in arcing energy which makes you wince at its intensity.

name: throne
description: This exquisitely-carved throne is truly fit for a king -- or queen, in this case. An intricate button in the shape of a skull can easily be seen carved into one arm of the throne.

name: ruby emblem
description: FILE DESCRIPTION WCCRUBY.EMB

name: red key
description: This key is made of plain iron and was not hard to manufacture. The ridges of the key are fairly simple, tellin you the lock is not that secure. It is painted bright red, you can assume to match whichever house it belongs to.

name: mithril chainmail hauberk
description: This chainmail shirt is crafted from mithril, the strongest substance known to exist. The dwarves are the only ones known to have the skill to fashion mithril, and such exotic wonders are rare and precious.

name: fine chainmail hauberk
description: This exquisite chainmail shirt is crafted from the finest high-steel. Painstaking work has gone into its shining interlinked rings. It would provide good protection from blows in combat.

name: ogre-skin shirt
description: This heavy shirt is made from the thick, boiled skin of an ogre. Known for their toughness, Ogres are usually unwilling to part with their skin, but when the occasion arises it makes excellent armour.

name: silvery shield
description: This large, curved knight's shield gleams with a silvery light. A thin border of golden runes frames the rearing shape of a lion.

name: dwarven chainmail hauberk
description: This heavy suit of chainmail is a product of the masterful skill of the dwarves. Made of two thin layers of tiny, but unbelievably strong, rings, it provides a level of protectio seldom seen in light armours.

name: crystal platemail
description: This exotic suit of armour has apparently been made from smoky black crystal. Runes embedded deep in its surface give evidence of its magical origin, and pulse with a dim green fire.

name: long battle shield
description: This long, rectangular shield is used by elite armies to form walls, behind which they can fight safely. Semi- circular holes are cut on either side, through which spears or other thrusting weapons have room to attack.

name: prismatic robes
description: These brilliant robes reflect the light in the myriad colours of the rainbow. They are smooth and light like silk, but are far more durable and are obviously of magical origin.

name: lacquered battle armour
description: This leather tunic is crafted from stiff, black leather, and has been emblazoned with swirling golden emblems. Small semi-precious gems glitter in adornment on the breast. From the look and quality of it, it was likely the personal armour of a high-ranking leader.

name: adamantite platemail tunic
description: This massive suit of plate armour is made of interlocking plates of dark, gleaming adamantite. Nearly impenetrable, this suit of armour would greatly protect the wearer in combat, if the weight is bearable.

name: skull shield
description: This massive shield has elaborately-carved skulls set in its black iron front. Embedded in the centre of the shield's face is a gleaming skull, its visage forever frozen in a hideous grin.

name: astral robes
description: Strange, haunting visions of the astral plane continually shift and writhe across the surface of these pale golden robes. Made of some light, but incredibly strong, material, the magic inherent in these robes can be felt by even the most magic-deadened individual.

name: behemoth hide
description: This hideous-looking armour is fashioned from the worked hide of a behemoth. Stronger than steel, the behemoth's spiked skin gives the wearer an ominous and deadly appearance while providing incredible protection.

name: dragonscale armour
description: Gleaming with a permanent polish, dragonscale armour is highly-ranked in its worth. The overlapping dragon scales provide nearly-unsurpassed protection, making many other suits of armour seem almost useless in comparison.

name: aegis shield
description: This huge, round shield is intricately carved in a manner not seen in hundreds of years. Raised in the centre of the shield, a long-forgotten god's face stares out, the sapphires in his eyes gleaming like lightning. It has survived for countless generations, and aside from its antiquated appearance it is completely unmarked.

name: silversilk tunic
description: This beautiful shirt is made of the finest material known to man -- silversilk. Only the elves know how to weave this marvelous magical cloth, which is as light as silk while being strong as steel, and just as impenetrable.

name: fine greatsword
description: This heavy, two-handed sword has an extremely sharp four- foot blade that can punch through even the heaviest armour with ease. It is made from high steel and is commonly seen in the possession of high ranking officers.

name: fine mace
description: This sturdy weapon is crafted out of high-steel, and has been fashioned in such a way that it is excellently balanced. This allows for heavier hitting with no reduction in speed.

name: black steel halberd
description: This massive, unwieldy weapon has a wickedly-curved head, and is fashioned from a gleaming steel the colour of soot. Wound about its haft is a thin cord which provides a good grip.

name: great bronzewood club
description: This massive club appears to be a branch hewn from one of the far-off bronzewood trees, with the smaller branches removed. Its grip is bound tightly in leather, and the weapon swings surprisingly well for its size.

name: ashwood staff
description: This long, slender staff has weighty silver caps on the ends for better striking power. It is nicely balanced. Thin leather strips have been wound about the centre for grip.

name: dwarven axe
description: This heavy, one-handed axe is short-hafted and has a single blade shaped like a half moon. Well-balanced and durable, it is a fine example of the fact that daily dwarven handiwork greatly surpasses most works of masters of other races.

name: dwarven hammer
description: This light hammer has a rectangular head of the finest dwarf-iron. It is easy to swing yet hits hard, and would make an excellent weapon.

name: three-headed flail
description: This massive flail is quite impressive -- it has three spherical, studded heads attached to long chains, which would cause great damage in combat. Its thick wooden haft is banded with iron for reinforcement. A difficult weapon to use, it is rarely seen in the possession of unseasoned fighters.

name: long golden staff
description: This long golden staff is exquisitely carved with intricate symbols all along its length. At one end is a circular head, with a blazing emerald glittering in its centre.

name: runic warhammer
description: This massive, heavy hammer's granite head is intricately carved with jagged runes of a crude sort. The runes glow a fierce red and seem to pulsate to your heartbeat. Its haft is of leather-bound ironwood, and appears well-worn.

name: demon-carved halberd
description: This hideous creation's blade is carved with all manner of grotesquely-leering demonic faces. Its heavy edge is sharp as a razor, and its thick haft is intricately carved to resemble intertwined limbs.

name: dragontooth trident
description: This long, heavy, two-handed trident's shaft is made from a single piece of witchwood, known to amplify the power of spells cast into it. Its wicked-looking head consists of three-forearm-length dragon's teeth, naturally as sharp as razors and as strong as steel.

name: starsteel mace
description: This long-shafted mace has been crafted from a strange and extremely rare metal called starsteel. It shines bluish- silver, and its head is round and studded. A single glittering diamond has been set in its pommel, and spiral symbols inlaid in its haft glow warmly.

name: wicked bone scythe
description: This massive weapon looks like it was conjured up in someone's nightmare. Its long, curved blade is almost talon- like in appearance, and glitters with razor-edged sharpness. The haft is made out of yellowed bone, carved with faces screaming in torment and with images of leering demons.

name: stormhammer
description: This heavy stone weapon seems almost crudely made, but is imbued with incredible destructive magics. Lightning crackles all about it, occasionally discharging when the hammer strikes its mark.

name: shimmering vial
description: This small glass vial is filled to the brim with an oily, opalescent liquid that glows and shimmers with a pale light.

name: black potion
description: This heavy metal flask is filled with a vile, oily fluid that reeks of rotting vegetation. Small bits of unknown matter float about in it revoltingly.

name: golden vial
description: This long, elegantly-crafted crystal vial is filled with a brightly-glowing golden fluid. The light from the liquid pulses and hums with a strange force, causing the crystal of the vial to ring musically!

name: azurite stone
description: This small, ornamental stone is opaque and a deep mottled blue in colour.

name: agate stone
description: This small, ornamental stone is banded with brown, blue, red and white stripes.

name: hematite stone
description: This small, ornamental stone is a silvery grey-black colour.

name: malachite stone
description: This small, ornamental stone is coloured a rich light and dark green.

name: obsidian stone
description: This small, ornamental stone is glassy and jet black in colour.

name: turquoise stone
description: This small, ornamental stone is a mottled light and dark aqua.

name: bloodstone
description: This small, semi-precious stone is red in colour, with flecks and spots of blackness.

name: carnelian stone
description: This small, semi-precious stone is dark orange in colour.

name: moonstone
description: This small, semi-precious stone is semi-opaque, and is white with a pale blue hue.

name: onyx stone
description: This small, semi-precious stone is black and shiny.

name: piece of crystal
description: This small, semi-precious stone is clear and multi-faceted. It shines brilliantly in the light.

name: piece of amber
description: This small, fancy stone is a transparent golden colour, and is highly prized in certain primitive villages.

name: amethyst stone
description: This small, fancy stone is a beautiful semi-transparent purple in colour.

name: piece of jade
description: This small, fancy stone is a milky green in colour.

name: aquamarine stone
description: This small, precious stone is quite smooth, and a pale blue-green in colour.

name: garnet
description: This small, precious stone is clear and deep red in colour.

name: pearl
description: This small, precious stone is pure white and seems to glow in the light.

name: topaz stone
description: This small, precious stone is a golden yellow in colour.

name: black opal
description: This small gem is dark green in colour, with black mottling and golden flecks.

name: fire opal
description: This small gem is a fiery red in colour, and glitters in the light.

name: opal
description: This small gem is a pale blue in colour, with green and gold mottling.

name: diamond
description: This small, transparent jewel is a brilliantly glittering blue-white in colour, and is highly prized for use in jewelry.

name: emerald
description: This small, transparent jewel is a brilliantly glittering green in colour, and is highly prized for use in jewelry.

name: ruby
description: This small, transparent jewel is a brilliantly glittering crimson red in colour, and is highly prized for use in jewelry.

name: sapphire
description: This small, transparent jewel is a brilliantly glittering medium blue in colour, and is highly prized for use in jewelry.

name: wooden box
description: This simple pine box is about one foot long and half as wide and deep. Objects inside rattle about freely.

name: oak chest
description: This medium-sized chest is of simple but elegant construction. Long, interlocking planks of sanded oak form its rectangular shape, and the clattering of object can be heard from within when it is moved.

name: massive wooden chest
description: This huge wooden chest is crafted from heavy pine. It is simply made, but very sturdy. It has no lock, and when moved things can be heard rattling around inside it.

name: iron-banded chest
description: This medium-sized chest is made of thick wood, and is bound with sturdy iron strips. When moved, objects rattle about inside.

name: silver box
description: This smallish silver box is ornately carved with rampant animals. When moved, objects rattle about inside.

name: huge darkwood chest
description: This heavy chest is crafted from silver-bound planks of darkwood. Its massive, rectangular frame holds objects of value, for when it is moved rattling sounds can be heard from within.

name: golden box
description: This elaborate wrought-gold box is inlaid with beautiful filigrees and designs. Something inside rattles about noisily when the box is moved or shook.

name: steel chest
description: This solid steel chest appears to have been crafted by a blacksmith, as the work is crude but solid. Objects inside rattle about when it is moved.

name: silverwood chest
description: This large, gorgeous silverwood chest is heavily inlaid with golden ornamentation and small precious stones. Objects inside rattle about when it is moved. from within.

name: crater
description: The crater is hot and blackened by the impact of whatever meteorite crashed here. Metallic splinters litter the area, and glitter with a strange, otherworldy light.

name: gouged walls
description: The gouges in the walls are quite large, indicating that whatever beast chewed its way through here has large, unnaturally sharp teeth. Embedded deep in the gouges are tiny slivers of a glittering metal, though what that means is anyone's guess.

name: gleaming shard
description: This long, straight shard glitters with an otherworldly bluish hue. It is made of a metal unknown to this land, and it both indestructible and razor-sharp.

name: grey bushes
description: The bushes are fairly unremarkable. Their bark is a dark grey, and is extremely dry-- their leaves are small, round and light grey.

name: grey bushes
description: The bushes are fairly unremarkable. Their bark is a dark grey, and is extremely dry-- their leaves are small, round and light grey. Upon closer inspection, a narrow crack can be seen lurking behind them!

name: golden hide
description: This glittering hide is covered in coarse golden hair. It is extremely dense for its size, making it very heavy and quite a nuisance to carry around. It could possibly be made into armour, but only by a skilled craftsman.

name: silver flute
description: This beautiful silver flute sings with a clear, beautiful tone when played.

name: golden harp
description: This exquisite golden harp is crafted with intricate swirling patterns. Its strings are fine and well-strung, and the melody that it plays when its strings are plucked is heavenly.

name: bardic lute
description: This rare lute is a remnant of the days of the legendary bards. Its resonance is perfect and its construction is a mastery of woodcraft.

name: room ticket
description: This small ticket is good for a night's rest in an inn or tavern. Usually worth the price, as resting in a comfortable inn bed is more beneficial than anywhere else.

name: swamp boots
description: These long boots come up nearly to your crotch, and are covered in a coarse, dense black pelt. They seem to be completely waterproof.

name: fine throwing knife
description: This well-balanced, razor-sharp blade makes a formidable weapon at short range. It is both accurate and damaging in the hands of an expert.

name: black retchweed
description: This coarse, wiry plant is one of the fouler species of vegetation in swamps. Known to cause death and deformity in whomever eats it, it can be used to create powerful poisons for which there is no known antidote.

name: swamp
description: This spooky swamp stinks of rotting vegetation and gaseous fumes. The ground alternates from soft spongy masses, to soupy poisonous marsh seemingly at random, making navigation hazardous in the extreme. Strange sounds echo throughout the concealing mists, and shadows continually flicker in your peripheral vision. You get the feeling of being watched.

name: gnomish fish-helm
description: This strangely-crafted device is made to ressemble a fish's head. Covering the mouth and nose is an airtight wooden device that hooks up to a small pack of sort on the back. It allows breathing of water, but only under extremely cold conditions. Somewhat fragile, it is not useful in combat situations.

name: climbing harness
description: This heavy leather harness is complete with hooks and rope. It is used by climbers to anchor themselves while climbing, and is invaluable when making the treacherous climbs up mountains.

name: iron crown
description: This light circlet is surprisingly finely-crafted, despite the fact it is only iron. An eye-sized amber stone set in its front glitters brightly.

name: spectral sword
description: This long, glowing blade is slender and sharp, and appears like it doesn't actually exist fully in this plane. It is a pale yellowish-white, with the hilt being white-gold.

name: throne
description: This large gilded throne appears to have been crafted for someone of large stature, as it is a little big even for a fully-grown man. The throne's arms are carved to ressemble lion's paws, and at the top of the throne is a glaring eagle's head, its beak open in a soundless shriek.

name: patch of black mushrooms
description: These small mushrooms are jet black in colour, and have a distinctly distasteful odour. Their stalks are long and spindly, their caps wide and thin.

name: Eternal Fire
description: This flaming ball burns with a bright, warm light that doesn't harm but is warm and comforting. Its radiance penetrates into every dark corner, and lifts the spirits just to see it.

name: pickaxe
description: This large tool has a heavy metal head, one side of which has a curved spike, the other sporting a broad axe-like blade. It is indispensible to miners, who use it to hack out the rock and then to break it up to expose the ore. It also makes a good weapon.

name: mountain of rubble
description: This gigantic cave-in has completely sealed the entrance to this cave. There is no apparent way out...

name: Storm Spirit
description: This small crystal sphere contains the essence of lightning. Swirling about inside as crackling arcs, which make the orb flash and spark wildly.

name: mine pass
description: This small wooden card is etched with the symbol of the Miner's Guild of Khazarad. Only people bearing this pass may enter the mines.

name: copper ore
description: This rough chunk of rock contains a large portion of copper. Somewhat valuable, copper is used in many everyday applications. Before the copper can be extracted from the ore, it must be smelted and the rock skimmed off the surface of the metal.

name: silver ore
description: This rough chunk of rock contains a large portion of silver. Fairly valuable, it is mainly used in jewlery and high- quality dishware. The ore must be smelted so that the silver can be extracted-- until then, it is nearly worthless.

name: gold ore
description: This rough chunk of rock contains a large portion of yellow gold. One of the most valuable metals around, gold is used in most jewelry and embellishments, and is a favourite of the dwarves. However, the ore is nearly worthless until it is smelted.

name: iron ore
description: This rough chunk of rock contains a large portion of iron. Useful in creating weaponry and eveyrday items, it can be refined to make steel. Before being usable, however, the iron must be extracted from the ore by smelting it.

name: obsidian talisman
description: This small, circular disk is heavily engraved with intricate runes, and emanates a strange aura of power. It is quite heavy for its size, and when touched makes the hair stand on end.

name: Heartstone
description: This heavy, glittering jewel is blood red in colour. It shines with a thousand facets, and is warm to the touch.

name: gold signet ring
description: This small golden ring is worn by heavy use, and bears a striking symbol on its face. Circular, with a skull and two crossed axes, the symbol is a mystery.

name: cracked obelisk
description: This tall, pointed obelisk is night-black and as smooth as glass. Intricate runes carved into its surface emanate a strange aura of power. A large crack runs down through it, however, and the emanation of energy fluctuates wildly, sending prickles running along your skin.

name: runic key
description: This key is inscribed with many strange, intelligible symbols that seem to writhe as you look at them.

name: gleaming dagger
description: This long, straight dagger glitters with an otherworldly bluish hue. It is made of a metal unknown to this land, and is both indestructible and razor-sharp.

name: enchanted dagger
description: This long, straight dagger glitters with an otherworldly bluish hue. It is made of a metal unknown to this land, and is both indestructible and razor-sharp.

name: Spirit Dagger of Goijar
description: This long, straight dagger glitters with an otherworldly bluish hue. It is made of a metal unknown to this land, and is both indestructible and razor-sharp. Glowing with a ghostly halo of spectral fire, this weapon is designed for a special purpose.

name: golden chest
description: This large, heavy chest is heavily embellished with intricate dwarven ornamentation. The symbol of King Kulgar is emblazoned on the lid, and it is obvious that it is full of valuables.

name: adamantite chest
description: This large, heavy chest is plainly decorated, but has been polished to a nearly mirrorlike shine. Silver studs lining its edges glimmer brightly, and it is obvious that the chest is full of valuables.

name: black iron chest
description: This large, heavy chest is made of black iron, which has been polished so that the container gleams like a beetle's carapace. A hideous demonic face has been carved into its lid, and it is obvious that the chest is full of valuables.

name: Ice Tear
description: This small, smooth object glitters like ice but is as hard as diamond. Bluish-white and cold, it radiates an aura of sorrow that is unmistakeable.

name: small cloth pouch
description: This is a dirty canvas bag, large enough to hold a few personal belongings.

name: dirty parchment
description: Inscribed on this parchment is a crude map, with sprawling text in a child-like hand:

name: small black mushrooms
