description: These small mushrooms are jet black in colour, and have a distinctly distasteful odour. Their stalks are long and spindly, their caps wide and thin.

name: bag of poison
description: This small leather bag is filled with a lethal concoction of poisons.

name: altar
description: This bowl-shaped silver altar looks like it was once used to burn offerings or to provide light. It is permanently affixed to the shrine's marble floor, which is probably why it has not been stolen.

name: acid gland
description: This rubbery lump is covered with a thin layer of slime. It is pale white in colour, and has a distasteful smell faintly reminiscent of rotting flesh.

name: golden hide tunic
description: This heavy shirt is made out of a dense golden hide, which glitters beautifully in the light. It is covered in coarse, almost wirelike hairs of gold, and appears to have been bolted together with shining steel rivets.

name: metal plate
description: This square metal plate is somewhat larger than a human's hand-span, and is set in the side of the passageway's wall beside the dead-end.

name: serrated scimitar
description: This heavy, sawtoothed scimitar is engraved with harsh orcish runes. Its hilt and pommel are made of bone, worn dark with age.

name: pig on a spit
description: This is a fat, greasy, roasted pig impaled on a wooden spit. Slowly cooked over a fire, it is delicious but extremely fattening.

name: roots
description: These long, snaking roots are about an inch thick and are greenish-yellow in colour. Their aroma is quite pleasant, sweet and fragrant as flowers-- a strange find in these gloomy tunnels. A handful could be gotten with some small difficulty, by ripping or cutting them out.

name: unfertilized eggs
description: These half-dozen eggs are each about six inches long, and are pasty white in colour. They have a faint sweet smell and are a little sticky to the touch.

name: bushes
description: At first the bushes appear to dense to move through, and are definitely too hardy to chop up. However, after some searching, you find a small opening to the north which could be passed through.

name: alder chest
description: This large, iron-banded alder chest is nearly too heavy to move. Iron handles on its sides allow it to be carried, and whatever is inside rattles about noisily.

name: steel key
description: This large, shining key is well-crafted and seems to be used often. Stamped in its head is the shape of a roaring lion.

name: skeleton key
description: This small, fragile key appears to be made out of yellow bone. The handle is a rat's skull, with small glass marbles for eyes.

name: statue
description: This towering stone figure stands at least twenty feet tall. Crafted in the image of cloaked man, its features are shrouded in the depths of its hood, and its sleeves are rolled up to its elbows. Inscribed upon its base is an intricate text which can be deciphered upon closer inspection.

name: jade wave carving
description: Beautifully crafted from a single block of jade, this sculpture is carved to ressemble a curved wave crashing down upon the rocks. It is affixed to the stone altar, but for some reason seems moveable.

name: obsidian mountain carving
description: This exquisite sculpture is carved to represent a jagged, treacherous mountain range. It is affixed to the stone altar upon which it sits, however it seems able to be moved slightly.

name: white marble fog carving
description: This beautifully-crafted sculpture depicts the intricate swirling details of a foggy cloud. Upon closer inspection, the fog carving appears able to be moved somewhat.

name: sunstone flame carving
description: This priceless sunstone sculpture is crafted to ressemble a single burning flame, each tiny lick picked out in exquisite detail. Although affixed to the stone altar, it appears able to be moved somewhat.

name: titanium fork
description: This shining, titanium device greatly resembles an oversized tuning fork, attached to a strange crystal-studded handle. Of gnomish manufacture, it is a queer device that only the brilliant gnome inventors could create. <Type AIM FORK WEST to use on a western wall, and so on.>

name: tree
description: This ancient darkwood tree must be hundreds of years old, if not millenia. Large enough in girth to house a village of people, this grandfather of trees is unparraleled in all of the land.

name: door
description: This large darkwood door is carved with elaborate swirling patterns and sigils. A silvery doorplate set in the upper middle of the door bears a single rune of warning.

name: ivory statue
description: This small ivory statue is crafted to ressemble a head with eight faces. Each face has one single glaring eye, each a different colour; one red, one orange, one yellow, one green, one blue, one violet, one black and one white.

name: basalt key
description: This black, porous stone key is indestructible despite its fragile appearance.

name: brass knuckles
description: These shining knuckles are gripped in the fist to increase punching damage. Though they provide little protection, they are definitely worthwhile if fists are the primary form of attack. Used mostly by mystics, they are limited in use to the more advanced practitioners.

name: yellowed note
description: This worn, tattered parchment is inscribed with a few straggling sentences, reading:

name: smudged paper
description: This small piece of paper has a few lines scribbled on it:

name: potion of levitation
description: This small glass vial has a bulbous round bottom, and is filled with a bubbling white liquid. Stamped on its cork is a pair of wings.

name: waterfall
description: The Silver river thunders down through a gaping hole in the ceiling of the cave here, pouring down into a turbulent pool.

name: double-terminated quartz
description: This is a six-inch piece of clouded quartz. It shines when light strikes it, refracting off of its many facets.

name: cave roots
description: These long, snaking roots are about an inch thick and are greenish-yellow in colour. Their aroma is quite pleasant, sweet and fragrant as flowers.

name: magical quartz rod
description: This short quartz rod pulses with a pale, spectral light. Its strange enchantment causes it to hum slightly, and it is warm to the touch.

name: barrier
description: This shimmering, nearly invisible barrier can only be seen by the slight opalescent ripples that occasionally break its surface. It covers the passageway to the north, and seems impenetrable.

name: golden egg
description: This large, heavy egg is warm to the touch, and glimmers beautifully in the light. Its surface is mirror-smooth and is completely unmarred.

name: skull mask
description: This large face-mask appears to be crafted from a human skull. Painted black and laquered, it is placed over the face and attached by a pair of thin leather straps so that it fits snugly. The eye socks glow faintly red, giving the wearer a demonic appearance.

name: phoenix feather
description: This brilliant golden feather burns with a fiery hue. Rare and priceless, feathers of the legendary phoenix are only ever found in the possession of those who have aided the creature in some way.

name: mandible
description: This long, unwieldly item is a jaw ripped from a giant sized insect. Razor-sharp, it can tear through armour with ease but it is difficult to wield.

name: wire key
description: This small key is made of a complex intertwining of steel wires.

name: ruby ninjato
description: This magnificent blade is amazing to behold. Fashioned from a collection of bright, crimson rubies, it is single edged, yet that edge could slice great wounds in any foe. An aura of heat seems to come from its jeweled surface, and runes of power have been etched into the stone. A mithril hilt has been fashioned as a claw, grasping the blade mightily.

name: etched adamant broadsword
description: This double-edged blade has been fashioned from adamant with masterful hands. The edge is very sharp and seems to move with great agility. Etched on the base of the blade are the ancient words
.  No signs of magic are evident on this blade, from the blade to the leather that binds the hilt, or the pommel ends in a simple silver ball.

name: antlered helm
description: This is a rigid leather helm, with many druish runes painted on the crown and sides. Two large three-pointed antlers have been grafted to the helm, giving its wearer a fearsome visage.

name: ancient scroll
description: This ancient scroll holds cryptic writing within it, that seem glow with a dangerous power. They look to be runes of the magi upon its aged skin.

name: ornate red key
description: This key is made of solid steel, with complicated ridges from handle to end, indicating the lock probably belongs to a vault of some kind. It is painted a dark red and a single ruby is set in the head.

name: adamantite chest
description: This large, heavy chest is plainly decorated, but has been polished to a nearly mirrorlike shine. Silver studs lining its edges glimmer brightly, and it is obvious that the chest is full of valuables.

name: orange key
description: This key is made of plain iron and was not hard to manufacture. The ridges of the key are fairly simple telling you the lock is not that secure. It is painted bright orange, you can assume to match whatever house it belongs to.

name: ornate orange key
description: This key is made of solid steel, with complicated ridges from handle to end, indicating the lock probably belongs to a vault of some kind. It is painted dark orange and a single topaz is set in the head.

description: This blade crackles with immense energy. Made from a strange silvery metal it glitters along the edge of the blade. The hilt is elaborately wrapped with a single piece of fine silk, which seems to cause the air around it to tingle with power. The entire sword hums and it seems desperate to be used in combat.

description: You hold a pair of intricately crafted bracers, made of a the purest mithril, found deep in the dwarven mines of Khazarad. Encrusted into the metal are many fine, medium sized rubies. The bracers seem to have a magical magnetism to them, and naturally pull towards each other. Engraved in black on the inside of the left bracer is the name: Cyan.

name: rotted tree
description: This large, twisted tree stands here before you, hunkered down by disease and rot. It seems on the verge of collapse were it not for the numerous roots that still stick into the ground. A large hole surrouneded by mud and gunk is squarely below the plagued tree, leading below into places unknown.

name: crimson spiked shield
description: This is a medium sized shield has been fashioned from a form of insect chitin. A large flame has been painted on it, and a great spike protrudes from the center. Though heavy it offers some protection along with dealing damage to boot.

name: sharktooth trident
description: This heavy, two-handed weapon, is made of a most unusual material. Three jagged prongs covered in razor sharp teeth jut from a barnacle covered shaft of stone. The construction of the weapon and the barnacles make it somewhat unwieldy, but the sharp teeth that litter the prongs would seem to do enough damage to suffice.

name: etched adamant warhammer
description: This long-shafted warhammer has been crafted of purest adamant. The only markings are carved into the hammers head,

. The silvery hammer moves with great speed and can still deliver a crushing blow, knocking its oppenent to the ground. The long shaft of the hammer ends with a flame carved on the bottom, painted a bright crimson.

name: etched adamant greatsword
description: This massive sword can only be handled with two hands and could easily cleave a man in half. Crafted from fine adamant the blade has been sharpened to a keen edge. Carved with care on the base of the blade are the words
. The hilt has been covered with rigid leather, and the pommel fashioned in the image of a star.

name: Demon's Maw
description: Rows of yellowed teeth line the blade of this hideous greataxe. Vile symbols line the blackened obsidian haft of the weapon, and they almost seem to reach for you. The smell of brimstone and burnt flesh is thick from this weapon and the heat that it radiates already cause you to perspire. Beastly hair has been tied in knots on the handle.

name: runed petrified staff
description: This twisted rock staff was once the branch of a bronzewood, however time has caused it to become unbreakable. Even still various black and brown runes glow from the staff, carved long ago, they still have a life to them giving the staff great magical power.

name: burning staff
description: An item of myth or mystery, this staff smells as if it were burning and yet you can see no fire. Grasping the staff however causes your hand to almost blister from the heat that erupts from the wood.  Lively golden symbols, scribed into the staff, move and sway to their own beat. Abruptly the staff begins to cool, allowing you to firmly grasp it.

name: copperwood staff
description: A piece of beautiful copperwood has been used to make this staff. Still full of life, this staff carries a strange numbness with it, and yet makes your skin tingle and your hair stand on end. Various knots stick out of the staff causing light to jump from knot to knot in random patterns. Magic radiates from this staff with great force.

name: ice crystal staff
description: Magic of great power is the only explanation for this staves existance. Pure ice has been carved and formed into a tall staff. Chills exude from this crystalline wonder, causing the skin on your arms to become a terrain of goose bumps. Near invisible sygils of silver have been carved into various parts of the staff, making its power more evident.

name: dirty obsidian key
description: A large key fashioned from obsidian has been caked with dust from its lack of use. You blow some of the dust away and realize some of the teeth have been blown away with it. The key appears to be totally worthless.

name: ancient obsidian key
description: A large key fashioned from obsidian shows immense age and use. It is very worn, and some of the teeth seem to have disappeared entirely, you are sure this key is totally worthless.

name: flaming portal
description: This oval rift in space pulsates with an evil, chaotic power. Negative energy leaks out and surrounds you, leaving you numb and trembling. Whatever lies beyond would be sure death for the weak, and difficult at best even for mighty heroes.

name: shuriken
description: This small steel disk has four razor-sharp blades protruding from its edge. It shines brightly from its polish and look ready to deal out damage.

name: catoblepas eye
description: This huge eyeball is about two feet in diameter, and glows with a greenish hue. Its is fairly heavy and cumbersome.

name: flaming star
description: This strange object appears to be a piece of magical fire, fashioned into a four pointed star. The heat is intense from this weapon, and it looks as though it would make a deadly projectile weapon.

name: midnight glare
description: Used traditionally this knife would most likely be the fastest weapon ever created, the blade however is not built well for this, designed specifically to be thrown at the opponent. This knives blade is about five inches long, and the handle about two inches. The blade is made of a strange blue metal that when held is nearly invisible.

name: practice dummy
description: This large stuffed dummy hangs from a wooden frame, and is used to test combat skills and weapons. It is mildly enchanted so that it can take a hearty beating and still remain intact.

name: azure shamshir
description: This long, curved sword is made out of an intense blue substance that appears to be glass. It is smooth and exceptionally well crafted, and the handle is made of carved ivory that is extremely comfortable.

name: light ball
description: This pale white ball radiates a bright light, but exudes no heat and is almost cold to touch. It seems light weight and almost looks as though it could float, keeping your way lighted until its magic expired.

name: scroll of zeal
description: This holy writ details the exact prayers and intonations necessary to gain the power to learn this spell.

name: round table
description: This massive oak table could easily seat forty people. It is well-crafted and inlaid with rosewood panels in an intricate spiralling pattern.

name: bed
description: This large, comfortable bed is simple in design, but sturdily crafted. A luxurious goose-down mattress insures a good night's rest.

name: bookshelf
description: This large, wide bookshelf is designed to hold a large number of books of varying size.

name: long table
description: This simple, sturdy table is similar to those found in most common rooms of taverns and inns. It is heavy and is built solely to last.

name: wooden chair
description: This elegant wooden chair is ornamented with simple curving designs. Built to last, it is commonly seen in most town houses.

name: bench
description: This long wooden bench is often seen accompanying the common tables in an inn. It is sturdily built from solid oak wood.

name: desk
description: This elegant desk has been painstakingly hand-crafted from a variety of precious woods, and is rarely seen outside mansions of the rich.

name: cabinet
description: Simple in design but otherwise pleasing to the eye, this large cabinet has a great amount of room for storing supplies.

name: dresser
description: This nicely-carved dresser has three drawers for holding clothing, and is carved out of a nice light pine wood.

name: rug
description: This beautifully-woven rug is decorated with angular designs in intricate patterns. Painstakingly handmade, it is a treasure to own.

name: tournament badge
description: This small, bloodstained iron badge is a symbol proving once's participation in a Tournament battle. It has obviously seen much use.

name: crimson badge
description: This fearsome-looking badge is hammered out of heavy red metal. Crafted to ressemble a clawed fist, it is only worn by the highest-ranking orc in a war band.

name: black badge
description: This heavy iron badge is crafted in the shape of a clawed fist. It is commonly seen on high-ranking leaders in an orc war band.

name: orc-head
description: This bloody head once belonged to a foul, vicious orc. Now its blank eyes stare out dully in death, and ichor leaks from its ruined neck.

name: iron badge
description: This heavy iron badge is crafted in the shape of a clawed fist. It is commonly seen on the low-ranking leaders of the band who command only a few orcs.

name: glass orb
description: This small glass orb is beautifully-made, and sparkles mysteriously in the light.

name: crystal orb
description: This small crystal orb is beautifully-made, and sparkles mysteriously in the light.

name: granite orb
description: This small granite orb is beautifully-made, and quite smooth to the touch.

name: marble orb
description: This small marble orb is beautifully-made, and quite smooth to the touch.

name: ashwood wand
description: This long, slender ashwood wand is smoothly carved, and is engraved with arcane silvery runes.

name: teak wand
description: This long, slender teak wand is smoothly carved, and is engraved with arcane silvery runes.

name: mahogany wand
description: This long, slender mahogany wand is smoothly carved, and is engraved with arcane silvery runes.

name: pine wand
description: This long, slender pine wand is smoothly carved, and is engraved with arcane silvery runes.

name: darkwood rod
description: This heavy darkwood rod is about two feet long, and is covered in all manner of swirling symbols.

name: silverwood rod
description: This heavy silverwood rod is about two feet long, and is covered in all manner of swirling symbols.

name: rosewood rod
description: This heavy rosewood rod is about two feet long, and is covered in all manner of swirling symbols.

name: birch rod
description: This heavy birch rod is about two feet long, and is covered in all manner of swirling symbols.

name: cedar rod
description: This heavy cedar rod is about two feet long, and is covered in all manner of swirling symbols.

name: shadow material
description: This strange wispy fragment weighs nothing, and seems to fade in and out of view. It has an unpleasant feel to it.

name: holy water vial
description: This small glass vial is filled with pure, clean water. A stopper keeps its contents inside, and you see a single holy symbol inscribed upon it.

name: summoning bone
description: This long, smooth bone radiates pure evil. Used by powerful necromancers to trap the souls of the living and force them into an undead state, it is a tool of the netherworld and should be destroyed.

name: honeycakes
description: These small, round delights are sweetened with honey, and are the primary dessert for the peoples of this area. They are as nutritious as they are delicious.

name: mulled wine
description: This small wooden cup is filled with a quantity of strong, heated wine.

name: cup of tea
description: This small wooden cup is filled with a fragrant spicy tea, whose aroma stimulates the senses.

name: palm tree
description: This tall, slender tree is topped with long, jagged green leaves, and bears a cluster of round brown fruit.

name: shimmering pool
description: This wide, deep pool is filled with a cool, crystal clear water. It darkens somewhat towards the centre.

name: angular key
description: This beautifully-crafted brass key is quite large and heavy. It head is cut with an angular geometric design.

name: three-toothed key
description: This long, heavy key has a strange construction-- three oddly-formed teeth jut out from its barrel instead of the usual one.

name: well
description: This well is filled with a brackish, muddy water that would probably not be healthy to drink.

name: basalt obelisk
description: This towering stone obelisk is engraved with geometric symbols, and is topped with a black capstone. At eye-level, two lines in an ancient language read:

name: basalt obelisk
description: This towering stone obelisk is engraved with geometric symbols, and is topped with a black capstone. At eye-level, two lines in an ancient language read:

name: basalt obelisk
description: This towering stone obelisk is engraved with geometric symbols, and is topped with a black capstone. At eye-level, two lines in an ancient language read:

name: mummified miner
description: The twisted shape of a dead miner lays here in a corner. Mummified by the heat and dryness, his face remains forever locked in a horrible soundless scream. His legs have been crushed beneath a heavy sandstone boulder. One of his arms is outstretched, and sitting on the ground a few feet away from his clawlike hand is a tattered leather pouch.

name: red iron key
description: This short, heavy key is made of a deep-red metal, and is somewhat crudely made.

name: black altar
description: The black altar is large enough that a large human would easily fit upon its surface. Ancient bloodstains can be seen encrusted upon it. The glaring eye engraved on the altar fairly radiates evil, and has an odd, smooth construction.

name: copper amulet
description: This small, round amulet is crudely stamped with a symbol representing a roaring lion. It hangs on a heavy chain.

name: stone hand
description: This is a stone carving of a gnarled, inhuman hand. Its fingers are splayed as if ready to claw at someone.

name: jeweled altar
description: This large golden altar would bring a fortune if it were melted down, but it is far too massive to move. Embedded in its surface in a circle are many gems: an amethyst, a diamond, and emerald, an onyx, a pearl, a ruby, a sapphire and a topaz.

name: saracen head
description: This severed head is quite revolting. And it stinks. The desert raiders are apparently not big on personal hygiene.

name: moon-lamp
description: This intricate creation is an invention of the desert- dwelling Nekojin. It is a specially-enchanted crystal orb, which when exposed to the moon's rays captures this light and radiates it. It is held in a wooden box, much like a lantern.

name: heavy box
description: This large box is stamped on one side with the Tolgard's trader symbol. It is difficult to tell what is contained within, as the contents are carefully packed to avoid breakage.

name: tiger-claw necklace
description: Long, perfect tiger claws, covered with golden runes, hang from the platinum chain of this necklace. It seems to hum slightly, and feels oddly light.

name: silvery scroll
description: This thin scroll is made of hammered silver, and is imprinted with ancient characters. It radiates an aura of power that is unmistakeable.

name: jeweled turban
description: This elaborate headpiece is made of bright red silk and glittering gold. A sapphire the size of an egg is set in the headband, and sparkles with an unnatural light.

name: shelf
description: This small shelf is quite bare, apart from two large, ancient-looking books. One of the books has a bright-red cover, and has small pages, but hundreds of them. The other is bound with blue cloth, and is slim, but the pages and cover are at least twice the size of the other.

name: dwarven ale
description: This is a large, heavy wooden mug filled with the strongest alcohol known in the realm-- dwarven mushroom ale. It has a bitter bite to it, and easily knocks non-dwarves off of their feet.

name: red iron ore
description: This dense metal is blood-red, and is extremely hard, with an almost oily sheen. The chunk of ore is about the size of someone's head, and is very heavy.

name: red iron axe
description: This heavy, one-handed axe is short-hafted and has a single blade shaped like a half moon. It is crafted from a dark red metal, that shimmers with an oily sheen. A fine example of quality dwarven handiwork.

name: red iron hammer
description: This heavy warhammer has a broad striking head that can easily beat down the target. It is made of a strange, blood- red metal, which shimmers with an oily sheen. The weapon is a good example of quality dwarven handiwork.

name: red iron dagger
description: This long, heavy dagger is practically the size of a shortsword. Its blade is razor-sharp, and is made from an odd blood-red metal that shimmers with an oily sheen. The weapon is a great example of typical dwarven handiwork.

name: worn stone tablet
description: This ancient stone tablet is engraved with arcane runes, detailing the methods and practice of druidic magic!

name: papyrus scroll
description: This ancient, crumbling scroll is made from a coarse-grained papyrus plant. Printed on its surface in faded ink is a holy prayer.

name: khopesh sword
description: This is an end-heavy sword, with a slight forward curve. It is large and heavy, and does considerable damage in combat. It is a little unwieldly and slow.

name: two-headed pike
description: This long, unwieldly polearm has razor-sharp pike blades at both ends. Difficult to use for the novice warrior, it can be a deadly weapon in the hands of a strong, large opponent.

name: golden pike
description: This large, heavy weapon is crafted from a glittering gold that seems harder than steel. It has two pike-heads, one at each end, with black blades that can cut through steel with ease.

name: hydra key
description: This large stone key's head is shaped to ressemble the hideous serpentine form of a hydra.

name: meteorite rod
description: This three-foot rod is crafted from one of the few metals available in the desert-- meteorite ore. Heavy and ornately engraved, it is curved around at the end like a cane. It is a symbol of the pharaoh's eternal rule, and feels warm to the touch.

name: golden headdress
description: This elaborate gilded headdress is typically worn by the royalty of the desert peoples-- specifically, the pharaoh. It consists of a tiara-like crown of gold, crafted to ressemble a rearing serpent. Bands of fine gilded cloth hang down from the crown, and lay over the shoulders of the wearer.

name: crescent moon staff
description: This long, beautiful staff is crafted out of a hardwood with a deep blue-grey colour. Carved along its length is a winding pattern highlighted with silver. It is capped with a silver crescent moon, the points facing outwards, which is engraved with extremely fine letters that glitter in the light.

name: golden lion key
description: This small, heavy gold key's head is crafted to ressemble a roaring lion. It is smooth and warm to the touch.

name: spiked obsidian collar
description: This heavy, glittering collar is crafted from unnaturally hard obsidian. Short, sharp spikes jut out of its surface at refgular intervals, and gleam wickedly in the light.

name: rainbow stone
description: This small, beautiful gem is shaped like a bird's egg, and glows with a soft light. Its colour slowly cycles through rainbow's hues in an almost hypnotic fashion. It is hung upon a fine platinum chain, to be worn about the neck.

name: sculpture
description: This odd stone construct is quite smooth, and appears to have been polished-- it has an almost mirrorlike sheen. Multicoloured crystals embedded in its surface flash and pulse with a haunting rhythm. There is a gap in the side, which may allow entrance inside.

name: inscribed leather scroll
description: This worn writ instructs the reader in the holy incantations required to cast a powerful healing spell. It makes no sense to anyone other than a devoted Priest.

name: sunstone wristband
description: This thin gold wristband is etched with intricate spiral patterns. Set into its surface are many small, circular sunstones, which shine orange-red in the light.

name: silverbark canoe
description: This small, beautiful canoe is made of carefully-cured and waterproofed silverwood bark. Of elven make, it is virtually unsinkable in shallow waters and is very light.

name: barbed spear
description: This long, sturdy spear has been crafted out of a tough swamp tree. Its head is made of sharp steel, hooked and barbed to cause painful injury.

name: severed head of Irikani
description: Even in death, her visage is one of pure evil, and her devlish eyes follow you, giving you an ill feeling in the pit of your stomach. Her hair is coarse and almost burning to touch, and droplets of crimson occasionaly drop from the head, splashing on the ground with a smell of sulphur.

name: curved fang
description: This four-inch fang belonged to some great beast of a poisonous nature. It is black and hollow, and you can tell that there is some liquid inside that sloshes when you shake it.

name: spider silk trousers
description: These trousers appear made of some incredibly fine silk. When you touch the cloth it seems as if a million tiny strands of a fine fabric form each thread, and the stitching appears made of some golden fabric, each one appearing to form a sparkling rune.

name: bone necklace
description: Bones of all shapes are thread together by a single green vine, tied at the back. Each one seems to rattle on their own volition, causing you to think that they might be imbued with some magic power.

name: dented wizard's hat
description: This pointed hat is decades old, and from the dirt you wonder if it has ever been washed. Despite the grime you see many stars and magic runes running along it's length and along the brim. You note some of the stains would indicate the last owner had befallen tragedy.

name: net
description: This net is crafted from the vines of a strange plant that grows near the tasloi village. It is perfect size and weight to carry comfortably and toss easily. It is also perfect size to entrap a man.

name: javelin
description: This long wooden pole runs six feet in length. Vine is used as a grip in the middle of the pole, and the ends have been carved into several fine points, causing great agony to it's victim.

name: stone javelin
description: This long stone pole runs seven feet in length. You can not tell if it is chiseled stone, or petrified wood, but regardless it feels very sturdy. The pole has a sharp point at each end.

name: mithril plate leggings
description: This pair of leggings are made of the purest mithril, shining brightly in the light. They appear very heavy, but are surprisingly light when you pick them up. You can tell from the craftsmanship that they were fashioned by a master-smith.

name: mithril chain leggings
description: Several very tiny chain links, are all woven together to form an almost impenetrable pair of leggings. You can tell by their shine that they've been made of dwarven mithril, and wonder if they belonged to some lord or powerful warrior.

name: wyvernhide pants
description: These thick leather trousers are made from the hide of some reptilian beast. The brown scales are incredibly durable, and you can tell they provide protection that would rival the thickest animal hide.

name: black leather leggings
description: This pair of leather leggings is made from a glossy black leather which seems to absorb the surrounding light. It does not weigh much at all, and is very flexible.

name: chameleon leggings
description: You can tell by the ways the leggings change shade that they were made from the skin of some color changing beast. They feel extremely comfortable and look like they can afford ample protection.

name: red chitin leggings
description: These bizarre leggings appear to have been made out of the shell plates from some gigantic red crustacean. They are tied together by some glowing vines of some sort, and it appears to have been treated with some mixture that gives it a fine sheen.

name: red chitin helm
description: This red helmet has been made out of the head plate of some monster crustacean. It feels very durable for its slight weight, but the two holes left from the eye stalks still remind you of its origin.

name: red chitin armour
description: This red suit of armour is made up of several shells of some massive crab-creature. It feels incredibly tough and has been tied together by several glowing vines, and they seem to have been treated with some strange mixture that makes it give off a glow.

name: red chitin shield
description: This strange shield looks to be crafted from the red chitin of some large sea-monster. They are interlocked together and tied by some strange glowing vines. It is very light and you wonder if any weapon could pierce its surface.

name: sapling longbow
description: This slender bow is made out of the sapling of some outlandish forest. The string used is a single glowing vine, that is tightly wound to the ends of the bow. It comes with a quiver full of similar sapling-like arrows, feathered together with a tree-leaf.

name: bloodstained chakram
description: Red stains cover this circlet of strange metal, and as you grab it you feel an intense sense of evil. Black runes seem to pulsate from the large circle, and you wonder what evil deeds it has done. Much smaller then a regular sized chakram it is small enough to use for stealthy attacks.

name: bronze chakram
description: A razor-sharp bronze circle, which when hurled, flies out and returns to its wielder.  The blade is three inches wide, with the weapon being one foot in diameter.

name: ethereal chakram
description: This circle is made of some strange glass-like material, with strange smokey runes radiating from its edges. As you look at the circlet closer it seems like some shifting cloud is inside.

name: giant spiked collar
description: This collar is crafted from hard leather and appears to have belonged to some giant animal. On its lowest fastening, you think you could probably make it fit. Its sharp spikes are wickedly curved, and anyone wearing this would definitely look cruel and menacing.

name: fur-lined pouch
description: This pouch fastens around your waist like a belt, except it's two sizes too big.  Upon opening you see many bits of bone, wood and herb inside, it obviously belongs to someone schooled in witch doctoring.

name: gargantuan stone maul
description: This looks like a gigantic rock with a metal shaft coming out of it.  The head is two feet in diameter, and is very heavy.  It is so massive you have a hard time lifting it off the ground.  You try a couple of practice swings and the weight almost takes your arms off.

name: giantwood club
description: This was obviously a tree branch of some thousand year old tree before it was fashioned into a rough club.  It is gigantic in size and would have to have belonged to a huge monster. It is six feet in length, you could barely lift it yourself, however you can tell anything struck with this would have to take a step back or be flattened.

name: lionskin belt
description: This fine belt was made from the hide of some animal and then tanned. It feels very thick, and is buckled with a piece of gold, finely crafted into the image of a lion.  It is heavy to wear around your waist, but still makes a nice fit.

name: lionskin tunic
description: This tunic is made of dyed animal skin, tanned to a golden brown. The center is inlaid with a finely crafted symbol of a lion. From the feel of the tunic it's very hard to pierce, and the lining is made from a fine fur. The craftsmanship looks a little clumsy, but still durable in a fight.

name: great spiked club
description: A great stone club with huge spikes, it is a weapon in the crudest fashion. Gigantic in size, it could be stood on its end and be taller than most men.  Anyone who could even wield this would be a force to be reckoned with.

name: petrified stone corselet
description: A gigantic piece of stone makes up this

.  It is roughly chiseled to look like plate armor, but that doesn't change that it's still a massive piece of rock. It would fend off just about any attack on your torso, you only to worry about the rest of your body when wearing this massive chest protector.

name: stormmetal greataxe
description: This is a massive, long-handled axe. The double blades are made of a bizzare metal that gives off a blueish tinge as white lightning runs up and down the razor-like edge. As you grasp the handle it gives you a slight shock, and it seems to give off an odd hum as it weaves through the air.

name: stormmetal scalemail tunic
description: This entire suit is enchanting to behold, the metal lights up all over with lightning, giving the entire suit a blueish tinge. The circles of metal are all tightly woven together to make a hard-to-pierce suit. You note the suit was worn by a very large man as you put it on and have to adjust the straps to fit your smaller frame.

name: stormmetal bracers
description: A pair of armbands made from a bizzare metal, with a lightning charge running along the length of the bracers giving it a blueish tinge. The metal is incredibly sturdy, etched in runes of some strange language of power. The bracers are oversized but will still fit.

name: storm crown
description: This is a large circlet finely-crafted in some strange metal. The air crackles with the lightning that circulates all around the crown. A massive sapphire is set in the front of the crown. Upon closer inspection there appears to be a thundercloud hidden deep in the gem.

name: titanic stone maul
description: This huge maul is made up by a great eight foot rod, topped by a large stone ball. Incredibly difficult to lift, it is very slow to wield, but anything it hits will be crushed by its massive weight. A great weapon for only the strongest combatant, you see by the stains on the stone that it's already found many victims.

name: beaded belt
description: This belt is made of several coloured beads, woven together with several tiny vines. You can not tell if the glow of the belt comes from the beads or the vines, but a strange warm feeling seems to radiate with each glow.

name: silver belt
description: This brightly shining belt is made of a single massive band of silvery metal. Green runes adorn the buckle, and they seem to give off their own light.

name: ogre bone bracelet
description: Strange magical runes dot the length of the leather thong that holds together the bones of a monstrous ogre.

name: shadow bracelet
description: This dark black bracelet is made of an odd leather than seems to eat at the surrounding light. Running your finger along it gives you a strange cool feeling.

name: thief's pouch
description: This tiny, leather pouch attachs to the wrist, providing easy access to the tools of a thief which jingle inside.

name: witchwood bracelet
description: This bracelet is crafted from the magically-grown witchwood tree. Exotic runes are precisely placed in intervals along the band. It feels strangely warm to the touch and you feel a harmony with nature.

name: mithril bracelets
description: This pair of finely crafted metal is made of dwarven mithril. They are snug fitting and cover your wrists, almost reaching your elbows. The left is adorned with black etchings, and the right hand is detailed in white.

name: silverwood lute
description: This lute is definitely a rare find, for it is made of the sacred silverwood tree. It glows brightly from the symbols engraved on it, and the strings seems to play a musical tune themselves.

name: blackwood staff
description: This long staff is made of a thick black wood that feels cold to the touch. Etched upon its length are vile runes that glow a dark red color. You get a sickly feeling in the pit of your stomach when you run your fingers along the letters.

name: black leather belt
description: This leather belt is made of a glossy black leather which seems to absorb the surrounding light. It does not weigh much at all, and is very flexible.

name: dark hood
description: This hood is made of some type of black velvet-like cloth. When worn nothing can be seen of the wearer's face. Dark blue runes annoint the brim of this hood, and you get the feeling this item is not for the good of heart.

name: runed longbow
description: This slender, curved bow is made of some strange dark wood. Bright, glowing runes are burned all over the wood from tip to tip. The tight string that runs down appears to be made of some strange silk but pulls back as if it were the strongest cord. A quiver of arrows, also made of the same darkened wood, come with the bow, their tips a dull red.

name: shimmering sash
description: This is a six-foot long shimmering silken sash, worn around the waist. It seems to glow and pulsate with its own light. You can just make out runes sewn in some tupe of gold thread but you are forced to look away by the light.

name: skull-capped staff
description: This six-foot long staff is made of some type of yellowed wood. It almost appears to be rotting until you feel how sturdy it is. On the top of the staff is a grinning human skull, with two red points of light seeming to come from its eyeless sockets.

name: trollskin boots
description: This pair of boots is well-crafted from the skin of a large troll. They come up to the knee and feel comfortable enough, but it's still hard to grapple with the idea of wearing the skin of a troll.

name: scaled lantern
description: A small wiry stock holds this strong smelling lantern at arms length. Scales and bone house a small, but bright, glowing ball, which radiates a greenish light.

name: glowing pearl
description: Suprisingly heavy for such a small object, this pearl radiates a light from within.

name: giant crab shell
description: This chitinous shell looks to be well worn. Dents and scuffs scar the surface, but it still seems very well suited for protective purposes.

name: ruby earrings
description: The rubies used to make this pair of earrings have been set into a white gold backing. They have been shaped into roses. The petals are so well defined, it must have taken hours to complete each. At the base of each one is a tiny pair of emeralds, in the shape of leaves.

name: mithril earrings
description: Tiny rings of mithril have been linked together to form a circular pattern. Looking closely you see that one has a small dent in it, and realize they have been worn before.

name: diamond earrings
description: These tiny diamonds are set into a thin gold backing. They sparkle brightly without catching the light, and give off a humming sound so soft that you can barely hear it even while wearing them.

name: sparkling pendant
description: A silver star shaped necklace with gems set into each of the points. The metal is buffed to a high sheen, and the gems sparkle with a life of their own. Looking closely you notice the gems seem to slowly shift colors.

name: icy scroll
description: This scroll is tinged blue and tied by a bright blue ribbon. It seems to let off a vapor of some sort, and as you touch it, your whole body begins to shiver, as if an arctic wind blew down on you.

name: cosmic staff
description: This long, slender staff shimmers under the glow of diffused starlight. Glittering sparks encircling it spin about madly, flashing brightly and emitting high-pitched noises. The power of the cosmos is imbued within this staff, which, when tapped, provides arcane strength.

name: starhammer
description: This beautiful weapon seems to be made out of pure light from the stars, glowing radiantly and shimmering. It hums with arcane power and feels warm to the touch.

name: severed earth dragon claw
description: This dismembered claw is the shriveled, dead remains of some massive dragon. Its skin was once the color of soil, but in withered form it has blackened some. Five decayed fingers jut out to end in five very sharp nails. It looks like an awkward, but usable weapon.

name: quest token
description: A token signifying you have completed a quest, turn this in to the proper person and receive your prize.

name: deathcoil
description: This long, metallic whip has tiny sharp protrusions along its length, designed to lacerate the target. Its heavy grip is bound in a strange grey leather and it almost seems to move with a life of its own!

name: deathblade
description: This long blade is made of pure black metal and is extremely cold to the touch. Its overpowering evil aura almost seems to drain the life from you.

name: naginata
description: A lightweight 6-foot long pole wiht a curved blade on the end. The naginata reminds you of a halberd, but is lighter and easier to maneuver in combat. The pole is made from some unrecognizeable wood. It is thick and sturdy, but very light. The blade at the end is long enough that it could easily have been crafted into a sword instead.

name: kote
description: These armoured sleeves connect behind your shoulders with a thick strip of leather. They are made from tiny metal plates stitched together with a coarse black thread, and an intricate camouflage pattern has been painted on the them. plates.

name: manriki-gusari
description: You see a length of black chain with weights at each end. The manriki-gusari is easily thrown at your opponent's ankles for tripping and hindering retreat. Used at the correct time, it can give you the upper hand in combat. The length of the chain is just right for tying about your waist and concealing it beneath a belt or sash.

name: gunsen
description: This compact shield folds out quickly into a large iron fan. It is ideal for deflecting blows in close combat, and then snapping shut to give extra room for a counter blow. Ornate lettering lines each partition, unfolding into a haiku about death.

name: tonfa
description: The tonfa consists of a long, thick rod made from hardwood and a handle that juts out about a third of the way down the shaft. Used in the hands of a trained ninja, it can be used to effectively break an opponent's weapon, leaving him vulnerable to your attack.

name: twin shortswords
description: A pair of shortswords, specially crafted for the ambidextrous. There are matching symbols carved down the sides of the blades.

name: webbed gauntlets
description: This pair of once leather only gauntlets has been fused with think, but very light webbing. The added protection from the webbing in no way restricts the movement of the wearer, as the leather and webbing mix is completely flexible.

name: bloodstained broadsword
description: This razor-sharp blade is over three feet in length. The metal of the blade and hilt is a deep gray color and doesn't look familiar. Each edge of the blade looks to be permenently stained with blood and a single glowing crimson rune lines the pommel.

name: ball of webbing
description: This thick ball of webbing is remarkable light and pliable. It looks as if it would make a decent projectile.

name: leaf blade
description: This seems to be half of a large leaf forming a perfect semicircle. Amazingly rigid for a leaf, the rounded edge is sharper than most blades made of metal.  No handholds appear along the flat edge which makes it awkward for anyone to wield.

name: giant pearl
description: This pearl is large enough to take both your hands to lift. It's not necessarily heavy, but awkward to lift. The milky-white color reflects rainbow colors in the light.

name: glowing vine
description: This is roughly a six foot length of thick jungle vine. These plants grow near the Tasloi village and have a soft glow about them. You recognize that the tasloi nets are probably crafted from these vines. The material is sturdy and could be used for a number of purposes.

name: spider silk robes
description: These robes have been beautifully crafted from the silk of giant spiders. They drape comfortably about your body, and give off a sort of warm feeling. You see a soft rainbow effect when it catches the light.

name: feathered key
description: The hard thick shafts of bird's feathers have been shaped into the odd semblance of a key. There are no strings or glue, and you can only assume they are held together by magic.

name: chiseled key
description: This key was chiseled from hard volcanic rock. The edges of the handle are rough and unpolished. The key portion has been smoothed down to fit a lock properly.

name: magma key
description: Magma was dripped into a mold and slowly cooled to form this key. It is small enough to fit within the palm of your hand, or a tiny lock.

name: polished key
description: This key is made from hard black volcanic rock. It's been polished to a high sheen. When you hold it too tightly in your hand, you have a slight feeling in the pit of your stomach.

name: red rock key
description: The porous red volcanic rock has been shaped into a thick key. It seems to absorb body heat and constantly gives off a warm feeling.

name: crocodile fang
description: This sharp fang is about 3 inches in length, and half an inch thick at the base. The tip of the tooth has been ground smoothly from use, but the fang is still quite sharp.

name: frozen shard
description: This is a triangular shaped piece of magical ice. Occasionally when an ice golem dies, it shatters and yeilds shards. This piece is about a foot in length and an inch in diameter. You are forced to handle it carefully so the edges don't slice your hand open.

name: pixie wings
description: These wings are very durable, despite how thin they are. When you hold them up to the light, rainbow patters shine to the floor below. They are beautiful to look at, and silken to the touch.

name: pulsating heart
description: Thrag's heart continues to pulse with life, long after his body has given up. By putting this in a magical container, you could probably preserve it for quite some time. The size of it reflects how large the beast actually was, and makes it awkward to handle.

name: scorpion tail
description: This tail yields from one of the white scorpions that live near the city of Khazarad. Medicine men have long favored these for various healing concoctions. Charlatans peddle them at a high price to the lonely as an effective love potion if ground and served in a drink.

name: spider leg
description: This long and thin spider leg is still twitching its death throes. The leg is suprisingly light and folds neatly in half from the natural segments. A trail of short black hairs runs up one side of the leg.

name: piece of shell
description: This section of turtle shell is about one foot in diameter. It is extremely thick and seems almost unbreakable. A very heavy blow must have shattered the original shell. Unfortunatly, it appears to be too small to use as a shield.

name: mamba fang
description: This wicked looking fang is over 3 feet in length and comes to a very fine point. As you shake it you can hear fluid rolling about in what must be a hollow within the fang. With proper preperation this could be a formidable weapon.

name: crane totem
description: This tiny crystal statue of a crane is nearly transparent and seems very delicate.

name: dragon totem
description: This small statue of a dragon is made from lava rock and seems to drain the energy from your hand.

name: gorilla totem
description: This small jade statue of a gorilla feels warm to the touch.

name: monkey totem
description: This small golden statue of a monkey is nearly freezing to the touch.

name: viper totem
description: Coiled as if to strike, the obsidian figurine of a viper makes you think twice about putting your hand near it.

name: golden idol
description: Made of the purest gold this small caricature of a warrior looks fierce even with its oversized proportions. Normally gold of this type is very soft and malleable though the detailed working of this figurine shows no wear and no matter what you try a scratch cannot be left upon it.

name: sign
description: Gone hunting components, try back later.

name: songsheet of the elements
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical song of the elements.

name: scroll of merciful grace
description: This holy writ details the exact prayers and intonations necessary to gain the power to learn this spell.

name: songsheet of soothing
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical song of soothing.

name: scroll of magma blast
description: This parchment is inscribed with runes of magic, but exactly what is written can only be learned by reading it.

name: scroll of acid tempest
description: This holy writ details the exact prayers and intonations necessary to gain the power to learn this spell.

name: king crab claw
description: This large claw is awkward to hold because of its bulk. It is about 4 feet in length, including a portion of the arm. The shape of it would make it an effective tool for scooping large amounts of dirt or sand.

name: scroll of wizard knock
description: This parchment is inscribed with runes of magic, but exactly what is written can only be learned by reading it.

name: salca dart
description: The poison that coats this dart is made from a rare fungas only upon the upper branches of the trees in the jungle. Known to cause weakness in muscles, monkey that accidentally eat it commonly plunge to their deaths unable to hold their weight going from branch to branch.

name: heavy spear
description: Larger then a normal spear, this weapon is made for those that possess exceptional strength. Many would argue that this is a ballista bolt not a hand to hand weapon but those that have the strength to wield one make a definate argument for its deadliness when skewering opponents.

name: fluked trident
description: This large spear-like weapon has small ridges along the shaft and in the three prongs that form the head. On closer inspection, it appears that small holes, long and thin were forged into this weapon to decrease weight and improve balance.

name: fangblade
description: Made from the tooth of a giant viper and crafted by a master weaponsmith, few weapons are the equal to its elegance and deadliness. Bone white with a jewel encrusted pommel it seems as though it has a mind of its own and helps to guide its weilder to draw blood.

name: bane dart
description: Made from the poisons of a jeweled viper this dart is able to disrupt a spellcasters ability to draw and control magical powers.

name: stone head
description: This is a giant life-like head made of solid stone, it is very heavy to lift. The former owner of the head seems to have belonged to that of someone of great power. The dead eyes gaze outward in cold, lifeless silence.

name: thundering scroll
description: This scroll seems charged with rippling energy, you find it shocking to touch!

name: withered tree
description: This once great tree, now twists and bends like a tired old man. Diseased and near death something seems to keep it clinging to life. Its dried branches stick out like ancient fingers reaching to the sky. Two large holes stick out of the bark where branches once were.

name: scroll of wrathful curse
description: This holy writ details the exact prayers and intonations necessary to gain the power to learn this spell.

name: staff of power
description: This long, exquisite ebony staff has been crafted by the finest smiths, and emblazoned with powerful magic runes by only the strongest enchanters. A smooth multifaceted crystal tops the staff, sending out a glittering spray of rainbow sparkles.

name: fungus walls
description: What you can see of the walls, they appear to be made of light grey stone. However, most of it is covered with great patches of mold and fungus.

name: tukata root
description: This rare root is from the tukata plant, which only grows upon the corpses of those killed by poison. Tukata root seems to have the ability to nullify the effects of poison and in the living plant actually create nutrients to live off of.

name: songsheet of battle
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical song of battle.

name: behemoth hellhound hide
description: This is the thick, heavy hide of a behemoth hellhound. Its black fur is dry and straight, and reeks of brimstone.

name: scroll of nature tap
description: This holy writ details the exact prayers and intonations necessary to gain the power to learn this spell.

name: battered wooden chest
description: This large wooden chest has seen better days. Large iron bands scratched and bent in places from fruitless attempts to remove them, hold the container securely on the floor. No locks secure the lid and there is a loose latch on the lid that looks like it would be easy to lift.

name: boomstick
description: This looks to be a twelve gauge double barreled Remington. Very rare, it can be found in the sporting goods department. Fashioned in Grand Rapids Michigan. It is known to be quiet costly. The stock has been made of walnut, and the barrels made of cobalt blue steel. The trigger looks to have a very easy pull to it. Written up on it:

name: hero's tabard
description: This deep brown cloak would weigh less if it were lined with lead. Sewn from the cocoons of the temprite moth they provide one of the sturdiest protections possible in cloth. Though not the easiest cloak to wear its sturdiness has saved more then a few warriors of lore.

name: inquisitor's cloak
description: Small scales of metal hammered thinner then paper look like a shimmering dragon hide on the outside of this soft deep grey cloak. The witchunters of old were rumored to wear such cloaks during their first attempt to purge magic from the realm.

name: firebrand cape
description: Worn by paladins of all faiths during the Great Wars, these bright red cloaks acted as beacons signifying a person looking for a honorable duel to the death. Tales of clashes between armoured juggernatus wearing these cloaks abound through the songs and tales told by bards.

name: cloak of faith
description: Devised by the first battle clerics, words of strength and power are woven into the underside of this cape to charge a cleric physically and spiritually in battle. Many an enemy group has fallen to a cleric wrapped in this cloaks embrace.

name: folds of worship
description: Cloth lighter then the sheerist silk, these cloaks are rumored to be from the robes of the gods themselves wore when they walked the lands. Merely wearing these poweful artifacts is said to bring you much closer to the greater powers.

name: faith keeper
description: A cape reserved for the most zealous missionaries. It is told to bring help to those troubled by the beasts and hardships of the road, in times of need it can bring the wearer into a zealous frenzy to keep faith in the wayward heathens. It is a pure white cloth, with a sun emblazoned brightly on the back, and a platinum star for the clasp.

name: death's shadow
description: Rumored to be magically made from the shadows of the undead, no item in existence is darker. It is said that a ninja who owns this cloak will never go unarmed for the cloak is hungrier for death then any owner.

name: blacknight
description: Made of the darkest black cloth these cloaks were commissioned by Skeller himself for the most poweful of his guild. Enchanted by an evil drow mage and riddled with hidden pockets and tools it became the gifted thieves best friend.

name: lyrist's companion
description: An indescript off-white, the magics within these cloaks could turn an unruly audience into a peaceful mob or move a quiet group of commoners into a dancing frenzy. Many of the secrets of these cloaks left with the original sages.

name: shawl of fortune
description: A light wrap that borders between blue and gray these cloaks had been within the gypsy families for years, lost during the tragedy of the wars. Many great gypsy princes and wise fortune tellers have warn these robes and more than a little of their spirit remains bound to them.

name: tails of battle
description: Not so much a cloak but a collection of cloth strips, black on the outer side and bright yellow on the underside. Commissioned by the king these cloaks struck terror into the foes while the warlocks spun and cleaved their way into enemy ranks.

name: runed cape
description: Flawless white with runes of various colors creating a tangle of magic upon it these robes have been donned by the most powerful of magi since the beginning of time. A slight hum of magical power can be felt by anyone near it.

name: leafwoven cloak
description: Tiny vines still producing small green leaves make up this cloak. Created by the first druid to give disciples knowledge of how the earth mother supports her children this magical clothing brings a druid closer to one with nature.

name: mantle of the woodsman
description: The rangers that first scouted these lands were proud owners of these deep green cloaks. Imbued with protection from various elements these cloaks allowed them to withstand the harsh wilderness for months at a time.

name: peasant cloak
description: The humble look of this ratty cloak hides it's true power. Owned by generations of quiet monks who spent life times training in the arts, these cloaks provide the insight and fighting knowledge of generations past.

name: scroll of divine courage
description: This holy writ details the exact prayers and intonations necessary to gain the power to learn this spell.

name: emerald-studded bracelet
description: Crafted of adamantite, and studded with large emeralds, this bracelet was crafted by someone of great skill. Each emerald seems to glow with an inner light, giving the bracelet a life of its own.

name: shimmering portal
description: A large oblong portal that shimmers with white light. If you listen quietly, you can hear the energies surging and fading in rhythm with your heart beating. It looks large enough for a man to walk through on horseback.

name: blackened dirk
description: This short thick blade is flat black color with intricate etchings circling the hilt. Light disappears into the surface of the blade instead of reflecting back. Blending easily into the shadows, it makes an excellent knife for those who prey on the unwary.

name: sai
description: A pair of thin blades about a foot long. Each blade has a curving hilt, giving them the appearance of small hand held pitchforks. The sai are ideal tools for an opportunistic ninja to surprise his prey with.

name: blackened wrist guard
description: Made from a flat black metal, this guard is a small disk that straps cleverly across the palm of your hand and the back of your wrist. The disk is designed to protect the back of the hand and wrist while still allowing freedom of movement to climb, wield a weapon, or cast a spell.

name: lifestealer
description: The lifestealer blade is nearly four feet long but unbelievably thin for its size. Made of an orcish metal it reflects no light and mysteriously makes no sound as it moves through the air.

name: black embroidered robes
description: A large black robe of a velvet material that completely covers you from head to toe. A gold pattern is embroidered around the hem of the robe, and around each sleeve. The material is thick and provides excellent protection.

name: black diamond
description: These oval shaped black diamonds appear to be worn ornamentally on the forehead. Holding one in your hand, you realize they are actually a living organism that embeds in their flesh. Only the death of a nanati host releases the stone. It hums with life in your hand.

name: crystal
description: This piece of crystal looks newly polished and has an odd cyan glow to it. You notice as you move closer to it, that the glow seems to almost pulse, as if it were in time with some heartbeat.

name: Draka's Blade
description: This broadsword is crafted from rare black metal.  The blade itself appears to have lost its luster but its edge gleams due to the sharpness of it. Etched into its simple handle is the name
, obviously it's original owner. Thoughts of great and mighty deeds flash in your mind as you heft the weapon.

name: head of the orc warlord
description: This beaten and bloody head once belonged to a dreaded black orcish warlord. Now blank eyes stare dully in silence, as foul bloody ichor leak from its fanged mouth and severed neck.

name: crimson scale gauntlets
description: This pair of hard leather gloves are made of some type of black animal skin, the back of each hand has several diamond-shaped crimson pieces of some alien metal sown into the leather. On each piece of metal is stamped a small flame.

name: sacrificial dagger
description: This light weight blade appears to be crafted of some black metal. The blade is very serrated, with skulls engraved all along its length. A single bloodstone is set in the pommel and it seems to have a faint glow to it.

name: curved bone dagger
description: This trully gruesome weapon, made entirely out of yellowed bone carries a taint of pure evil. The jagged blade is very cold to touch, and is only adorned with a single piece of polished jet which hums faintly. Faded red stains on the edge tell you it has been used many times to prey on unknowing victims.

name: scroll of ethereal shield
description: This parchment is inscribed with runes of magic, but exactly what is written can only be learned by reading it.

name: icy scroll
description: This scroll is freezing to touch and gives off wisps of steam as if it were made entirely of ice, oddly enough you can unroll it to reveal swirling runes in the language of druids.

name: bloody meat cleaver
description: This massive piece of cutlery has dried bloodstains covering the thick metal blade. You can tell from the smell it hasn't been cleaned for quiet awhile, and yet the black wood handle appears to be freshly carved.

name: ice chest
description: This massive chest was once made of some fine metal, except ages of being locked in solid ice have made the metal brittle. Years of being put away in some icy, dark cavern have made this chest weight ten times what it seems. Your skin almost sticks to the surface as you brush your hand across the lock.

name: withered tree
description: This once great tree, now twists and bends like a tired old man. Diseased and near death something seems to keep it clinging to life. Its dried branches stick out like ancient fingers reaching to the sky. One large hole sticks out of the bark where branches once were.

name: wedding gown
description: This elaborate wedding gown is made from the finest silk. The bodice is decorated with small pearls, arranged in intricate patterns. The ten foot train that trails behind the gown is made from layers of soft lace.

name: wedding band
description: This elegantly-crafted band is made of the finest gold. It is about a quarter inch in diameter, and polished to a high sheen. A small diamond set in the center glitters softly, and engraved in small letters inside the band are the words,

name: gavel of justice
description: This weapon is surrounded by a faint holy aura. Made entirely of platinum from handle to hammer-heads, it has been fashioned to appear like that of a massive gavel. Symbols of justice are etched on each head.

name: daikatana
description: This is a large two-handed sword, five feet in length. Though longer then a greatsword, the blade feels light and is slightly curved. The edge glitters in the light, and the hilt, shaped like that of a dragon's maw, tells you it was crafted by the hands of a master.

name: ice crystal falchion
description: This sword has a bluish white hilt which attaches to a crystal blue blade of what looks like pure ice. The blade has a heavy end with a slight curve forward. It feels large and heavy but seems to be easy to weild.

name: magical rune
description: A magical rune crafted by a mage of great power, it symbolizes the person has done a great service for the crafter and can return it for reimbursement for that deed.

name: smoking blackwood chest
description: This massive blackwood chest smells faintly of brimstone and tinder. Smoke comes from every crack and crevice and you are left to wonder if opening it will release some hell bent force or unholy treasure of utter damnation.

name: black runed shovel
description: Looking at this shovel makes you queasy. The handle is made of polished blackwood, with glowing red runes running along it's shaft and the shovel blade. As you examine the blade further you realize it has been honed to a sharp edge and it looks more like an enlarged spearhead then anything else. Whoever fashioned this shovel no longer intend it to dig.

name: stone chest
description: This chest is actually a large piece of granite that has been meticulously hollowed out. A large stone slab forms the door. It looks immensely heavy and you already feel your muscles ache from the strain they are about to take.

name: blizzardfang
description: This serrated dagger could easily be a sword in the hands of a weaker person. It looks to be made of some magical ice so cold that it would give goosebumps to anyone that wields it.

name: severed arm
description: This long arm once belonged to some well muscled humanoid. It is black and purplish from the severed shoulder down to the stiff, jagged nails. It smells faintly of rotting but your sure it would do as a weapon in a pinch.

name: severed leg
description: This blackened severed leg has belonged to some humanoid of great strength. Even disattached the muscles are still bulky and toned. Despite the fact you can hardly stand the rancid smell you know this would make a crude though morbid weapon.

name: spiked black tentacle
description: This is is the severed black greenish arm of a tentacled abomination. Several spikes protrude from the end making it a very clumsy but cruelly effective weapon.

name: minotaur horn
description: This curved black horn is three and a half feet in length. As you examine the tip and see the dark stains of dried blood it is evident that it once belonged to a very mighty minotaur of great brute strength. According to ancient myth the horn of a minotaur can be used for magical components or as a musical instrument.

name: platinum greatsword
description: This is a massive platinum blade four feet in length. It appears incredibly sharp and you wonder if it could cleave a man in two. Requiring two hands to wield, and massive strength to even use, this sword would cause huge amounts of damage in battle and you can only hope you will never face such a weapon in combat.

name: gravestone
description: Here lies Dougan, Paladin of the House Of Lords, he proclaimed himself the flaming cow god of doom, until he met the minotaurs.

name: jail cell
description: This is a small, cold, stone cell. It has a crude wooden bench to lay on, and a glory-hole in the corner, but other wise the room is bare.

name: midnight sash
description: This sash is made of some type of material which feels as fine as silk, but it seems to absorb any light around it. Holding it in your hands it seems to tingle your fingers, and you can see tiny runes stitched into the thread in some alien language.

name: dented soup can
description: This can has been crafted by some mechanical technique not known to you. It has a large dent on one side, which although brusies the can itself the can still holds a full eight ounces of soup, just as it did before the dent.

name: gravestone
description: In memory of Miss Teri, who vanished mysteriously into the mist, and is missed.. rarely has the realm seen such a perfect example of charm and beauty.  We are sure wherever she found harbor is made better by her presence, and hope that the Angel watching over her fares well.

name: gravestone
description: Here lies JenGhis, Paladin Leader of the House of Lords. He served truth and justice until betrayal overcame him from an unholy idol.

name: gravestone
description: Fleet the Wise, Mage extraordinare, he was wolfbait for many moons until he discovered the secret of serpentkin, but the secret waned on his soul and he faded away.

name: gravestone
description: Cougar Darkblade, Lord Paladin, rescuer of countless who were lost in the infinite twisting passages of the labrynth.

name: gravestone
description: Here lies Rab, the rabid Ranger, twisted and demented he always had a true sense of loyalty.

name: gravestone
description: KiLee the Ranger, she had more fun romping through the forest then is healthy for any one person.

name: gravestone
description: Og Skullsplitter, his favorite food was horseapples. His last words, told in a mumbled delirum, only mentioned the taste of the last horse.

description: This is a bardic songsheet of destruction.

name: gravestone
description: Tiberius the Ninja, graceful and deadly, sleek and silent. It didn't help much against the dragonfire.

name: gravestone
description: Lying here be Kasdon, the goblin thief that stole many hearts as well as wallets. He was well loved by all and sorely missed.

name: gravestone
description: Here lies Akmad, wild warrior always on the edge. He swore to everyone he was endowed like a camel, he only showed the wrong kind of woman.

name: gravestone
description: The final resting place of Brother Luke, with patient and even hand he guided many novices through the harsher parts of the realm, he moved on in life and rests easy now.

name: gravestone
description: Here lies Lute SilverSong, Who was as tall as he is long, We will miss that halfling bard, How he made us laugh hard, But the last joke he had done, He picked the wrong someone, For it you accuse someone of the fart, It better not be Sheriff LionHeart. We Sa-Lute you Silversong!

name: gravestone
description: Raise a glass, raise a toast, Here lies Itoshu, he was made to roast, On his last visit to the black dragon.

name: gravestone
description: Jehan JDC He could always put a smile on someone's face He knew the right things to say and stood up for them He loved his family and loved his mmud Our prayers and thoughts go out to you John Rest in Peace Jehan. You will be missed.

name: gravestone
description: Here lies Conan. Many people were heard to exclaim what a mighty warrior he would be, if only he like the sword better than his ale.

name: gravestone
description: Damien Xcelcier a friend, a foe, To whom honor ment the most He stood with pride, but alas, he died. He warned us about fear, he should have been more sincere. He warned of the wrath, but it was Dark Phoenix; who got the last laugh. He will be remembered over many beer it is to him, that we say 'Cheers'

name: gravestone
description: Here lies Satire Shilligan, the warrior punk. They stabbed him forty six times before burning the corpse.

name: gravestone
description: BlueSky the mage, we miss him so, It's really too bad, that he had to go, But an  overconfident mystic, convinced him to try, To get his death pile back, and now we cry, Into the dying grove they journeyed, never to return, But got ambushed by killer bees, their poison did burn, We thought BlueSky was wise, but he messed with the hive, And we find that funny, because the mystic did survive.

name: gravestone
description: The resting place of Tomster FistsOfFury, he shaped the dark caves into his own private lair. The smell finally got to him.

name: gravestone
description: Pandabear, Paladin of the Dark Blades, always lended a hand to any in need. Tolerant and patient with those who did not heed. Done away in dead of night, by most foul and dastardly deed. Unavenged goes her death, and she will be missed.

name: gravestone
description: Rugal BlackNoah, a Kang Mageslayer that vowed to dominate the world and purify it of all that is magical. His ashes were found in the obsidian tunnels.

name: gravestone
description: Here lies Lagerhowen, Forest King of Genocide, for the women and the wine did he live, but in the end one of them did him in, nobody knows for sure which it was

name: gravestone
description: Here lies Jyhad, he always tried to start one, and ended up starting too many.

name: gravestone
description: Here lies Ares, he brought war and plunder to the innocent, ninety bounties later and his Nigrescence is no more.

name: gravestone
description: Here lies Delirium, doer of many dastardly deeds, it is said his spirit is that devilish voice whisipering in your ear.
