name: shovel
description: This is a simple shovel that has hardly been used. It is made with an oaken handle, that seems somewhat rotten, and a rusty iron blade. It could be used to dig up a few graves but anything more stressful and it could easily break.

name: jail key
description: This rusted iron key has seen many years of age, but little use. It appears by the emblem on it that its some type of offical Silvermere key for city use. On the opposite side of the emblem is the letter J which you assume would mean Jail.

name: young tree
description: This young tree has been planted decades ago and is in full bloom of its leaves. It sways lightly through the wind, the branches creaking like old bones and the whisper of leaves is quiet and relaxing.

name: nightblack portal
description: This oval rift in space pulsates with an evil, chaotic power. Negative energy leaks out and surrounds you, leaving you numb and trembling. Whatever lies beyond would be sure death for the weak, and difficult at best even for mighty heroes.

name: gambling sign
description: Play Dragon's Dice or Crowns and Skulls for lower wages, or ask for a fortune by the gypsy girl here!

name: mouthpiece
description: You see a mouthpiece used for a musical instrument made of platinum. A single rune that of an O with a swirl in the center is the only marking on it.

name: battlehorn
description: This is a simple horn of some large beast, hollowed out entirely with a mouthpiece of platinum at the tip. You see on the mouthpiece is a large O with a swirl inside the ring, a rune of perhaps but your not sure what it does.

name: red dragon tail
description: This long slender tail is aproximately 12 feet in length. Long black  spines cover it from base to tip. It  is relativly light in weight and is quite durable In the hands of a master, this tail could be crafted into a fine weapon.

name: dragon fang
description: This razor-sharp fang is about 12 inches in length. It glistens brightly in the light.  With enough strength it could tear through flesh and metal alike.

name: red dragonscale whip
description: This long slender whip is aproximately twelve feet in length. The handle is made of soft black leather which gives you excellent control. A large dragon fang is mounted at the tip of this fine whip.

name: tent
description: The blue fabric of the tent sparkles lightly in the darkness As you feel the wonderous cloth, a cool breeze flows over your body and caresses your mind.

name: tainted ruby
description: A massive ruby inset on the floor before the altar, it has a tainted, dirty, red colour to it. With horror you realize the blood from the altar is draining to tarnish the ruby. An inner flame seems to burn inside it, swaying with an odd seduction, yearning for your touch.

name: ornate dragon carving
description: Made from some ornate blackened wood, it depicts a dragon claws outstretched and flame ablaze in full splendor. A magnificent depiction it seems lifelike from the tiny eyes to the sharp fangs of the tiny maw. The carver was immensely skilled in the ways of working wood.

name: red dragon hide
description: You can tell this piece of hide came from a young dragon. Red as blood it is somewhat heavy, with small spikes jutting out in some spots. It seems to carry a warmth of its own, and you wonder if it could be used for some kind of armour.

name: red dragon gauntlets
description: This is a pair of masterly crafted gauntlets, made from the hide of a dragon. Very supple, they are soft and warm to the touch, yet give excellent protection against almost any attack.

name: red dragon leggings
description: Blood red dragonhide make up this pair of leathery leggings. Crafted by a supreme leatherworker, these leggings offer powerful protection for the lower body, and yet are very flexible.

name: red dragon tunic
description: Amazing to gaze at, this suit of red dragonhide was obviously made by the hands of a master. Spiked ridges along the back and shoulders give it an almost hellish look, making its wearer look fearsome indeed.

name: red dragon helm
description: This is a sturdy helm of red dragonhide, fashioned with superb skill. You see it has extra padding so it may protect the crown from blows with more protection then normal.

name: red dragon boots
description: This is a pair of skillfully crafted boots, made from the red hide of a dragon. They come up almost to the knee and are warm to the touch. Built for protection they are also form-fitting and very comfortable.

name: soulblighter
description: A long, slightly curved blade of red meets a hilt fashioned from the yellowed bone of some dead animal. The blade gives off a glow giving everything a macabre shine of blood. An inscription on the blade reads
. As you read it a foul raspy voice seems to whisper in your ear words of great power and damnation.

name: cruel bone greatsword
description: The bone of some massive animal, this sword is immensely heavy and hard to wield. Jagged ridges climb up either side of the bone's sharpened edges, which could cause immense wounds. The hilt is made of some strange, blackened metal with the skull of some animal on the pommel.

name: blackened unicorn horn
description: Wretched and evil, this three-foot-long horn emanates an aura of damnation. As black as night it twists and turns before coming to a blood tinged tip that is needle sharp and just as deadly. Because it is so twisted it is somewhat unwieldy, however it would still make an excellently vile weapon.

name: farming hoe
description: A six foot long wooden pole attaches to a flat metal blade to form this implement of soil destruction. A simple farming tool, it can be used for a weapon in a pinch.

name: runed farming hoe
description: Six feet of blackwood attach to a black glittering metal blade. Fiery runes are etched all along the farming tool and glow with a rhythm of its own. You can only assume some mage was a farmer in a previous job and created this for some purpose. You at least hope it was a sane mind.

name: rusty scythe
description: This long curved blade is wicked in appearance for such a benign tool. Stretched out from a curved handle like a ragged, bloody claw, this farming instrument has seen better days and those days were many ages ago. While immensely slow it could cut many a limb off with dreadful precision.

name: deck of cards
description: A simple deck of traveling cards, they have the stiffness of cards never used before. Simple patterns adorn the backs, while individual hand-painted pictures have been placed with expert care on the face of each card. According to myth card decks have been used to turn the tides of fortunes by gypsies while traveling abroad.

name: faded shawl
description: This is an ancient piece of cloth with holes almost showing in spots. Once brightly colored with checkers of green and brown it has seen decades of use and wear. It gives very little protection and you wonder if it could be of any use at all.

name: withered walking stick
description: A small stick, once the branch of some tree, is now almost petrified from the many ages it has seen. Dirt covers it from tip to handle and you can tell from the scratches and cuts that the many miles it has seen have not been kind. Something about this stick gives you a tingle.

name: bloodwood chest
description: A chest that sends shivers down your spine it is a chest made of some ancient wood that appears to be stained with fresh blood. Foul runes are etched all along the sides and even more archaic symbols adorn the handles and lock.

name: vorpal hatchet
description: This is a strange axe made of a metal which glitters as if it were silver, but is blacker then the heart of a fiend. Designed for quick and deadly cuts, it appears that with the slightest swing it could dismember an opponent very easily.

name: sunburst necklace
description: Inlaid with bright gold that almost shines with its own light this necklace one of the finest works youve ever seen. In the image of a glorious sunburst that has risen with the new day to destroy the night with the light of purification. On each chain link of the necklace is a symbol from some sacred archaic tongue.

name: platinum plate leggings
description: This is pair of heavy plate greaves, made using the purest platinum you have ever seen. They are extremely thick and provide excellent leg protection. They almost shine with an inner glow of magic.

name: jewel-encrusted warhammer
description: More a treasure then an actual weapon, jewels of all shapes adorn this weapon. Sapphires, emeralds, rubies and diamonds glitter all around this massive hammer of war. Jewels are inlaid so thick that it is not possible to tell what it is made of underneath.

name: Darkbane
description: A long slender blade crafted in a fashion long lost to modern day. The name Darkbane is written in gold, and the entire sword seems to glow with its own sublime divinity. A platinum dragon, with wings outstretched, has been crafted to be the hilt of this shining blade. It moves through the air with a great flash of white, singing a hymn of prayer.

name: fur cloak
description: This large cloak is made from a thick white pelt that feels like velvet. It is thick and durable, but also heavy. The cloak was hand crafted by villagers living near a snow topped mountain range and designed to provide extra protection from the elements in winter.

name: fur gloves
description: The insides of these gloves are tanned to a soft and supple consistency, to allow freedom of movement for your fingers. The velvety white hair on the outside has been cut short enough to allow more dexterous movements, while still being thick enough to provide protection from the climate.

name: silvery spiked corselet
description: This finely crafted platemail is fashioned from a silver that has a white and pure innocence to it. You can find no dents or scratches on the metal, as if it had never been fashioned by mortal hand. The only markings found is a simple holy symbol inscribed on each individual plate and many large spikes that protrude from the shoulder.

name: longsword
description: This is a three-foot length of sharpened cold steel, bladed along one edge. Its blade is thin, and designed for thrusting. Overall, this is a good weapon.

name: ethereal dagger
description: Made of some smoking, glass-like, material this dagger is almost weightless to hold. Cold to touch it almost leaves a misty trail through the air. Glittering with a deadly gleam this supernatural weapon could become useful.

name: brimstone hammer
description: This great sledge reeks of sulphur and ash. A massive rock, black as night sits atop a long metal handle to make a crude but effective cudgel. Black writing is scripted on the head that seems to writhe and dance. The hammerhead litters ash around your feet. You know not where this hammer came from, but you can tell it is for immense destruction and evil.

name: bloodstone ring
description: This ring is made of four black iron bands, intertwined to appear as if it were actually a small claw. Cradled inside the claw is a stone the color of blood, with small flecks of blackness that seems to swirl in its depths. For some reason watching the swirling makes your stomach twinge and you almost have to look away before you become dizzy.

name: dark onyx ring
description: A ring of pure blackness grasps an even darker onyx stone. The ring is cold to touch, and seems to turn the air around you colder still. You find putting this ring on dims your vision, as if you were closing your eyes to sneeze and had not yet opened them.

name: scarlet doublet
description: No finer doublet have you ever seen then this piece of superb sewmanship. Normally worn by noblemen, you pinch the fabric and realize it is several thousand miniscule chains interlinked together. An excellent a deception as any, this could be worn to look like normal clothes but in truth protect as well as any hauberk.

name: executioner's hood
description: A massive black hood, wrought of black cloth. It is used fully hide the face of anyone wearing it so they made commit murderous deeds with their identity secret. Two narrow slits are the only openings and a vile rune, stitched with some glittering black thread, sits atop the crown of the death mask. Only one of evil intentions would consider this hood.

name: black stained tunic
description: A tunic made of cotton, dyed a deep, unending black. It is entirely unremarkable except for the dark stains that mark the shirt. Splotched all over there is no pattern to them other then they appear to have been splashed on the tunic. Upon closer inspection you realize the stains are blood, giving you a slight chill up your back.

name: heavy black boots
description: Thick black leather make up this large pair of boots. The skin is so rigid you would think it were iron but for the supple feel of tanned skin. Covering from toe to shin it seems to have a menacing look to them, an unending well of blackness as if it were going to stomp mountains into the ground. Small spikes jut from around the sole.

name: red rose
description: An illustrious shade of red paints this rose a magnificent color in any light. Freshly cut it is still full of life, as if it inhales the air around it with a new breath each time. In full bloom the petals seem a delicate piece of glass, together making a masterpiece only nature can create.

name: black rose
description: Midnight petals hug the stem of this freshly cut rose. Soft to the touch that it almost feels like down, it is so pretty in its dark richness it almost brings a tear to your eye. Legend holds that black roses are the most rare and are desired for magic if not true beauty.

name: burning black feather
description: This feather burns darkly from a great fire. You fear as if your skin will blister the moment your hand touches it.

name: vibrant scroll
description: This parchment is a radiant sight to see. In strange patterns, every colour of the rainbow reflects from it, while the blackened magi letters seem to stay bold and unwavering.

name: rolled parchment
description: Thorand, dire times have caused the writing of this letter. The fortress is weakening, and Xarthick has fallen to temptation, the she-devil has gotten to him. If you have any one that can aid us, send them now. I do not think we can last another fortnight. Give them this parchment so my men know not to fight them, they do not trust anyone else.

name: throwing hammers
description: This well-balanced, sturdy pair of light hammers make a poweful weapon at close range. Crafted by dwarven smiths, it has been told that hammers like these were used in combat to support skirmishing troops.

name: diamond-encrusted bracelet
description: Beautiful diamonds surround a metal band to create a gorgeous bracelet of incredible splendor. It glitters brightly, almost blinding you. No inscription or insignia can be found anywhere on the arm-wear.

name: elven harp
description: This exquisite golden harp is crafted with intricate swirling patterns. Its strings are fine and well-strung, and the melody that it plays when its strings are plucked is heavenly.

name: blackened bracelet
description: A circlet of some type of burnt metal it is impossible to tell what it was before being made so crudely. Bizzarre carvings dance around the large metal ring.

name: nightblack scythe
description: This huge, heavy scythe is as black as eternal night, and radiates a strange aura of death. Its shaft is set with ivory skulls, its blade is long, curved, and sharp as a razor. A sense of evil invades your senses, and you feel as if gazing at this grisly weapon taints your soul.

name: bone ring
description: This is a simple ring made of many small bones tied together to form a circle. Easily fitting most fingers, an ebony skull is imprinted upon the largest bone.

name: bone club
description: This large club has been fashioned from the rib-bone of some mammoth beast, dead long ago. The head of the club is covered with jagged spikes, and large protrusions that could do a great deal of damage to its victim.

name: blackwood cudgel
description: A crude weapon, it has been fashioned somewhat from the root of some great blackwood tree. It is very thick, with twine tide around it's narrow end to form a simple handle. The base of the cudgel is very thick with knots causing its target to bruise heavily if not break.

name: rod of might
description: A rod made from simple iron, it seems almost weightless to hold. A single marking is the only thing remarkable about this tool of a ruler. It radiates a certain serenity about you and piece of mind. This must be the symbol of some great and powerful lord from long ago, the last remnant of an extinct dynasty of order that fell to the chaos.

name: blackwood longbow
description: A cruelly fashioned longbow, it looks to be made from blackwood. The wood has been stained with some dark red fluid, and the bowstring seems to draw with great speed. A quiver does not accompany the bow and a practice draw forms an arrow of darkness. Vile runes are carved on the front of the bowshaft, that writhe in a twisted dance.

name: reading glasses
description: This is a pair of simple reading glasses, known to be worn by scholars and librarians of old. You note that there is a second lens inlaid within each frame.

name: blackwood war-spear
description: This menacing black spear has a three-foot long shaft made of blackwood. It feels as hard as any metal and you suspect some type of red resin has been used to harden its edge, as the wood seems to have a reddish tinge. The jagged head looks to be the fang of some savage beast, long, curved and sharp enough to slice a finger with a wrong move.

name: scarab necklace
description: A necklace of elaborate design, it is made up of twelve golden scarabs. Each one looks as if it had been alive, and dipped into the liquid metal. A single sygil is marked on each insect. Ancient myth tells of a necklace such as this protecting the wearer from most things terrifying.

name: templar greatsword
description: This is a long, heavy blade, made from some pristine metal. Sharp and deadly, it is bladed on both sides. A golden cross is imprinted on the hilt, and you see holy symbols written around the cross. On the blade itself it also has written

name: beastly claws
description: Formerly belonging to some dreadful beast, these claws look as though they could slash through skin with chilling ease. The claws themselves are attached to a pair of large, severed hands that have been hollowed out somehow by unnatural means. The sickening thought enters your mind that you could use these claws as a weapon by wearing the skin.

name: feather-tipped hat
description: A hat made from some rich, fine leather, it is the color of royal purple. A smooth silk band encricles the hat, keeping a bright, flamboyant, feather in place. Trying to identify the color of the feather only makes your head hurt as it seems to be constantly changing colors through the entire spectrum.

name: displacer fur cloak
description: The skin of a displacer beast, fashioned into a warm cloak. Magic of the creature has not left since it's death so the wearer will appear like a fleeting cat, always one step away from harm. A very powerful piece of magic.

name: mithril executioner's axe
description: This huge axe has a gigantic, single-edged blade crafted from pure mithril. Its fine edge could cut stone as easily as flesh, due to such cruelty in combat it is only useable by those soley dedicated to evil. While it is large and heavy, the blade moves marvelously quick.

name: burnt iron chest
description: This large, heavy chest is made of black iron, which has been polished so that the container gleams like a beetle's carapace. A hideous demonic face has been carved into its lid, and it is obvious that the chest is full of valuables.

name: elven longbow
description: This beautifully-made longbow appears to be made of glowing Bronzewood, a sure sign of Elven origin. Graceful runes have been carved along its length, and it's string hums vibrantly as you pull it with ease. A quiver of green accompanies the bow, full of silver-feathered arrows, eager for use.

name: crimson scalemail tunic
description: Hundreds of crimson discs have been sewn into this suit of armor. Each disc is of some strange metal and has been stamped with a crimson flame. It feels lightweight but the metal looks very strong for protection.

name: crimson scalemail leggings
description: This pair of leather pants are made of some type of black animal skin, with diamond-shaped crimson pieces sown around the front and back of the leather. The discs appear to be of some type of alien metal, and each piece has a flame stamped upon them.

name: crimson helm
description: Fashioned from some crimson metal, this helm looks durable enough to take on the worst punishment. It has a noseguard fashioned from obsidian yet it does not seem to hinder vision in the slightest. The symbol of an open flame is stamped on the brow of the helm, the mark of its maker.

name: large sign
description: This is a large wooden pole with three ancient slabs nailed to it. Through the faded writing you can see a black arrow pointing east with the words
. Another faded arrow points north, with
inscripted on it. The last arrow is more ominous, written in fresh red ink, scraggled on it displays the words

name: dragonfang ninjato
description: A magnificent one-handed sword. It is slightly curved with a dangerous edge. The blade radiates a spectrum. It is colored oddly, red, blue, green and black, all blending to form an intricate design. The hilt is fashioned to make it appear as if the ninjato was the breath of a dragon, mouth agape.

name: great blackwood chest
description: A large chest of unremarkable creation. Thick blackwood surrounds the contents of this chest, and a simple iron lock. The weight of the blackwood makes it immensely heavy.

name: anointed morningstar
description: A platinum rod connects a chain of finest silver to a large barbed diamond ball. Incantations of divine power encircle the diamond, protecting it from shattering, while dealing swift and brutal justice to any and all villiany. The weapon moves swiftly and with ease, as if it were an extension of your arm. Its spikes are like the fangs of a coiled viper.

name: diamond longsword
description: A long blade of a single cut diamond shines brightly with an inner light. You are basked with a holy glow as you gaze along the holy prayers inscripted along the three foot long blade. platinum has been forged to form the hilt of this sword. A sunburst of gold is drawn masterfully on the pommel.

name: Holy Wrath and Righteous Fury
description: Two longswords, twin in every fashion, meant only for use in combination with the other. Ivory hilts embossed with gold meet glowing white blades made of almost pure and holy might. Sacred symbols are written like flowing grace and beauty. On one blade it is written
and on the twin it is written

name: spiritual warhammer
description: Myths have told of great and powerful priests creating the embodiment of a weapon to fight all that is wretched. This is such a weapon. Created from some holy power, it seems metallic, yet weighs nothing. The heavens seem instilled in its handle and head, and you can faintly hear the chant of holy prayer, tickling your senses with a divine presence.

name: white gold flail
description: This great flail is made of the purest white metal. Silver and gold symbols of holy power are etched into the four spiked heads, each one bearing righteous wrath and fury upon the unfaithful. Many a good soul must test their virtue each day to use such a weapon.

name: great mithril battle-hammer
description: This large, two-handed sledgehammer is made from the purest ore of mithril you have yet seen. It looks somewhat unwieldy and slow, yet it seems to move with ease. Runes are stamped along the handle, written in flowing platinum. A massive holy symbol is stamped on the head, showing the crafter made it for fighting against evil and only for the just to wield.

name: iron wand
description: This foot-long wand is fashioned from thick black iron. It is entirely unremarkable except for the clear, silvery blue rune that has been carved on the head of the wand.

name: platinum greathelm
description: This is a massive helm of platinum that once belonged to a knight or noble lord. It still shines brightly and it seems to tell a story of chivalry and deeds of valour.

name: diamond scimitar
description: You see a magnificent weapon of platinum and diamond. The single cut of diamond is three and a half feet long, and slightly curved. The blade is razor-sharp with silver runes scripted by some priest or saint to show this blade as holy. The hilt is platinum with a sunburst of gold as the pommel.

name: Solarblade
description: This swift golden blade shines as if it holds the power of the sun. Three feet in length, it moves with blinding speed, a golden wave of death. The hilt is made from pure white pearl with silver lettering of divine power inscribed on the crosspiece. Weaving it through the air it makes a loud hum, seething with righteous power.

name: moonstone rod
description: This rod of moonstone glows a spectrum of pale blue, white and gold. Three feet in length, it is engraved with silver markings that run along the rod. At one end of the rod you see it is wrapped in some type of silver metal to use as a grip for this crushing weapon.

name: Angel's talon
description: This dagger is over two feet in length. Large for its size, it is somewhat quick to wield. It looks to be made of ivory but it has an almost hidden beauty not found in earthen stones. The blade is somewhat curved to appear like that of a talon. A golden sunburst is engraved on the pommel of the silver hilt.

name: white oaken staff
description: This is a six-foot-long staff fashioned from some white oak tree. It is carved to appear like a ring of angels dances up around the staff until at the top sits a sunburst of gold.

name: obsidian trident
description: Three prongs of obsidian stick froth from a shaft of burnt silverwood. Two-handed it is somewhat heavy to wield, yet the prongs look to be crafted to dole out the most pain of traditional weapons. A single crimson flame is stamped on each spearhead, showing the markings of some lost order.

name: Demonslayer
description: This is similar to the longsword, but is double-edged and is heavier. The blade is made of some strange crimson metal, that almost seems to dull your sense to touch. The hilt is fashioned from silver, with a single crimson flame stamped on the pommel.

name: Judicator
description: This heavy-looking hammer appears painful in the capable hands. Fashioned of some crimson metal, it dulls your senses as you touch it. Created by a master it is flawless in weight and speed. A single crimson flame is stamped on the head, and under it, in ancient tongue are the words

name: ruby staff
description: Carved from a maple, this six-foot staff shines as if freshly polished. A large blood red ruby sits atop the head of the staff, a faint humming sound can be heard from it. Strange red runes encircle the staff from the foot to the head, each glowing of their own accord.

name: ivory crozier
description: This staff of ivory radiates holy power. Bronze runes run along its length, radiating a bright glow. An angel crafted from gold shines from atop the crozier, wings outspread it points to the heavens. Under the angel are holy words of prayer.

name: amber pearl earrings
description: This pair of small amber earrings have been crafted to cradle a pearl, looking as though they were a pair of rain drops. The pearls seem to waver in front of you, but it could be a trick on your vision.

name: fur boots
description: These boots are made from a thick white pelt, that feels almost like velvet. Thick and very durable, they reach to the knee. Warm and snug they would allow one to traverse wintery conditions.

name: brown leather boots
description: This is a pair of brown leather boots. They come up to the middle of the shin, and look durable enough for long walks. On the toe of each boots a lightning bolt has been branded.

name: winged boots
description: This pair of boots have been masterfully fashioned from white leather. Soft to the touch, they look incredibly durable, and a pair of golden wings have been imprinted on the side of each boot, next to the heel.

name: bleeding main-gauche
description: This long parrying knife appears to have come from some crazed dream. Blood constantly drips from the blade and hand guard and is a horrid sight to behold. You wonder what awful magics are at work with this guard, and can think only one of vile mind would think to grasp it.

name: onyx earrings
description: Dark onyx set against an ebony backing make up this pair of earrings. Crafted with great percision and expertise, these show no sign of tarnish or age. Obviously of great value, these earrings may be of vast worth at a jeweler.

name: battered chainmail hauberk
description: It is evident from initial inspection that the wearer of this tunic met with a grisly end. Missing links, large holes and countless nicks and scratches show this tunic has gone through several untold battles. Despite this, it looks protective for someone desperate enough in battle.

name: serrated spiked shield
description: This medium shield was crafted with pain in mind. A large spike protrudes from the center, and several serrated barbs stick out from the front and sides of the shield, giving the holder a fearsome look in combat.

name: black velvet gloves
description: This is a pair of simple gloves made of a black velvet. Soft and warm, they have a tingling feeling when touched. On the palm of each glove is the image of a red eye.

name: crimson earrings
description: Small crimson discs entwine around two thick adamantite hoops.  On each disc a tiny flame insignia has been stamped.

name: star helm
description: Made of pure starsteel, or adamant as it was called by the ancients, this huge helm is a very strange sight indeed. A small oval covers the entire face of the bearer, shielding the front of the skull, as well as protecting the eyes, it is said the bearer sees only by the holy light of his faith. Twelve golden tendrils jut out of the top and rear. one for each member of the great council of paladins.

name: turquoise ring
description: This elaborately-carved platinum ring is set with a small turquoise stone. The band is made to ressemble intertwined vines, with small leaves forming the clasps which hold the stone.

name: silverwood helm
description: This leather helm has been fastened with a covering of deep silverwood bark. While heavier then regular helms it also vastly increases protection against blows to the head. A single blue sigil has been carved into the bark, above the crown of the helm.

name: cobra earrings
description: This is a strange pair of earrings, designed to resemble the head of a cobra. The eyes of the snakes are made by polished areas on the fine mithril earrings, and the fangs are made by sharpened rubies. They attach to the ears with loops of thin mithril wire.

name: Caladbolg
description: This sword property of the ElfGod.

name: shadowy portal
description: This rift appears as though it were a vertical pool of shadowy black ink. A chill seems to flow from its edges, consuming all light, and making your entire body ache with its warmth-sucking embrace. There is no telling where this may take you, but it appears to be your only exit.

name: iron key
description: This is a heavy iron key. Its handle is crafted to form a circle, allowing easy storage.

name: ancient blackwood heart
description: An ancient wooden heart, so black it is almost cancerous. Dirt still clings to it like a second skin and a stench seems to arise from it intermittently. It still feels very warm to your touch as if it still held life inside of it.

name: white oak forest
description: You gaze at one of the many trees standing before you. As you look closer you see the leaves are a mix of gold and silver, giving the ancient oak a strange glow. Its branches reaching to the sky it looks like a great victorious king, returned from a battle of vanquished evil.

name: white oak forest
description: You gaze at one of the many trees standing before you. As you look closer you see the leaves are a mix of gold and silver, giving the ancient oak a strange glow. Its branches reaching to the sky it looks like a great victorious king, returned from a battle of vanquished evil.

name: jagged bone key
description: This key looks to be the chipped fingerbone of something long dead. It is extremely yellowed and almost seems petrified. The sharp edges look as if they could easily pierce the flesh of anyone using it.

name: rotted book
description: Age has not treated this book well, you can barely read the title:
You open it and find a single coherent passage...

name: black leather book
description: A tightly bound black leather volume, no writing can be seen on the outside, as if something had burnt off any lettering. You open the book and find a passage.

name: molding parchment
description: Parchment written on paper now molding with age, you can only interpret the following before the scroll becomes unreadable...

name: plain scroll
description: A plain scroll made of simple paper, it appears to be some sort of official document from years ago...

name: tattered manual
description: A training manual from long ago, it is written in old tongue you open it and decipher the following...

name: ebony scroll
description: Bound in bright crimson string this parchment of night seems dull and unremarkable, letting loose the string you read..

name: yellowed parchment
description: A bright yellow parchment, written with black ink, it unrolls easily and you read the following...

description: Many years are stacked on the pages of this great and massive tome, the front reads

name: massive black gem
description: This gem is finest cut diamond you have seen in your life of adventure. It seems to pulse with a deep, seductive blackness, each one throbbing your temple, pounding against the back of your skull. You find it hard to resist the urge to grasp the gem and claim it as your own.

name: long golden chain
description: This is a long, extremely thin chain of bright gold. It has been threaded with some strange red material that almost makes it look like blood has stained this chain. A clasp at one end has been broken off, but it looks like it could be repaired by skilled hands.

name: silver key
description: This simple silver key still gleams brightly despite it's obvious age. Made with the curves, and teeth of ages long past, you assume it belongs to someone with a long heritage to have such an old item.

name: pew
description: A plain church pew, with a simple cushion spanning its length. It looks to be made of oak, and still smells faintly of it. There is nothing remarkable about this seat of faith.

name: ship's wheel
description: Aged beyond recognition this wheel that steers the ship has degenerated into a skeletal circle of large splinters. The ghostly magic that charges the ship keeps it together however and it seems to be steering itself by some unknown command or by the will of the ship itself.

name: chipped obsidian key
description: A large key fashioned from obsidian shows signs of use in the jagged marks and scars along its edge. The teeth have been chipped someone, and you are sure this key is totally worthless.

name: platinum key
description: A small key made of platinum it seems to weigh as much as a feather. Something is enscripted on the key, but it is not in a language you recognize. worthless.

name: angelic statue
description: A large marble statue stands before you, a sculpture of some angelic figure clutching a book as if it were more important then life itself. A silver plaque has been clawed and scratched as if blotting out any mention to which the statue was ment to honor.

name: scholarly statue
description: An ancient stone statue, fashioned many centuries ago stands here. You presume the statue is meant to honor a specific scholar that belonged to the library long ago, but time has not been merciful and the statue is almost beyond recognition of any sort. A large stone book is grasped by the statue, a title was once chiseled onto the cover.

name: mage statue
description: Enduring granite has somehow kept this statue from disrepair, though the age of centuries can still be seen in the layer of dust upon it. Carved into that of some great and powerful mage, he points his finger northward, as if releasing powerful magic to the oncoming darkness.

name: blue book
description: The cover of this book has a strange feel to it, as if it were made of feathers. The wooden cover tingles at your fingertips, and you hastily open it to the first page...

name: ancient parchment
description: An ancient scroll, written many ages ago, it crinkles as you grasp it, the dry page beginning to flake away from your touch.

name: ruined book
description: This book may once have held the secret to life, the secrets of the realm, and everything thereafter, but it is now a novel of dust, with pages flaking into nothingness as soon as you grab it.

name: ancient scroll
description: Time has finally gotten the best of this scripture to knowledge. As soon as you unravel the scroll you see the ink has faded beyond recognition and the scroll itself is about to crumble.

name: crimson tome
description: Crimson wood surrounds the pages of this scripture. A symbol of a large flame adorns the cover, and it faintly smells of incense. You open it to the first pages.

name: black book
description: It is hard to tell if this book has ever been opened. Not a spot of dust covers the entire manual and the pages look crisp and fresh. Spidery runes decorate the front and sides of the manual, you open it to the first page and read:

name: blackened scripture
description: This book looks immensely burnt and clawed in several places you are unsure if the contents can even be deciphered. You open it anyway and find a single legible page...

description: A tightly bound black leather volume, no writing can be seen on the outside, as if something had burnt off any lettering. You open the book and find a passage...

description: A red book with odd lettering on the wooden cover, you open it and read the following...

description: A blue book with odd lettering on the wooden cover, you open it and read the following...

name: red leather book
description: A large leather book dyed red, it bears a large yellow flame on the cover, encircled by birds flying in a clockwise pattern. On the spine of the book are the letters
You open it and turn to the following...

name: ruined book
description: This book may once have held the secret to life, the secrets of the realm, and everything thereafter, but it is now a novel of dust, with pages flaking into nothingness as soon as you grab it.

name: death shroud
description: This weightless death shroud barely appears to exist in this world, fading in and out of view. The very fabric carries the smell of death upon it, as well as a taint of supereme evil.

name: sign
description: This is a strange sign showing runes written in a dark ink. Though you can not decipher what is said you can tell that it seems to be a sign of warding, specifically banishing something or someone from entrance into this encampment.

name: cot
description: Mold has ravaged this cot giving it a look of a sickly green shade. You can tell it hasn't been used for many years but you are unsure who would have found it comfortable at all.

name: bulletin board
description: FILE DESCRIPTION WCCRULES.BUL

name: coffin
description: A plain coffin, made of thick granite. Dust is caked on top of the coffin in a thick layer. Until now no one has disturbed this final resting place, and as the hair on your neck stabs you like needles, you begin to consider leaving it be.

name: Flamemasher
description: A large hammer, magically fashioned from hot magma with a black steel handle. The magma is shaped like the head of a massive warhammer, waves of blistering heat flow from the hammer. A set of black and white scales are the only markings on this weapon.

name: paired dragonblades
description: Twin blades, masterfully crafted, they have been honed to a razor-sharp edge. One is pure white, with glowing blue scales that make it look like a serpentine tail. The other is black with a dark red pall to it, glowing in counter with its white twin. A small dragons claw make up the hilt of each blade. The white holds a jet, the black a diamond.

name: sapphire chakram
description: A razor-sharp circle that shines with immense power. It has been crafted to appear as if a large white serpent and large black serpent were fighting over two sapphires, crafted opposite of each other. Suddenly a wave of electricity runs through the circle from one sapphire to the next. Etched on each gem is a scale of balance.

name: Frosthand
description: Your bones chill merely gazing at this instrument of destruction. Almost clear it is a large mace fashioned from ice. Gold runes are chipped into the ice, deep under the surface of the galacial globe. Fashioned around the rod of cold is a piece of leather wrapped around it so that one may hold the weapon without immediate frostbite.

name: stone warhammer
description: Black and white runes are inscripted on this massive sledge of stone. Made from some type of granite, its color is so dull it seems to flow out and shade everything around it. A pair of scales have been written on the head of this weapon of stone, making it the only markings that you see.

name: hammers of balance
description: Two hammers of adamantite, a matching pair of power and strength. The head of one hammer is crafted of diamond, a sunburst of gold imprinted upon it. A piece of jet sits atop the other hammer, a crimson skull imprinted as well. They appear as if crafted in pure unison, never to be used apart.

name: Windblade
description: Lightning erupts from this weapon as if it had struck down from the clouds and stuck itself to the steel hilt. Furious power streaks around the sword, as if in a constant struggle over the blade, weaving around like a coiled serpent. Untouched by this struggle is a large sapphire on its pommel a grey stamp of scales the only markings upon it.

name: petrified mace
description: A mace fashioned from wood has now been aged into stone, it has been fashioned to appear as if two snakes were intertwining to grasp the head of the mace in either maw. Despite the heavy look it is very light to wield.

name: acid slasher
description: A blade of magical acid is grafted to a silver hilt. The blade drips large goblets of flesh-eating acid on the ground causing a hissing to sound. On the pommel of the hilt is the symbol of a black and white snake intertwining, devouring each other in an eternal struggle.

name: staff of scales
description: A long staff fashioned from an alien material, it has been carved to appear as if two long snakes were intwined with each other, pointing opposite of the other.

name: jeweled dirk
description: Onyx and diamonds of all sizes decorate the hilt of this dirk. The short thick black is crafted of silver, with many runes adorning the blade. The edge is razor sharp that could easily cut through flesh or armor, at the base of the blade is a black and white serpent intwined.

name: MagiRavager
description: This massive greatsword shows the hands of a master smith in its creation. Made from some strange crimson metal, it moves with incredible quickness for a blade its size. Touching the sword dulls your sense and you see the stamp of a flame upon the base of the blade. You can also see written
in ancient tongue.

name: vorpal cutlass
description: A three foot blade crafted from an unknown metal, glittering as if silver, yet black as nightfall. The blade is slightly curved to allow for quick, precise strikes that would leave a foe in pieces. A crimson flame has been stamped on the blade.

name: jeweled maul
description: A large crimson metal rod of eight foot length attaches to a massive round ball encrusted with onyx and diamonds. It looks impossible to lift, but somehow it is manageable, you find nothing significant about the gems, other then they seem to have been treated by some chemical to be solid and unbreakable. Defintely a weapon that could splat most foes.

name: medal of flame
description: This medal has been formed into the a flame from some type of alien, white metal. Crimson paint has been used to colour it in spots, and inscribed upon it are the words:

name: sacrificed body
description: This is the body of a creature of unknown race, its skin melted away, a milky fluid covering it. Its flesh is embedded with pale, oval-shaped eggs the colour of maggots, though they have all been broken and ooze liquid. It is impossible to determine who, or what, the body once was.

name: levers
description: Two iron levers, side by side clearly show the abuse they've taken from the many scars and scratches upon their shaft. Left and right, they both look protrude here in an upper position, but they look easy enough to manipulate downard.

name: red leather book
description: A large leather book dyed red, it bears a large yellow flame on the cover, encircled by birds flying in a clockwise pattern. On the spine of the book are the letters
You open it and turn to the following...

name: golden box
description: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: silver box
description: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: sealed letter
description: Once pristine parchment is now stained with a mixture of dirt, sweat and blood. Yet the seal of the letter, that of a cat eye inside a rising sun, seems fresh and new.

name: small vial
description: This small glass vial is filled with a shimmering green elixir. It is closed by a simple cork stopper.

name: songsheet of swiftness
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Swiftness.

name: songsheet of force
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Force.

name: songsheet of knowledge
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Knowledge.

name: songsheet of sageness
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Sageness.

name: fingerbone key
description: This small, fragile-looking key appears to be made of bone.

name: ancient tapestry
description: within the picture seems to draw you in.

name: Deathweaver
description: This long blade is made of pure black metal and is extremely cold to the touch. Underneath the shine of the weapon you think you almost see helpless faces howling in agony. You then notice serrations in the blade itself, almost as if it were to drink the blood of its victims.

name: skull flail
description: Fashioned by evil hands this weapon would strike fear in the weak. A long, black rod carries spikes of its own, even as its spiked chains are attached to three humanoid skulls, each one polished to a sickly shine. A single crimson rune has been carved into each skull, glowing with a vile light.

name: demonic pitchfork
description: This long, nightblack two-tined pitchfork radiates an aura of palpable evil. The shaft's metallic surface is engraved with all manner of twisted, hideous faces. The three teeth at the end are curved and sharp as demon's horns, the middle tooth being the longest.

name: AngelCrusher
description: Hellish runes dance along this evil weapon. Black draconian wings sprout from the handle to form opposing hammerheads. Crimson markings are seen all along the entire weapon, no doubt signs of the many evils that have been enclosed into the black iron of this crusher of angels.

name: netherworld hammer
description: This massive, heavy weapon is crafted from the essence of tortured souls. Their low moans continually escape from the grotesquely shifting surface of the hammer, and the stink of rot and burning flesh exudes from every pore of the weapon. A single crimson fang is carved into the top of the head.

name: flail of oblivion
description: This heavy flail sports eight whirling, spiked heads. It is made from a light silvery metal, which gleams with a brilliant shine. The vortex flail can be swung with blinding speed for its size, its multiple heads spinning in deadly arcs. Each spiked head has the marking of a crimson skull.

name: abyssal scimitar
description: This curved blade looks as if a nightless sky were used to craft it. Light is swallowed up by the edge and yet a deadly shine seems to dance along the length. Black iron has been used to fashion a simple hilt to this weapon of evil. A taint seems ever-present with this scimitar, and a low shriek can be heard as the weapon slides through the air.

name: Demontongue
description: This long whip is alight with unholy fire. Crafted from the skin of some underworld beast, spikes jut from the entire length of the whip, each one bearing a tiny wisp of a dark red flame. A massive cluster of spikes and beastly fangs end the dark weapon, surely causing suffering to any victim that it was used upon.

name: Soulwaste
description: Dark runes dance along this weapon of black iron. Slightly curved, the blade is very well balanced with a razor sharp edge. A small skull is set in the pommel, a crimson rune clearly marked upon it. The smell of ash invades your nose and grasping it seems to cause the hilt to graft to your skin with unnautral glee.

name: darkbone staff
description: The long dark bone of some hellish beast clutches a pulsing bloodstone at its top. Created from evil forces, sharp pieces of bone jut from all around the staff, causing enhanced pain for any that would be struck by its evil. The bloodstone swirls with each pulse, dark and crimson fluids moving in time, as if it were a beating heart.

name: bloodkrys
description: Nearly the size of a shortsword, this weapon is permenantly stained from the blood and gore of former victims. From the large jagged edges along the blade it looks that it could be easily baptised again. Under the blood you can see the black blade has a smooth, almost bright shine to it, a long serpentine letter wriggles under your scrutiny.

name: Magus Ripper
description: A long serrated talon gives this scythe a very sinister appearance. Crafted from a strange crimson metal, the blade is held by a large metal haft, ancient words scripted along its length. One of the words you catch

name: serrated bone war-spear
description: A large bone, three-feet in length has been used to craft this weapon of cruelty. Jagged ridges surround the head of the spear, formed to cause great agony and bleeding to any foe unwise enough to challenge the wielder. The butt of the spear has been hollowed out to appear like that of a skull.

name: crimson-hilted morningstar
description: This large, heavy weapon has a brightly enameled red hilt, and its thick black iron chain is attached to a wickedly- barbed ball. Crude runes have been engraved into every surface, and it seems extremely cool to the touch.

name: shreaded tapestry
description: You can tell this was once a piece of fine tapestry, but that would have been ages ago. Now it is a pile of shreaded and tattered thread. Despite its poor condition you can still make out a picture in the tapestry. It is that of a person climbing into a pile of shreaded tapestry, as if it were some kind of portal.

name: hangman's noose
description: This is a long piece of rope, tied together into a formation commonly known of as a hangman's noose. The circular bottom is wide enough so that almost any head could fit in it.

name: songsheet of enlightenment
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Enlightenment.

name: enigma gloves
description: Several pieces of coloured, stiff, cloth have been wrapped to form a pair of myriad gloves. The straps have been shaped in bizarre patterns that almost seem to throw you into a rapture. On each glove, the symbol of the Kai Lords glows a bright crimson.

name: blue portal
description: A large rectangle hangs in midair, a rippling pool of blue light. A golden aura shines about it, little can be seen of the other side, but there is no feeling of malevolence or evil from the rift.

name: spectral shroud
description: This weightless death shroud barely appears to exist in this world, fading in and out of view and giving off strange energy.

name: amber sceptre
description: Three feet in length, this sceptre has an odd glow to it, as if dimming and shining in its own pattern. Strange, unusual markings adorn it on all sides, and a shining ball stands atop its circular head. Great power seems to surge forth, and you sense a heat that emanates from the grip.

name: silverwood staff
description: This elegant staff is a living branch of the silverwood trees, long and slender and warm with life. Starting halfway up the shaft and continuing to its end, stars of all shape and size have been carved into the wood and have been coloured gold, with no apparent damage to the living wood. The silverwood staff radiates a palpable magical aura.

name: crimson blood robes
description: The strong scent of old blood covers these robes as if it were woven with the fabric. Perverse runes have been written into the the hem and back of the robe, with hellish visions and evil rites covering other parts. Wickedness radiates from this cloth, and only such a mind could consider wearing it.

name: vortex staff
description: This long staff is made of a strange metallic silver, which has a myraid shine to it. Strange sparkles shimmer along its shaft, as if it held stars inside its metal confines. The image of a circular wave sits at the head of the staff, and a crackle seems to emenate from it at odd times.

name: barbed circlet
description: This odd piece of headwear has been created from a metal you have not seen before. It is spindly and thin, as if it could be easily breakable, yet somehow feels indestructable. It hums slightly, and a glow pulses from it in a rhythm of its own. Large purple-tinged barbs stick out, as if to grasp the head that wears it.

name: chaotic vortex
description: Brilliant colours swirl about in midair here, as some sort of extra-planar rift breaks the air. Energy shoots from it violently, and the swirls seem to speed increasingly fast, and the rift seems to widen slightly, as if it were about to explode.

name: greatbow
description: This great, heavy bow has been carved from the trunk of some large tree. It is strung tightly with the sinew of some beast. Though quiet large it can obviously pack a large punch to any target. It comes with a quiver full of blue-feathered arrows.

name: blackwood shield
description: Carved from the bark of a blackwood tree, this shield is very thick. Almost as light as a feather in comparison to a metal shield, it still looks as though it would provide protection against attack. The blackwood has been polished making it dark enough to aid stealth-like abilities. Druidic runes line the shield all around its edge.

name: scroll of serenity
description: This holy writ details the exact prayers and intonations necessary to gain the power to learn this spell.

name: vorpal katana
description: This is a light one-handed sword. It is about three and a half feet long, midway in size between a broadsword and a greatsword. Its slightly curved blade is razor-sharp, and the sword is apparently made by a master craftsman. Its black hilt is carved in the shape of a rearing panther.

name: blackwood forest
description: The trees of this forest are tall, reaching over you like giant monsters from a bad dream. Red ichor drips like sap from the bark and the long, spindly branches stretch out, hanging its leaves over you like sharp claws.

name: Crest of Silvermere
description: This necklace glitters brightly with its fine, crafted links of silver. A graceful eagle of platinum spreads its wings on the large silvery disc, signifying it the crest of the great city town of Silvermere.

name: blackwood harp
description: This harp has been crafted from a nightmare. Jagged strings look as if they were made from twine, with points sticking out in some places. Fashioned from blackwood it has been created to look as if the harpist were playing on a ribcage of some beast, with a dark red polish shining from the wood. A crimson sigil glows brightly, branded into the wood.

name: arlysian longsword
description: This is a three-foot length of sharpened cold steel, bladed along one edge. Its blade is thin, and designed for thrusting. Overall, this is a good weapon. The mark of Arlysia is etched on the hilt.

name: arlysian mace
description: This is a steel ball mounted on a two-foot wooden rod. It is a well-rounded weapon, providing adequate defense and attack. This is the weapon of choice for those of the priestly following. The mark of Arlysia is etched on the handle.

name: arlysian dagger
description: This is a small, sharp knife, used primarily for stabbing. It is easy to handle and to conceal, but it does minor damage. It is completely useless against most heavy armours. The mark of Arlysia is etched on the blade.

name: ethereal sabre
description: Smoking black glass make up the blade of this other-worldly weapon. A strange silver metal forms the hilt and a single grinning skull is the pommel. It weaves through the air leaving a trail of smoke behind, and it seems very sharp.

name: silver signet ring
description: This small silver ring has been fashioned to appear like two wings encircling each other. On the head is the symbol of a sunrise, with the letters D and B engraved upon it.

name: morningstar ring
description: A beautiful ring, crafted of platinum and gold, it has been fashioned to appear as if sunlight were clustered around your finger. Written inside the band are the words of holy tongue, they speak

name: shamanic headdress
description: This strange rustic headdress shows no method to its madness with the many pieces of leather, twigs, and animal bones that adorn it. It carries a strange mixed aroma that is impossible to identify, and it seems to tingle at your touch as if it carried some form of magical power.

name: yellow potion
description: This glass bottle holds a rich yellow liquid that almost looks like melted cheese. A simple cork stopper plugs the opening.

name: crimson potion
description: This small glass vial is filled with a shimmering red elixir with large bubbles floating in every direction. A lead stopper covers the top, stopping its contents from spilling out.

name: bubbling blue potion
description: This flask rattles violently, as if the bubbling light blue liquid were about to explode. A large iron stopper covers the entire top of the flask.

name: oily potion
description: This large glass bottle is brimming with an oily fluid that looks to be filled with large crimson blobs, floating and congrealing together, sloshing the bottle around makes a quiet revolting appearence.

name: grey potion
description: This heavy metal flask is filled with a disgusting grey fluid that smells of dead earth and burnt wood. Blobs of matter float about in it revoltingly.

name: sickly green potion
description: This odd potion looks like some form of moldy vegtables liquified long ago. It has a disgusting slosh to it and your nostrils tingle from the smell that corrodes your nose.

name: frothing brown potion
description: This small glass vial is filled with a disgusting brown liquid. The cork barely keeps the vile smell from your nostrils and you are caused to think that perhaps this is some stool sample instead of anything magical.

name: rainbow potion
description: This small glass vial is filled with an ever changing color, with giant bubbles bursting and reforming inside. It looks somewhat violatile as if it might explode at any moment.

name: golden sun robes
description: These robes are made of white cotton and look unfaded. Sewn into the cuffs is the symbol of a radiant, glorious sun, along the hem you can see tiny words in holy script. A blessed calm exudes from the robes, and they feel as if only a person of virtue could wear them.

name: ancient bone chest
description: A chest that sends shivers down your spine it is a chest made of some ancient wood that appears to be stained with blood all over. Strange runes are etched all along the sides and even more archaic symbols adorn the handles and locks

name: silvery spiked shield
description: This is a silver shield of medium size. A massive spike has been masterfully grafted in the center, offering a warning to any opponents of the shield.

description: Many years are stacked on the pages of this great and massive tome, the front reads
by Jiggs Longthorne. You open the book and read...

name: black dragon robes
description: A magnificent silk robe, coloured a deep black. Sewn on the front is a midnight blue dragon, reaching out with claw and fang alike to strike out. It is tied around the waist by an equally black silk sash that has small onyx sewn into the center.

name: tissue
description: This piece of carefully woven cotten looks as though it can hold up to many gallons of liquid.

name: rotted worm skin
description: A large, hollow piece of skin from some great worm, it reeks of filth and vileness. Though digusting it seems to have an unending durability that would make avoiding attack difficult, but deflect the force of the blow.

name: platinum plate gauntlets
description: These heavy plate gauntlets have been fashioned from the finest platinum you have seen. They look very sturdy and able to protect hands from harm. Great care has been taken to inscribe silver words of prayer upon each knuckle.

name: blood portal
description: A vertical pool of blood seems to hang here, floating above the floor with power of unknown darkness. Occasional screams are heard as faces, twisted in agony and pain are seen. The portal seems to arch its frame, as if grinning at you, inviting you into its warm embrace.

name: scroll of rejuvenation
description: This bark parchment has swirling runes burned onto it, explaining the rituals and methods of learning this spell.

name: gravestones
description: This grave was once dug very neatly but something from the inside or out has undone the work. Large clumps of dirt have been tossed to the side. Nothing can be guessed of what was buried here as the gravestone is indecipherable from the jagged claw marks that have torn into the rock.

name: pile of spectral webbing
description: This is a wet pile of webbing that looks to have come from some beast of an undead nature. It is very cold to the touch and almost feels as if it were sucking the life from you. It is most beautiful to behold and while it appears delicate, feels as sturdy as the thickest rope.

name: weeping statue
description: Cracked and faded, this marble statue depicts a middle-aged woman, weeping for the loss of life in the graveyard. Bright marble has now faded to grey. As you look at the statue more, an eerie feeling overwhelms you and every now and then you would swear the statue was looking up at you, grinning with malice, and baring fangs.

name: ancient tome
description: Opening the tome, you find a page and read...

name: hideous face
description: A face of unspeakable evil and glee juts from the wall here. Fashioned to appear almost as some kind of lustful gaze, this face looks as though it has been badly scarred. A large eye socket appears vacant, and its wide, demonic grin seems to have a gaping hole where a tongue should be.

name: hideous face
description: A face of unspeakable evil and glee juts from the wall here. Fashioned to appear almost as some kind of lustful gaze, this face looks as though it has been badly scarred, and its wide, demonic grin seems to have a gaping hole where a tongue should be.

name: anvil
description: This large black-iron anvil is propped up by a stand, giving it a height of four feet. Its flat hammering surface is battered in parts from heavy use, and other dents show its abuse as well. Carved into the side of the anvil is the letter
, other letters follow but they have been scratched out.

name: firepit
description: A large circular pit of flame sits here, surrounded by stone. A magical blaze licks at the air above it, causing waves of immense heat to blast anything that would come near it.

name: splotched scroll
description: This long, ripped scroll bears several splotches upon its pages. The contents of the scroll contains the runes of magic, which can only be read by those who practice the magi talent.

name: Kai battle-staff
description: This long, slender staff is a creation of the ancient Kai Lords. It is extremely potent in battle, being perfectly balanced and imbued with incredible power.

name: astral staff
description: This staff is seemingly made specifically for fighters, however strong magics have been placed upon it. It is doubtful that any but the most strongly linked to magic could wield it.

name: ancient sword
description: This ancient iron scimitar was crafted very well, as it has survived many an age without losing its edge. Very well balanced and hilted with a carved oak handle this would be an excellent weapon for most fighters. A single rune is stamped on the hilt, possibly a family crest.

name: ancient chime
description: This is a bell-like golden chime, often used to ward off evil spirits. Dust covers it like a greatcloak, but it still looks useable.

name: golden locket
description: This small golden locket strung with a light silver chain. Inside is a tiny painting of a very beautiful woman.

name: cracked statue head
description: The marble head or bust of a great warrior lies here in pieces. It looks as though it had been dropped or thrown a great distance. Age and dust hide its guise, leaving the tribute a mystery.

name: twisted tree
description: This tall tree stands here, parched and broken, waiting for nature to end its existence. You can tell by the size it is easily a century in age, but scratches and cuts all over its trunk tell of a life not well lived.

name: barbed key
description: This key is made of some foreign metal with various barbs and spikes jutting from its teeth. A wicked looking key you shudder to think of the door that it must go to.

name: stormmetal belt
description: This is a very large belt, fashioned from hide and linked plates. From the blusish tinge that radiates from the belt it can be identified as stormmetal. It was obviously intended to be worn by someone much larger, but it is still possible to cinch it enough to wear it. An engraving of a lightning bolt has been stamped upon the middle plate.

name: bone leg boney
description: Upon closer inspection you see the leg bone has been jammed into a crevice in the floor, perhaps some sort of last ditch effort to escape this place of death. The bone appears lose enough that it could be pulled while stuck inside the crevice, but it has been jammed so tight that it can not be taken out of its resting place.

name: bookcase
description: This bookcase is covered in full layers of dust. Once made of maple, time has devoured it slowly, causing it to eventually cave in, covering the tattered books that once resided here in polished condition.

name: pile of rubble
description: Examining the piles of massive rock that lie here, you see a crack close to the wall, just big enough to walk through.

name: black leather book
description: A large leather book dyed black, bear no markings of any sort on the cover. You open it and find a page that draws your attention....

name: shining white talisman
description: This small white disk is hung upon a fine platinum chain. Strange runes are inscribed upon its surface, which read:

name: starsteel corselet
description: Large, thick plates of starsteel give this corselet a look of indestructibility. The combination of so many shining starsteel plates gives the entire suit a vibrant glow. It's massive weight is balanced by the fact it provides incredible protection in combat.

name: runed sacrificial robes
description: Robes of midnight cloth are adorned with vile runes the color of blood. On the cuff and color the symbol of a crimson horned skull is plainly seen. These robes carry an aura of absolute damnation.

name: mithril dwarven axe
description: This razor-sharp axe has been crafted with the hands of a master. Form from mithril, the crescent moon blade has the markings of dwarven tongue inscripted in gold upon it. You are awed by the balance and sharpness of this weapon.

name: serrated dwarven axe
description: This heavy, one-handed axe is short-hafted and has a single blade shaped like a half moon. The blade has wicked serrations along its edge, and a thick, green substance has coated it as well. The workmanship of this axe is shoddy at best, and looks as though an amateur smith crafted it.

name: black dragon gauntlets
description: This is a pair of masterly crafted gauntlets, made from the hide of a black dragon. Very supple, they are soft and warm to the touch, yet give excellent protection against almost any attack.

name: black dragon leggings
description: Black dragonhide make up this pair of leathery leggings. Crafted by a supreme leatherworker, these leggings offer powerful protection for the lower body, and yet are very flexible.

name: black dragon tunic
description: Amazing to gaze at, this suit of black dragonhide was obviously made by the hands of a master. Spiked ridges along the back and shoulders give it an almost nightmarish look, making its wearer look terrifying indeed.

name: black dragon helm
description: This is a sturdy helm of black dragonhide, fashioned with superb skill. You see it has extra padding so it may protect the crown from blows with more protection then normal.

name: black dragon boots
description: This is a pair of skillfully crafted boots, made from the black hide of a dragon. They come up almost to the knee and are warm to the touch. Built for protection they are also form-fitting and very comfortable.

name: white dragon gauntlets
description: This is a pair of masterly crafted gauntlets, made from the hide of a white dragon. Very supple, they are soft and warm to the touch, yet they give excellent protection against almost any attack.

name: white dragon leggings
description: White icy dragonhide make up this pair of leathery leggings. Crafted by a supreme leatherworker, these leggings offer powerful protection for the lower body, and yet are very flexible.

name: white dragon tunic
description: Amazing to gaze at, this suit of white dragonhide was obviously by the hands of a master. Spiked ridges run along the back and shoulders, and give off a shimmering glow.

name: white dragon helm
description: This is a sturdy helm of white dragonhide, fashioned with superb skill. You see it has extra padding so it may protect the crown from blows with more protection then normal.

name: white dragon boots
description: This is a pair of skillfully crafted boots, made from the white hide of a dragon. They come up almost to the knee and are warm to the touch. Built for protection they are also form-fitting and very comfortable.

name: blue dragon gauntlets
description: This is a pair of masterly crafted gauntlets, made from the hide of a blue dragon. Very supple, they are soft and warm to the touch, yet give excellent protection against almost any attack.

name: blue dragon leggings
description: Dark blue dragonhide make up this pair of leathery leggings. Crafted by a supreme leatherworker, these leggings offer powerful protection for the lower body, and yet are very flexible.

name: blue dragon tunic

name: blue dragon helm

name: blue dragon boots

name: altar
description: This large altar is made of smooth granite, with runes of wickedness carved into its face. Restraints for the head, hands and feet have been grafted to the stone, allowing little escape for anyone chained to its blood-bathed surface. An intricate spider design has been fashioned in the centre of the rock, its eyes glaring at you evilly.

name: large chest
description: This appears to be a large, ordinary-looking wooden chest. I bound with iron bands, and sits upon four short steel feet.

name: arlysian firegut
description: A strange and mysterious liquid resides in the depths of this stone tankard. A quick sniff immediately numbs your nostrils, cutting off all sense of smell and feeling.

name: diamond willow staff
description: Whoever created this staff had great crafting skill. It is taller than most men and is the color of old Ivory with veins of ebony. Where the veins swirl together in knots you notice the staff looking back at you. There are hidden in the wood the eyes of many creatures, you recognize owl and hawk, lion and wolf, bat rat and mouse among the many unblinking unnatural eyes.

name: rotten eye
description: White and pupiless, this grotesque organ was once the eye of some massive beast, but is now totally lifeless and smells of great decay. It is totally revolting to hold, and is very squishy.

name: rotted tongue
description: The massive, lifeless, tongue of some creation, it is putridly black, with some off shades of purple. You can hardly stop from retching at the sight of this dead member.

description: Many years are stacked on the pages of this great and massive tome, the front reads

name: black dragon hide
description: You can tell this piece of hide came from a young dragon. Black as night, it is somewhat heavy, with small spikes jutting out in some spots. Touching the scales show an extra roughness to them, and you wonder if it could be used for some kind of armour.

name: blue dragon hide
description: You can tell this piece of hide came from a young dragon. Blue as the sky it is somewhat heavy, with small spikes jutting out in some spots. It seems to carry an electric feel to it and you wonder if it could be made into some kind of armour.

description: This straight singled-edged blade is fashioned from pure adamantite. Its hilt is forged into the shape of a panthers head, and the letter
has been carved onto the base of the blade.

name: adamantite longsword
description: This is a three-foot length of sharpened adamantite, bladed along one edge. Its thin, heavy blade was made for thrusting or slashing. The feel of the sword shows it was crafted to be a well-balanced weapon, striking wounds with ferocious accuracy.

name: blackened book
description: A black silk cover overlaps the dark pages within, written in an odd script it is somewhat hard to decipher. On the cover has been drawn the picture of a mirror with a circle moving around it.

name: dusty papyrus
description: Through the immense layers of dust that have taken residence upon this paper you can barely make out the following...

name: green dragon hide
description: You can tell this piece of hide came from a young dragon. Green as the forest, it is somewhat heavy, with small spikes jutting out in some spots. You wonder if it could be used some kind of armor.

name: severed head of Enigma Lord
description: The bloody head of the undead mystic known as the Enigma Lord. Even in death his eyes are cold and unforgiving. His demeanor showing a will of iron, and unbendable force.

name: blood gore
description: Covering your mouth brings you little recovery as you vomit your last meal onto the floor. Pieces of humanoid anatomy can be seen all over this place, some whole, some sliced. A truly disgusting spectacle, fueled by insanity or pure evil.

name: granite coffin
description: A plain coffin, made of dull, grey granite. Dust is caked on the lid in a massive heap. On the sides you see massive holes as if someone had tried to nail the lid shut, but by the various cracks around them it would seem that failed. Something terrible has already broken out and is loose.

name: yellow bone portal
description: A grotesque piece of sorcery, this portal appears to be made of the bones of many humanoids. The vile gate pulsates making the bones chatter to some foul tempo. A swirlling crimson liquid pulsates within the portal, and the stink of death reeks from it.

description: This iron tankard bears the stamp of a crimson flame along the bottom. It is almost overflowing with mulled wine.
