name: stone
description: This large stone looks very out of place from the rest of the rubble. Something seems to be holding it in place, but it looks moveable.

name: disfigured statue
description: Once a beautiful sculpture, claws and other markings have mutilated this statue beyond any recognition of what it was. You can clearly see it once had limbs, but those have been severed long ago, leaving the marble to slowly crumble and further rot. As you seem to get closer to the statue your ears pick up the sound of agonized screams.

name: warrior statue
description: A large statue, carved from marble stands here. It shows no sign of age or degradation, as if it was carved new. The statue itself is sculpted after some noble, powerful warrior, a hard cold gaze staring into nothing. One hand is placed over his heart, while the other grasps a magnificent sword. A single word is on the statue's plaque: Ozrinom.

name: wooden hammer
description: A simple wooden hammer, it smells of fresh oak. It is a simple weapon of labor, a square wooden head sitting atop a wooden handle. Used primarly for pounding with great force, it could hardly be used much as a weapon against normal adversaries.

name: wooden stake
description: A stake of wood carved with master precision, the tip looks sharp enough to pierce any sort of unprotected surface. Made from a white oak, it smells freshly cut, but looks to have had some sort of hardening chemical used to make it almost unbreakable. It can be used by all priestly types but only for holy acts such as purifying a coffin.

name: scrawling wall
description: Brushing away the dust you can see that someone or something used a sharp, crude instrument to make the markings on the wall. It takes some time to read the handwriting but it says the following: Tis the sword, the hand and the eye, but not the m.... the rest is unreadable.

name: black scroll
description: With word from the Enigma Lord, I sense my minions from Silvermere have betrayed me. You saw them when you delivered the message of Nadroj. Kill them, and any agents of the white wench or the grey jester. --Balthazar --Balthazar

name: scrawling wall
description: Brushing away the dust you can see that someone or something used a sharp, crude instrument to make the markings on the wall. It takes some time to read the handwriting but it says the following: Sword, hand, sword, eye, then you die!

name: stone statue
description: A large stone statue stands before you. Sculpted in the image of a warrior, he wields a sword in one hand, and his other is outstretched in a grasping manner. Age has caused cracks to form on his sword hand, his other hand and his jaw.

name: stone sword
description: Upon closer inspection of the sword you see that it is not age that has formed the cracks but the original maker. It looks as though you could perhaps twist the sword while it is still wielded by the statue.

name: stone hand
description: This outstretched hand, palm up, appears not to have been cracked by age, but by design. Closer inspection shows that by turning the hand you can move it in a circular motion, perhaps even turning it upside down.

name: stone jaw
description: Though closed shut, this jaw appears as if it could be easily moved or lowered down to open the mouth, and possibly reveal the contents inside.

name: eye socket
description: At first nothing can be seen when looking into the empty socket, but as you gaze more into the gaping blackness, a small grey circle can be seen. Deep within the recesses you see a button.

name: stone statue
description: A large stone statue stands before you. Sculpted in the image of a warrior, he wields a sword in one hand, and his other is outstretched in a grasping manner. Age has caused cracks to form on his sword hand, his jaw, and a large hole can be seen where his eye once was.

name: large sign
description: A newly painted sign sits here in the middle of the road, in bright, obnoxious lettering it reads: Coming Soon! The most majistical marvelous myraid misfits in the land! The travelling comedy groupe of M. Alevolience and Co.

name: pristine coffin
description: The fashioning of this coffin was done with great care, even after the many years it has been buried. The coffin is fashioned of fine oak, with a crest of gold set engraved into the lid. On the crest the word
is scripted in graceful, flowing script.

name: large sign
description: A brand new sign sits here, pointing to a boarded up building to the north, the sign reads: Coming Soon! Phezik's Manual Labor Emporium Instant Work for Anyone!

name: wooden box
description: This simple pine box is about one foot long and half as wide and deep. Objects inside rattle about freely.

name: Feyr
description: A fearsome greatsword, it would require massive power to wield. Kissed with black fire, it shines as if it were made of darkest onyx. The hilt is fashioned from a blue metal, with the word
inscripted along the handle. A horrid decoration is upon the pommel, that of a baleful eye, full of hate and evil.

name: adamantite scimitar
description: This is a curved sword, about three feet in length, and bladed upon one edge. It is thin and fairly light, but can deliver considerable slashing wounds.

name: dark plated warchest
description: This gigantic chest is made of a deep, black metal, that devours all light. It looks as though it could easily weigh more then a ton, and would be unliftable by any but a giant. A massive lock keeps the chest safe from intrusion, however the key has been left in the lock, easily allowing someone to turn the key and unlock the chest.

name: yellow bone portal
description: A grotesque piece of sorcery, this portal appears to be made of the bones of many humanoids. The vile gate pulsates making the bones chatter to some foul tempo. A swirlling crimson liquid pulsates within the portal, and the stink of death reeks from it.

name: shadowy corselet
description: This is a heavy platemail corselet eats the light around you with its blackness. Engraved on the breast is a white skeletal hand crushing a red skull. The armour is so bulky it would be hard to avoid not getting hit, but it looks so massive that it would take any blow with ease.

name: oak chest
description: This medium-sized chest is of simple but elegant construction. Long, interlocking planks of sanded oak form its rectangular shape, and the clattering of object can be heard from within when it is moved.

name: large black gem
description: This gem is finest cut diamond you have seen in your life of adventure. It seems to pulse with a deep, seductive blackness. A large O has been chiseled on top of the diamond in red lettering.

name: silver box
description: This smallish silver box is ornately carved with rampant animals. When moved, objects rattle about inside.

name: scrawling wall

name: crowned spider skull
description: A fearsome looking item, it looks to be the skull of a large crowned spider. Ridges around the eye holes show where the clusters once lay. The chitin is so sturdy it would make an exotic, but sturdy piece of headwear to protect in battle.

name: horned spider skull
description: A fearsome looking item, it looks to be the skull of a great horned spider. Ridges around the eye holes show where the clusters once lay. Two great horns jut from the helm, allowing one to possibly gore an opponent, causing harm and knocking them to the ground. Though odd looking it could make for a sturdy helm.

name: scroll of natural prowess
description: This bark parchment has swirling runes burned onto it, explaining the rituals and methods of learning this spell.

name: blood inscripted scroll
description: Ancient dark parchment has been inscribed with unholy runes, written with aged blood that has been caked heavily to survive the years.

name: scroll of mass entangle
description: This bark parchment has swirling runes burned onto it, explaining the rituals and methods of learning this spell.

name: scroll of sleep
description: This parchment is inscribed with runes of magic, but exactly what is written can only be learned by reading it.

name: magma rock chest
description: This large chest is made from magma rock, long since cooled since the day it was first made. It has trully been made from magical means, for the weight of it is quiet late for being made of such heavy stone.

name: lunar chainmail hauberk
description: This suit of chainmail shines as if the moon were captured in its very rings. Shining with a blue tinge, a silver wolf head is sewn into the chestcloth, howling at the moon.

name: lunar chainmail leggings
description: Tiny chain links have been woven with a strange blue metal to form an unbreakable pair of leggings. The way they glow it would seem as if they had fallen from the night sky.

name: lunar chainmail coif
description: Links of blue steel mesh together and form a tight fitting coif. The metal has a strange glow that gives it a strange alien quality.

name: lunar chain gauntlets
description: This is a pair if elbow-length chain gauntlets has been fashioned in a bizarre fashion. Through intricate patterns it has been crafted to appear so that the hand were the head of a wolf, and the fingers forming the maw. It appears stylish without degrading the protection of the gauntlets.

name: sadamune-
description: This is a light one-handed sword. It is about three and a half feet long, midway in size between a broadsword and a greatsword. Its slightly curved blade is razor-sharp, and the sword is apparently made by a master craftsman. Its black hilt is carved in the shape of a rearing panther.

name: poisoned shuriken
description: This small steel disk has four razor-sharp blades protruding from its edge. A dull black substance has been smeared on the points.

name: granite tablet
description: This massive grey stone smells of fresh soil and rock dust, it weighs you down heavily but you not various runes and symbols of druidic tongue have been carved onto it.

name: magma chunk
description: This chunk of magma looks as though it would easily char the flesh off anything but surprisingly it radiates no heat. In glowing runes of druidic tongue phrases are written upon the lava rock.

name: metallic parchment
description: A thin metal sheet crackles with powerful energy, sparks jet from all over the page. Bright blue sygils of power can be seen very clearly on this metal page and they appear to be written in the language of druids.

name: frozen orb
description: This large orb of solid ice makes your teeth almost chatter with its glacial aura. Oddly you see faint crimson writing around it, which looks similar to druidic script.

name: mutilated corpses
description: Several bodies lie in piles along the floor here, all of them with various parts cut from them, sliced away as if they were choice cuts of meat. Some of the bodies you can tell have been here for some time, others look recently fresh.

name: table
description: This simple table has seen better days years ago. Marks and scratches decorate it like a polish, and it has been stained crimson in splotches, as if a great battle had been waged upon its simple surface.

name: aged desk
description: This elegant desk has been painstakingly hand-crafted from a variety of precious woods, and is rarely seen outside mansions of the rich. Thick dust coats it entirely, turning its polished brown to a dull, sickly grey. A drawer is curiously open halfway, drawing your attention.

name: aged desk
description: This elegant desk has been painstakingly hand-crafted from a variety of precious woods, and is rarely seen outside mansions of the rich. Thick dust coats it entirely, turning its polished brown to a dull, sickly grey.

name: silver casket
description: This squat, heavy silver casket is inlaid with many small etchings of capering warriors. It rests upon a small marble dias.

name: stormmetal corselet
description: Thick plates of a bluish metal have been crafted to form a massive corselet. Sparkles of white and blue dance around the edges and the plates seem to hum as they rub together. It is obvious by its size that a giant was the intended wearer, but with some adjustments it could fit the frame of a normal humanoid.

name: silversilk gloves
description: Woven from elven silversilk, these gloves weigh almost nothing. Stitched with runes of gold they would give any wearer simple protection to their hands.

name: silversilk slippers
description: This pair of simple slippers have been woven from silversilk that only elves possess. Embroidered with runes of gold they offer great comfort to the feet while traversing the harshest surface.

name: demonhide sandals
description: These blood red sandals are crafted out of the black-spined skin of a demon. They are tough and thick-soled. On the heel of each sandal, a glowing blue symbol of the Kai Lords is emblazoned.

name: sapphire bracers
description: Fashioned from a beautiful sapphire gem, and enforced with powerful magic, these bracers crackle with energy and might. A glowing warmth radiates from this magical armour, and the symbol of the Kai Lords can be seen within each bracer.

name: sandstone chest
description: This large, heavy chest is made of black iron, which has been polished so that the container gleams like a beetle's carapace. A hideous demonic face has been carved into its lid, and it is obvious that the chest is full of valuables.

name: black plate boots
description: This pair of boots is fashioned from thick black iron, and lined with the coarse hide of some animal. Formed with very poor skill, they lack any form of comfort but offer good defense against attack. A harsh, crimson rune has been stamped on the toe and heel of each boot. The iron is surprisingly light for its thickness.

name: black plate gauntlets
description: A collection of black iron have been fashioned to into a pair of heavy gauntlets. The palm of each metal glove has been created from coarse animal hide and each knuckle has been stamped with a harsh, glowing rune. The iron looks very heavy but feels surprisingly light.

name: black dragon tabi
description: These knee-length boots have been fashioned from a fine type of silk, and dyed a midnight blue. The form of a black dragon has been sewn on them, its tail beginning at the shin and its maw ending on the foot. The soles have been woven in such a way that movement would be muffled, enhancing the wearers stealth.

name: mithril plate gauntlets
description: This pair of gauntlets are made of the purest mithril, shining brightly in the light. They appear very heavy, but are surprisingly light when you pick them up. You can tell from the craftsmanship that they were fashioned by a master-smith.

name: prismatic slippers
description: This pair of fine slippers are woven out of a cloth that displays every colour of the rainbow. Smooth as silk, they are incredibly comfortable, and the warmth that radiates from them show they are of great magical quality.

name: prismatic gloves
description: Fashioned from a magical cloth, these gloves sparkle with ever changing colours. The outside feel smooth to the touch, but the inside of the gloves seem more sturdy, and a feeling of warmth flows from them.

name: prismatic trousers
description: These flamboyant pants glow in a spectrum of colour. Woven from a fine cloth, these leggings offer comfort and some durable protection from the ankles to the waist of the wearer.

name: astral slippers
description: Astral patterns dance along the tops of this pair of magically woven slippers. While more weighty then a pair of shoes, the power of these slippers easily offer more protection from the elements.

name: astral trousers
description: The bright sights of the astral plane move and quiver across this pair of pale golden leggings. Made of an almost weightless material, the feeling of immense magic radiates from the fabric.

name: astral gloves
description: This pair of silky smooth gloves reflect an alien greyness that moves about with a life of its own. At first glance these gloves look flimsy, but upon further inspection reveal a magical toughness that would offer fair protection to the hands.

name: shadowy ankh
description: This slim cross seems to defy description. One moment it glows softly, yet is insubstantial, then next becomes shadowy, occasionally waves of color ripple throughout. Only a dim red light is always visible at the center. One leg of the cross is a bit longer, the center of the shorter is ribbed, and fits your hand comfortably.

name: wyvernhide gauntlets
description: These leather gauntlets are made from the hide of a wyvern. The dull brown scales are extremely tough, and provide excellent protection for the hands. Wyvernhide is highly prized as wyverns are known for their ferocity in combat.

name: wyvernhide boots
description: This pair of boots have been fashioned from wyvern's hide. They are extremely tough, providing protection from the toe to the middle of the shin. The insides are lined with a soft material, to provide comfort as well.

name: adamantite ninjato
description: This blade of bright adamantite looks sharp enough to split a hair. The wooden hilt has been wrapped with fine black leather, and the letter R has been stamped on the base.

name: scroll of eldritch fury
description: This parchment is inscribed with runes of magic, but exactly what is written can only be learned by reading it.

name: adamantite ring
description: This ring is crafted in the image of a dragon, encircling itself to devour its tail. Written on the head of the dragon is the letter

name: adamantite chainmail leggings
description: These heavy leggings gleam with a shine all their own. Crafted from adamantite, the chain links have been fasioned with an experienced hand. While heavier then normal chain, they also provide increased protection from attack.

name: adamantite chain gauntlets
description: This is a pair of elbow-length gauntlets, created from adamantite metal. The gloves seem to have their own gleam, and the links themselves show the excellence that only a dwarven hand could bring.

name: adamantite chainmail coif
description: Crafted expertly for snug fitting protection of the head, these adamantite chain links look almost invincible to the sharpest blade.

name: adamantite scalemail tunic
description: This suit of animal hide is covered with fist-shaped discs of adamantite. Each one has been sewn into the hide, clustered together in vital areas of the torso. On each disc the rune of the dwarven tongue has been stamped, indicating this fine suit of armour the work of

name: adamantite scalemail leggings
description: Discs of purest adamantite have been sewn together into the thick hide of an animal. While the hide itself offers some protection, the powerful metal covering offers even greater protection to the legs of the wearer. On each disc is stamped the dwarven letter for
indicating the master craft of a dwarven smith.

name: adamantite scale gauntlets
description: Toughened animal hide is decorated with the fist sized shapes of pure adamantite metal. While heavier then the norm these gloves are clearly designed for the best protection in combat, without the weight of platemail. On each piece a dwarven rune has been stamped, showing the craftsman to be of great prowess among dwarves.

name: adamantite enforced boots
description: Boots of thick, heavy leather have been reinforced with large bands of pure adamantite. The efficiency of the work shows the boots to be of dwarven make, and their toughness in combat can be seen by the naked eye.

name: starsteel plate boots
description: You see before you, a pair of very fine boots. Thin, overlapping starsteel plates reinforce the already sturdy leather backdrop, providing amazing protection to your feet and lower legs. Inside the boot is layered with the finest doe-skin, to provide a soft padding as well as excellent

name: starsteel plate gauntlets
description: This pair of plate gauntlets is fashioned from the silver blue metal known as starsteel. Dwarven worksmen have pounded and fashioned the plates to maximize their durability and protection.

name: starsteel greathelm
description: This large helm is made of shining starsteel, as you hold it up to the light it gleams a brilliant azure. It is obviously work of the finest craftsmanship, but simple and efficient as well.

name: starsteel plate leggings
description: This is a pair of greaves made from shimmering starsteel. They look to provide remarkable protection for the legs, if the weight of the thick metal can be easily supported.

name: starsteel bracers
description: These shining steel bracers have a bluish-silver glint in the light. As you look more closely, you notice runes etched into their surface, and upon further examination you determine the runes to be of the dwarven language.

name: tattered white bible
description: With curled edges, and visible tear marks, this book has seen many days go by, and yet it somehow its pages seem to have a bright, enduring whiteness to its paper. Within the manual, written in silver, are the runes of a special, holy prayer.

name: green dragon tunic
description: Amazing to gaze at, this suit of green dragonhide was obviously made by the hands of a master. Spiked ridges along the back and shoulders give the wearer a powerful prescence.

name: green dragon leggings
description: Emerald green dragonhide make up this pair of leathery leggings. Crafted by a supreme leatherworker, these leggings offer powerful protection for the lower body, and yet are very flexible.

name: green dragon helm
description: This is a sturdy helm of green dragonhide, fashioned with superb skill. You see it has extra padding so it may protect the crown from blows with more protection then normal.

name: green dragon gauntlets
description: This is a pair of masterfully crafted gauntlets, made from the hide of a green dragon. Very supple, they are soft and warm to the touch, yet give excellent protection against almost any attack.

name: green dragon boots
description: This is a pair of skillfully crafted boots, made from the green hide of a dragon. They come up almost to the knee and are warm to the touch. Built for protection they are also form-fitting and very comfortable.

name: wyvernhide helm
description: This is a helm of thick, boiled, wyvern's hide. The brownish scales look dull, but immensely sturdy, and you can tell this helm was fashioned to offer decent protection for the head.

name: blood-stained manual
description: The dark stain of blood covers this wicked tome in every page corner, and crevice. Turning each page, reveals text more vile and grotesque then the previous. In the midst of wicked gloats, and stomach-turning torture, a rite of unholy power can be found.

name: blessed scroll
description: This holy writ details the exact prayers and intonations necessary to gain the power to learn this spell.

name: pristine scroll
description: This holy writ details the exact prayers and intonations necessary to gain the power to learn this spell.

name: hide inscripted scroll
description: Tattooed upon the hide of some ill fated humanoid are the words to an unholy prayer, giving power to those wicked enough to accept it.

name: platinum plate boots
description: This is a pair of plate boots, lined with soft leather, and fashion from platinum. The plates shine with a life of their own, and ornate carvings show great mastery was used in the making of these boots.

name: lunar chainmail boots
description: This is a pair of black leather boots, rising from the toe to just above the ankle. Sewn tightly about the boots are links of a strange blue metal. The chain seems to glow a metallic dark blue, and look strong enough to give decent protection in combat.

name: belt of the crimson flame
description: This is a wide leather strap with crimson metal scales fastened tightly together around it. Each scale has the mark of a flame stamped firmly upon it. The largest metal piece also works as the buckle. It is somewhat stiff to bend but flexible enough to wear around the waist.

name: ogre-skin baldric
description: The elegance of this baldric is found in its simplicity and its plain utility. The thick hide of an ogre has been tanned and studded with steel to provide excellent protection.

name: crimson inquisition mask
description: These masks are worn by members of the Crimson Flame to hide their identity and to intimidate prisoners put to the test of witchcraft. This mask is composed of smooth crimson metal and is featureless, save a pair of narrow eyeslits.

name: turkey leg
description: This giant turkey leg is easily the size of your fist! It smells delicious, and has been roasted in a thick, gooey red sauce. You can't help but get it all over yourself, and consider having a second helping.

name: scroll of chaos surge
description: This parchment is inscribed with runes of magic, but exactly what is written can only be learned by reading it.

name: iron ring
description: This is a plain iron ring, polished so that is gleams brilliantly.

name: severed purple tentacle
description: This is the deep purple tentacle of a mind flayer, brutally severed from it's previous owner. It is cold and damp to touch, and black ichor still oozes occasionally from the wound.

name: icy scroll
description: This scroll is tinged blue and tied by a bright blue ribbon. It seems to let off a vapor of some sort, and as you touch it, your hands began to flare with pain, as if they had been cut by something very sharp and cold, but no marks appear on them.

name: long-spear
description: This is a four foot long spear, used with both hands. It is fairly quick and is a good defensive weapon, but it does not do great damage.

name: great hydra statue
description: This massive statue is a monstrous sculpture. Fashioned from stone, it is carved into the form of a great draconic beast with two huge heads sprouting from its shoulders. Each head is nearly split in half by the maw it bears. The fangs of each head are easily the size of greatswords, and count into the hundreds.

name: wall
description: This wall of cavern rock seems to have been smoothed down through magical means. Upon closer inspection you can see a small letter
that has been chiseled in reverse on its dark surface.

name: nexus portal
description: This square block of energy seems to pulsate violently with life. Power reaches out from all sides, seeking release from its prison. Visions of a dark passage seem to erupt over the surface intermittently, and you realize this is a physical portal, leading to places unknown.

name: burning key
description: This key's head is shaped liked like a circled five-pointed star. It burns your flesh to touch it, and the taint of evil arises from it strongly.

name: golden pillar
description: A massive pillar of gold stands here, reaching high up into the sky. A myriad pattern of grooves spins around the pillar making it appear like a twisting screw with no beginning or end. In each groove you see several letters inscribed:

name: bubbling black potion
description: This small glass vial is filled with a jet black liquid, constantly bubbles and shakes about. Its impossible to tell the contents, but you think you see an eyeball floating around in it. The potion is stoppered with a thick seal.

name: charred spear
description: This is a four foot long spear, used with both hands. It is fairly quick and is a good defensive weapon, but it does not do great damage.

name: ornate panther carving
description: Made from a single piece of darkest blackwood, it depicts a panther, ready to strike. A superb representation, it seems lifelike from the brutal fangs of the gaping jaw to the razor-sharp claws on the meticulously detailed paw. The artist must have been quite an expert at carving.

name: ancient key
description: This key of ancient stone is shaped like an angel with its wings spread for flight. Most of the features have been marred by age, and it feels as if it were about to crumble in your hand.

name: silver plaque
description: Carved with a skilled hand, this plaque stands upon a marble pedestal for all to see. Various patterns have been shaped around the edges, and in big block letters you see: X B I E K O C D a few inches below the plaque reads: Speak the missing letter.

name: slimey spiked key
description: Covered in slime that reeks of death, this key appears to be tiny bits of metal somehow melded into one. Disjointed points rise up from the key, stabbing and poking any who grasp it.

name: stone rook key
description: Made of smooth, polished stone, this key has been fashioned to appear like that of the Rook chess piece.

name: bronze statue
description: A statue of newly polished bronze stands before you. Crafted in the vision of a crowned man, sitting atop a rearing horse. He looks to be wielding a large shovel.

name: starsteel shortsword
description: This impressive shortsword gleams with a silver-bluish tint, indicating it to be made from the rare metal, starsteel. It's razor-sharp edge looks extremely deadly, and it seems to glide silently through the air as you swing it. A well-cut diamond is set within the pommel.

name: enigma sandals
description: Several pieces of coloured, stiff, cloth have been wrapped to form a pair of myriad sandals. The straps have been shaped in bizarre patterns that almost seem to throw you into a rapture. On the heel of each sandal the symbol of the Kai Lords glows a bright crimson.

name: tree branch
description: Made from a tree you do not recognize, this branch seems to glow with power and youth. While it is not attached to any sort of tree itself, the branch does not bleed.

name: bow of silver
description: angel weapon

name: chained pile of bones
description: Immensely thick chains clasp around a pile of bones here. While the layers of dust speak of its untouched slumber for many ages, closer inspection reveals something went to great pains to break, and rebreak the bones. Undearneath it can be seen some writing, scratched into the floor:

name: shintai sword-
description: This simple sword is just under five feet long. Its three and a half foot blade is sharpened from both sides to the center. Its steel blade is a dull white colour and near its tip a single rune is engraved with unpolished gold. Its long cloth wrapped handle is stained with sweat and shows the swords extensive use.

name: golden rod
description: This four-foot-long rod glows brightly, casting everything with a golden shimmer. Words of a long dead language line its length, and it seems unusually light for being fashioned from a heavy metal. The top of the rod appears to be threaded, as if something should be attached upon it.

name: black spiked ball
description: The smell of burning flesh rises up from this ball of metal. Long, nine inch spikes protrude from the ball at every angle making it difficult to manipulate. A small hole can be seen within the ball itself, with tiny threads inside, as if the ball were meant to be attached to something.

name: black spike
description: Fashioned from a black metal, this spike looks as though it were filed to a needle sharp point. Dried blood and bits of gore stick to the surface, and it seems to emenate a strange throbbing heat. realize that the 'rust' is actually dried blood.

name: dynamite longbow
description: This slender, curved bow is made out of a long branch of supple wood. It is tightly-strung, and has a fair amount of stopping power. Its pull is a little heavy, but it makes for a good, accurate weapon. It comes with a quiver full of black-feathered arrows.

name: copper cross
description: A simple cross made from copper, it has been carved with great care and detail. It has been said that holy men hold it in hand, to strengthen their faith in times of crisis.

name: massive boulder
description: This massive stone is the color of dried blood and smells heavily of sulphur. It is hot to the touch, as if a fire burned deep within. It has been squarely placed in your path, blocking any further passage through here.

name: multicoloured staff
description: This sparkling staff is crafted out of four colored pieces of alien metal. Blue, red, brown, and yellow light seem to dance up and down its length, glowing about your fingers in delight. A single, silvery ball is set atop the staff, clutched by each of the four coloured pieces.

name: diamond pedestal
description: A breath-taking pedestal stands in the middle of the floor. Fashioned from some of the finest cut diamonds you have yet seen, it stands three feet tall, and its splendor is amazing to behold. Only one flaw can be found on the structure, a single hole gazes out, as if expecting a diamond of large size to close the gap.

name: pearl pedestal
description: A breath-taking pedestal stands in the middle of the floor. Fashioned from some of the most perfect pearls you have yet seen, it stands three feet tall, and its splendor is amazing to behold. Only one flaw can be found on the structure, a single hole gazes out, as if expecting a pearl of large size to close the gap.

name: moonstone pedestal
description: A breath-taking pedestal stands in the middle of the floor. Fashioned from some of the highest quality moonstones you have yet seen, it stands three feet tall, and its splendor is amazing to behold. Only one flaw can be found on the structure, a single hole gazes out, as if expecting a moonstone of large size to close the gap.

name: marble pedestal
description: A breath-taking pedestal stands in the middle of the floor. Fashioned from some of the most exquisite marble you have yet seen, it stands three feet tall, and its splendor is amazing to behold. Only one flaw can be found on the structure, a single hole gazes out, as if expecting a large block of marble to close the gap.

name: diamond
description: This large, transparent jewel is a brilliantly glittering blue-white in colour, and is highly prized for use in jewelry. Its beauty is only marred by the branding of the letter
that has been burnt onto its surface.

name: moonstone
description: This large, semi-precious stone is semi-opaque, and is white with a pale blue hue. Its beauty is marred by the letter
that has been burnt onto its surface.

name: pearl
description: This large, precious stone is pure white and seems to glow in the light. Its beauty is marred by the letter
which has been charred onto its surface.

name: marble
description: This large marble square is beautifully-made, and has a bright shine as if just polished. Its beauty is only marred by the letter
which has been carved onto it's surface.

name: marble pedestal
description: This intricately designed pedestal was most likely magically crafted out of raw marble. Four prongs break out from the top to grasp a magnificent crystal gem which sits directly in the center of the pedestal. You notice the crystal seems to glow with an inner blue light.

name: marble statue
description: This is a white marble statue of a ten foot tall knight in full plate armour. He stands before you, wielding a greatsword high in the air. It hangs just above the pedestal as if prepared to drop it down at any moment upon the crystal.

name: crystal gem
description: Cut by the most acute eye, this gem shines brilliantly in any light. It seems to have a bluish glow about it and throbs quietly in your hand.

name: crystal gem
description: Cut by the most acute eye, this gem shines brilliantly in any light. It seems to have a yelloish glow about it and throbs quietly in your hand.

name: skull key
description: This is a heavy iron key. Its handle is crafted in the form of a skull.

name: helmet key
description: This is a heavy iron key. Its handle is crafted in the form of a visored helmet.

name: star key
description: This is a heavy iron key. Its handle is crafted in the form of a multi-pointed star.

name: ankh key
description: This is a heavy iron key. Its handle is crafted in the form of an ankh.

name: white pawn
description: This appears to be a game piece of some sort. It is fashioned from marble, circular in size, and has a wide flat bottom which slowly narrows to a rounded top.

name: black knight
description: This appears to be a game piece of some sort. It is fashioned from marble, circular in size, and has a wide flat bottom which then is fashioned to become a horses head.

name: white bishop
description: This appears to be a game piece of some sort. It is fashioned from marble, circular in size, and has a wide flat bottom which then is fashioned to form a miter, the headdress of high clergy.

name: white queen
description: This appears to be a game piece of some sort. It is fashioned from marble, circular in size, and has a wide flat bottom which then is fashioned to form a tiara, the crown of queens.

name: black king
description: This appears to be a game piece of some sort. It is fashioned from marble, circular in size, and has a wide flat bottom which then is fashioned to form a royal crown, similar to that of a great king.

name: sceptre
description: This heavy glass sceptre feels as cold as ice. Its broad, flat head is engraved with a single, brightly glowing rune. The handle is wrapped in white leather, and a thong hangs from the pommel.

name: black rook
description: This appears to be a game piece of some sort. It is fashioned from marble, circular in size, and has a wide flat bottom which then is fashioned to become a castle battlement.

name: crown key
description: This iron key's head is shaped like a flat crown, with a cross at the very top of the head.

name: ruby key
description: This is a large shiny key carved from ruby. Its handle is carved in the shape of a flame.

name: amber key
description: This is a large shiny key carved from a large piece of amber. Its handle is carved in the shape of a lightning bolt.

name: sapphire key
description: This is a large shiny key carved from a large sapphire. Its handle is carved in the shape of a snowflake.

name: stone key
description: This is a large key fashioned from a large piece of granite. Its handle is unremarkable, fashioned to form a solid circle.

name: iron key
description: This is a heavy iron key. Its handle is crafted in the form of a bird claw.

name: iron pedestal
description: Round and sturdy, it is a wonder this pedestal has not melted under the intense heat which surrounds it. Floating above the pedestal, out of reach is a large crimson shard, which appears uneffected by the blazing chamber.

name: crimson shard
description: This long shard of red crystal is almost blistering to touch for it seems to possess an awesome amount of heat. Inside the crystal you see flames dancing within, most likely fueling the enormous heat it emits.

name: amber shard
description: This long shard of amber is shocking to touch for it seems to possess an awesome amount of electricity. Inside the crystal you see lightning dancing within, most likely fueling the enormous shock it emits.

name: sapphire shard
description: This long shard of sapphire is freezing to touch for it seems to possess an awesome amount of cold. Inside the crystal you see a light blue icicle, most likely fueling the enormous chill it emits.

name: quartz shard
description: This long shard of quartz is painful to touch for the many razor sharp points that protrude from it. Pieces granite, quartz, limestone and other stones jut from it at every angle, cutting any who touch it.

name: stone pedestal
description: Jagged and rough, this pedestal of stone looks as though it had been ripped from under a mountain. It is a deep grey color and still smells heavily of earth. A large shard of quartz floats out of reach above it, hanging in midair above the chaos.

name: throne
description: Piercing spikes protrude from every angle of this throne. Crafted from some sort of black iron that has long since rusted and stained by blood, it looks as though it were a device for torture then used for sitting. power emanating from it.

name: throne
description: Crafted masterfully from solid gold, this throne would do for any person of royalty. Fashioned for comfort, a plush cushion of purple covers the seat. The faint smell of perfume is in the air, and you feel warm just by being near this symbol of power.

name: nexus ore
description: This dense metal is shocking to touch and almost seems to tingle your every sense. The large chunk of ore is about the size of someone's head, and is very heavy.

name: skeletal remains
description: A humanoid skeletan lies here, or what parts remain. From what you are able to discern, a large amount of force was applied to its structure, leaving most of it in chips or shattered bits. One entire hand though still cluthes a piece of paper. The paper reads...

name: rock outcropping
description: This outcropping of rocks seems to bulge from the sides of the cavern here. You note they do not seem very attached to the wall, and could possibly be wrenched from the walls if someone had adequate strength.

name: void
description: A large void of space stands before you, supported by nothing, containing nothing, you almost think it goes on for eternity, but that would still come up short. Suddenly a small tiny pin prick of light appears, and seems to move closer to the hole of nothingness.

name: dusty tricorne
description: Dusty, black felt has been shaped into a wide cone, its brims folded up and pinched at three corners. A faded, white plume boasts out from the rear brim, for grand display. Occasionally the faint, ethereal image of a skull and crossbones pearlizes along the face of the cap.

name: raven claw
description: This short, thick, double-edge blade is made of a shimmering material that has a purplish hue to it. The blade itself is a little over two feet long, and comes straight out of the hilt before coming to an abrupt, vicious curve. For those fighting in close quarter, or in stealth attacks, this weapon looks as though it would fit the job nicely.

name: black dragon hood
description: The cloth of this hood readily appears black, but shines midnight blue in bright light. A serpentine dragon has been embroidered along the bottom of the mask, looking as though it were about to strike. The mask enhances the abilit to sneak up on someone, as  it absorbs even the tiniest sounds of breathing.

name: large rock
description: Made of simple granite, this rock is very large and looks immenseley heavy.

name: large rock
description: Made of simple granite, this rock is very large and looks immenseley heavy.

name: gold jeweled ring
description: FILE DESCRIPTION WCCRING.DSC

name: longsword1
description: This is a three-foot length of sharpened cold steel, bladed along one edge. Its blade is thin, and designed for thrusting. Overall, this is a good weapon.

name: longsword2
description: This is a three-foot length of sharpened cold steel, bladed along one edge. Its blade is thin, and designed for thrusting. Overall, this is a good weapon.

name: longsword3
description: This is a three-foot length of sharpened cold steel, bladed along one edge. Its blade is thin, and designed for thrusting. Overall, this is a good weapon.

name: longsword4
description: This is a three-foot length of sharpened cold steel, bladed along one edge. Its blade is thin, and designed for thrusting. Overall, this is a good weapon.

name: longsword5
description: This is a three-foot length of sharpened cold steel, bladed along one edge. Its blade is thin, and designed for thrusting. Overall, this is a good weapon.

name: silver gloves
description: These gloves are made of some type of metallic silver cloth. Tingling the tips of your fingers, you notice the stitching along the fingers and wrists show an odd pattern, woven with black and crimson thread.

name: silver hood
description: This is a hood of metallic silver cloth. Woven along the border is a strange pattern of black and crimson.

name: lightning whip
description: A large leather handle connects to a thin, long tail of shocking pain. Electricity shoots from the handle to the tip in sparking waves of fury. The whip seems to sway around as if to mimic a snakes hypnotic dance.

name: black chitin gauntlets
description: These exotic-looking gauntlets seem to have been made out of glossy, violet-black plates of insect chitin. They have been bounded together with spider silk and treated with a secret formula which makes them extremely hard and glossy.

name: red chitin gauntlets
description: These strange gauntlets appear to have been made out of the shell plates from some gigantic red crustacean. They are tied together by some glowing vines, and it appears to have been treated with some mixture that gives it a fine sheen.

name: training key
description: This is a heavy iron key. Its handles has been crafted into three images, a visored helmet, a skull, and a five pointed star.

name: stone wall letters
description: It is hard to make out much of the scrawling here, as age has devoured most of its form. Trying to decipher the writing only reveals gibberish, with the letters
etched repeatedly, ending finally with

name: greater black dragon scale
description: This huge black scale is larger than a tower shield and as solid as iron. It is incredibly light for its size, though, which is fortunate since otherwise it would be impossible to lift.

name: greater white dragon scale
description: This huge white scale is larger than a tower shield and as solid as iron. It is incredibly light for its size, though, which is fortunate since otherwise it would be impossible to lift.

name: greater blue dragon scale
description: This huge bluish scale is larger than a tower shield and as solid as iron. It is incredibly light for its size, though, which is fortunate since otherwise it would be impossible to lift.

name: greater green dragon scale
description: This huge greenish scale is larger than a tower shield and as solid as iron. It is incredibly light for its size, though, which is fortunate since otherwise it would be impossible to lift.

name: iron earrings
description: These are a pair of simple iron hoops, crafted well enough to not be called sloppy, but not magnificent either. Each hoop ends in a spike which can be moved for fastening.

name: bronze statue
description: This gargantuan statue of bronze stands thirty feet from the ground. Three distinct figures have been sculpted, one in full armour, another enshrouded by a cloak, and the last in plain robes. Nothing else can be seen of the figures for they have been posed with their backs facing outward.

name: red skull
description: Iron, painted red, has been used by expert hands to form a skull. Two gaping holes form the eye sockets, and the teeth have been chisled to give the skull a frightening, fanged leer. Ridges along the back of the skull allow for one hand to grasp it, as if to show any who would see it's wicked visage.

name: burning scroll
description: Reeking of sulphur, this scroll appears to be burning up, but still the strange paper remains whole. Upon it are written the rite of some wickedly evil prayer.

name: sandstone tablet
description: This large sandstone slab is crudely engraved with intricate runes of power, which you recognize as druidic magic.

name: scroll of glacial skin
description: This bark parchment has swirling runes burned onto it, detailing the rituals and methods of learning this spell.

name: stained papyrus scroll
description: This ancient, crumbling scroll of coarse-grained paper has been greatly dirtied and stained over the years. Despite this you are still able to read the words of an ancient, guttural tongue writen upon its surface. They appear to be words to an unholy prayer.

name: scroll of resist lightning
description: This parchment is inscribed with runes of magic, but exactly what is written can only be learned by reading it.

name: grey robes
description: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: grey robes
description: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: adamantite wrist guard
description: This wrist guard is made from pure adamantite, glimmmering darkly as you turn it this way and that examining the exquisite work. The metal is tastefully paired with black leather to form a dark and dangerous looking wrist guard, while still providing excellent protection and flexibility for the off-hand.

name: runed wrist guard
description: This ornate wrist guard is crafted of fine steel, with glittering runes of power engraved along it's length. Artfully cured leather straps bind it's cool, smooth surface to your wrist and hand, offering superior protection as well as mobility.

name: mithril chainmail boots
description: This is a pair of elven leather boots, covered with dwarven-crafted mithril links of chain. It is exceedingly rare for the elves and the dwarves to combine their methods of craftsmanship, but the result is precious indeed. The boots provide excellent protection without hindering stealthy movement.

name: red paisley bandanna
description: A large red cloth square, stiched with a white and black paisley print, is folded along it's diagonal and tied around around the head. It looks well worn, so worn in fact, that the voices of the previous wearers can occasionally be heard whispering indiscernibly.

name: gold-coin sash
description: Hundreds of bright, rune-stamped, gold coins have been hammered and chained together to form a grand hip scarf. Triangular in shape, the coins cover all down your thigh on one side, raising to a tied knot on the other. It can be fairly noisey while walking, if attention is not paid to move fastidiously.

name: brass zills
description: Finger-symbols, worn on the thumb and middle finger, are used to distract and entice targets. Their strange melodies, when used my knowing hands, infuse with the zills' own powers to create unique effects. This particular pair has been engraved with orchids, painted violet.

name: mirrored choli
description: Strips of variously colored and printed fabrics have been stiched together to form this tight fitting, long-sleeved, raffish blouse. Paired swirls draw attention to the upper chest, while each horizontal layer of fabric is alternated with a row of mirror-embedded cloth. Silvery runes glimmer near each mirror eyelet.

name: blue pantaloons
description: Bright, nearly electric, blue silk is pleated in between vertical strips of shiney black leather. The pants are almost an eyesore, being fairly snug at the waist and ankles though billowing out at the legs. The silk shimmers oddly, however, as silvery runes and tiny black diamonds have been embedded into the cloth.

name: layered sun skirt
description: The top layer of this skirt has been dyed yellow, with blazing suns worked into its surface. It is solid around the upper thighs, dividing at center into long strips that are tipped with topaz-stone suns. The under layer, visible lower thigh down, is bright yellow and orange, cut into vertical strips as though sunfire.

name: songsheet of beauty
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Beauty.

name: songsheet of ugliness
description: This parchment is inscribed with the musical knowledge to sing the magical Song of Ugliness.

name: astral skirt
description: The bright sights of the astral plane move and quiver across this wrap of pale golden fabric. Made of an almost weightless material, the feeling of immense magic radiates from the fabric.

name: black silk skirt
description: This fine wrap is woven out of a glossy black silk. It is embroidered with black thread, and is surprisingly tough. At second glance intricate symbols can be seen stitched all over their surface.

name: prismatic skirt
description: This flamboyant skirt glows in a spectrum of colour. Woven from a fine cloth, the wrap offers comfort and some durable protection from the ankles to the waist of the wearer.

name: silk skirt
description: This long wrap of brilliant silk is of excellent workmanship. It are light and loose, ties in a knot at the waist, and hangs down to the ankles.

name: white scroll
description: Written upon bleached white paper, in gold letters you can tell this scroll is a prayer of good priestly virtue.

name: shimmering papyrus
description: This coarse-grained paper seems to disappear and reappear at random intervals. Runes of magic are inscribed in a thick, black ink. The runes seem to spell out powers that can only be harnessed by powerful magi.

name: crimson chest
description: This large chest has been crafted from a thick pine. Stained a deep crimson, well-crafted designs have been carved upon it's surface, including a large flame upon the lid.

name: grey robes
description: This is a simple loose cloth tunic, made of soft cotton. It is thin and provides little protection, but is quite light.

name: water lily
description: Designed for floating freely, a large, trumpet-like flower rests candidly atop a broad, circular leaf. A languid, thin strand of roots dangles from beneath the flower, to provide necessary sustenance.

name: violet orchid
description: A narrow, dangly brown stem bears five, perfectly-shaped, violet flowers. Each flower has five petals, round and broad encircling feathery, red anthers. Each orchid plant will only bear this one stem of flowers, making them extremely exotic and beautiful.

name: onion
description: This globe-shaped bulb is slightly smaller than your hand, and is composed of many concentrically arranged layers. It is yellowish in color, and each layer is paper-thin.

name: carrot
description: This thick, bright orange root is capped with a crown of tall, feathery green leaves. Small rootlets reach out from around the carrot, adding to its grainy texture.

name: potato
description: This swollen root has brown dirty skin and yellow starchy flesh. It is oblong and round, though quite unevenly, as in some places it seems concaved in.

name: pumpkin
description: A massive, telltale orange globe sits at the end of a long prickly vine. It is naturally pleated, and is flattened on the side it was laying on to grow. Within it is a mess of stringy flesh and almond-like seeds, seeming kind of hollow.

name: red keyring
description: A steel ring, wide enough to slip around one's wrist with ease. It contains ten duplicate red keys.

name: white keyring
description: A steel ring, wide enough to slip around one's wrist with ease. It contains ten duplicate white keys.

name: altar
description: A round pillar of molten brimstone is set in the center of the lair, flames billowing high from its center pit. Glyphs and other symbols of forbidden arcanery flicker from the altar's smoldering surface, seeming like caged spirits held against their will.

name: skirts of flame
description: Red and orange silk make up the underlayers of these eyecatching skirts, with the topmost pieces shaped like petals of the sun. The pieces rise and sway as small flames run course along their surface. The deep red inner layer feels cool to the touch.

name: ruby hairpin
description: This sturdy hairpin is covered in tiny diamonds, with 5 tear shaped rubies making a flower at the tip.

name: lock of fiery hair
description: This lovely lock of hair still burns with energy. Each fine strand is a different color of flame, and is warm to the touch.

name: crimson ring
description: This ring covers nearly the entire length of the inner finger and appears to be master crafted from crimson metal. The underside is finely textured, helping to aid in the grip of a weapon. Set in the top is a narrow ruby within an oval engraving much resembling a burning flame.

name: apple tree
description: Matured well into its prime, this beautiful, healthy tree has greyish brown bark and soft green leaves. The branches and foliage are so thick it is sometimes difficult to spot ripened fruits within. You think you spot a ready fruit hanging just above your reach.

name: apple tree

name: apple
description: A semi-round fruit with bright red skin and off-white flesh. A dry, brown stem and small green leaf are still attached to its crown.

name: bruised apple
description: A semi-round fruit with spotchy red skin and slightly brown flesh. A dry stem and small green leaf are still attached to its crown.

name: wooden ladder
description: Two long, parellel planks of wood are attached together by evenly spaced, perpendicular steps. The wood has been sanded smooth, and feels fairly trustworthy not to break from under you.

name: flowery apron
description: A garment, fastened around the waist in the back, worn over the lower front of the body to protect clothing. The fabric is embroidered with tiny flowers around the edges, and the letters
boldy read from the bottom right corner.

name: apple pie
description: An apple filled pastry fills and is folded over a thin tin pan. The dough is cross-hatched across the top, and baked to golden perfection. The smell of cinnamon seeps wafts out from within, oozing in places where the apple goo has seeped out of cracks.

name: glass jug
description: A large clear container, bowled out at the center and funneling to a thin nozzle at the top. A small brown cork is stuck in the nozzle.

name: jug of cider
description: A large glass jug, bowled out at the center and funneling to a thin nozzle at the top. It is filled with a clear, honey-colored liquid, that smells quite strongly of apples and alcohol when uncorked.

name: wooden ladder
